headings.text: Yahweh in Ni Sagih Ni Siangthosak

verses.text: A kipat cil-in Yahweh in vantungte leh leitung a piangsak hi.
Tu-in leitung in limlemel nei loin a sung hawm pi-in hong piang a, kuam thukpi maitang khempeuh mial bikbek hi. Tuite maitang tungah Yahweh’ Kha a gamtang hi.
Yahweh in, “Khuavak om hen,” ci-in, khuavak a om hi.
Yahweh in tua khuavak pen phattuamna nei hi, ci-in mu a, Yahweh in khuavak leh khuamial a khen hi.
Tua ciangin Yahweh in khuavak pen “Sun” ci a, khuamial pen Amah in “Zan” a ci hi. Nitak omin zingsang om a, Ni Khatna ahi hi.
Yahweh in, “Tuite kikal-ah a zaipi khat om henla, tua tuite lak panin tuite kikal-ah a khenna hi hen,” a ci hi.
Tua ahih manin Yahweh in a zaipi khat bawl a, a zaipi tunga om tui panin tua ii nuai-a om tui a khen hi. Tua mah bangin a piang pah hi.
Yahweh in tua a zaipi pen “Van” ci hi. Nitak omin zingsang om a, Ni Nihna ahi hi.
Yahweh in, “Van nuai-a om tuite mun khat ah kikhawm henla, lei keu kidawk khia hen,” a ci hi. Tua mah bangin a piang pah hi.
Yahweh in tua lei keu pen “Leitung” ci a, a kikhawmtuah tuite pen “Tuipi” a ci hi. Yahweh in tua pen kituak linlian hi, ci-in a mu hi.
Tua khit ciangin Yahweh in, “Leitung in kung tuamtuam ahi: tang a nei kungnote leh a gah sunga tang a nei singkungte, amau nam tuamtuam ciatin po hen,” a ci hi. Tua mah bangin a piang pah hi.
Leitung in kunghing ahi: amau nam ciatin tang a nei kunghingte leh amau nam ciatin tang a nei singkungte a posak hi. Yahweh in tua pen man hi, ci-in a mu hi.
Nitak omin zingsang om a, Ni Thumna ahi hi.
Tua ciangin Yahweh in, “Zan pan sun a khenkhia dingin vanzaipi sungah khuavakte om henla, tuate pen Pawi hunte, nite leh kumte aa dingin ciaptehna lim hi henla,
leitung khuavak a pia dingin vanzaipi sunga khuavakte hi uh hen” a ci hi. Tua mah bangin a piang pah hi.
Yahweh in khuavak lian nih bawl-in: khuavak lianzaw pen sun a uk ding, khuavak neuzaw pen zan a uk dingin a bawl hi. Amah in aksite zong a bawl hi.
Yahweh in tuate leitung khuavak a pia dingin vanzaipi sungah koih-in:
sun leh zan a uk ding leh khuamial panin khuavak a khenkhia dingin a koih hi. Yahweh in tua pen man hi, ci-in a mu hi.
Nitak omin zingsang om a, Ni Lina ahi hi.
Tua ciangin Yahweh in, “Tuite in nuntakna a nei ganhing honpite piangsak henla, vasate in leitung tunglam vanzaipi kantanin leeng uh hen,” a ci hi.

Tua ahih manin Yahweh in tuipi ganhing golpite leh amau nam ciatin tuipi sungah tampi a pha, nuntakna a nei a gamtang ganhing khempeuh leh amau nam ciatin kha a nei vasate a piangsak hi. Yahweh in tua pen kituak linlian hi, ci-in a mu hi.
Yahweh in amaute thupha pia a, “Ci pha-in tampi pha unla, tuipi sung tuilak teng ah dim un; leitung ah vasate tampi pha un,” a ci hi.
Nitak omin zingsang om a, Ni Ngana ahi hi.

Tua ciangin Yahweh in, “Nuntakna a nei ganhingte amau nam ciatin leitung in piangsak hen: innsate, a bokvak ganhingte leh leitunga gamsate amau nam ciatciatin piang hen,” a ci hi. Tua mah bangin a piang pah hi.
Yahweh in leitung gamsate amau nam ciatin, innsate amau nam ciatin, leh leitunga a bokvak peuhmah amau nam ciatin a piangsak hi. Yahweh in tua pen man hi, ci-in a mu hi.

Tua ciangin Yahweh in, “Keima lim, Keimah hong sunin mihing Ka bawl ding a, amaute in tuipi ngasate tung, huih lak vasate tung, leitung khempeuh’ tung, leh leitunga a bokvak ganhing khempeuhte tungah ukna a nei ding uh hi,” a ci hi.
Tua ahih manin Yahweh in Ama limlemel sun-in mihing piangsak hi. Yahweh limlemel bangin Amah in “Pasal” khat piangsak hi. Tua ciangin pasal’ tung panin numei a piangsak hi.

Tua ciangin Yahweh in mipa thupha pia a, Yahweh in mipa tungah, “Ci pha-in tampi pha in la, leitung dim-in, gualzo in. Tuipi ngasate tung, huih lak vasate tung, leh leitunga a gamtang nuntakna a nei khempeuhte tungah ukna nei in,” a ci hi.
Yahweh in, “En in, leitung maitang khempeuh a om, tang a piangsak kungno khempeuh leh a gah in tang a piangsak singkung khempeuh nang tungah kong pia khin a, tuate an-in na nei ding hi.

Leitung gamsa khempeuh tung, huih lak vasa khempeuh tung, leitung ah a bokvak khempeuh tung, nuntakna a nei peuhpeuh tungah kung hing khempeuh an dingin Ka pia khin hi,” a ci hi. Tua mah bangin a piang pah hi.
Tua ciangin Yahweh in a bawlsa na khempeuh en a, man a sa mahmah hi. Nitak omin zingsang om a, Ni Gukna ahi hi.
Tua bangin vangtungte leh leitung, leh a sunga omte khempeuh kiman khin ta a,
Ni guk ni-in Yahweh in Ama sepsa nasep khempeuh zo-in, Ama sepsa nasep khempeuh panin a Ni Sagih ni-in Amah tawlnga hi.*
Tua ahih ciangin Yahweh in a Ni Sagih ni thupha pia-in, a siangthosak hi. Bang hang hiam cihleh Yahweh in a piansaksa leh a bawlsa nasep khempeuh panin tua ni-in Amah a tawlnga hi.

headings.text: Eden Huan ah Adam leh Eve

verses.text: Hih pen vantungte leh leitung a kipiansak lai-in amaute tangthu ahi a, Yahweh in leitung leh vantungte a bawl ni–
leitung ah gamlak kungnote a om ma, lo sung ankungte a po khiat ma-in, Yahweh in leitung ah guahzusak nai lo a, lokho ding mi zong om nai lo hi.
Ahi zongin leitung panin tuikhuu kaaito-in, lei maitang khempeuh a kawtsak hi.
Yahweh in leilak-a leivui tawh mihing bawl a, a nak sungah nuntakna hu muam-in, tua mipa a nungta khat hong suak hi.
Yahweh in nisuahna lam Eden ah huan khat bawl a, a bawlsa mipa tualai mun ah a koih hi.

Yahweh in etet dingin a lungnophuai leh nek dingin a limtuak singkung nam khempeuh lei panin a posak hi. Tua huan laizang ah Nuntakna Singkung om a, Sia leh Pha Theihna Singkung zong tua huan laizang mah ah a om hi.
Tu-in huan a kawtsak dingin Eden panin gun khat luang a, tua huan panin kakhia-in gun naakpi li hong pha hi.
A masa min pen Pishon hi a, kham omna Havilah gambup kimkot ah a luang pen ahi hi.
Tua gam-a khamte hoih mahmah hi. Suangngote leh mel tuamtuam a nei suang manpha a om hi.
A nihna gun min pen Gihon hi a, Cush gambup kimkot ah a luang pen ahi hi.
A thumna gun min pen Tigris hi a, Assyria gam nisuahna lam-a luang pen ahi hi. A lina pen Euphrates ahi hi.
Tua ciangin Yahweh in mipa la-in, huan kho ding leh a kem dingin Eden huan sungah a koih hi.
Yahweh in mipa thupia a, “Huan sunga singkung khempeuh panin na duh bangbang na ne thei ding a,
ahih hangin Sia le Pha Theihna Singkung panin bangmah na ne kei ding hi. Ahang in tua na nek ni-in na si taktak ding hi,” a ci hi.
Yahweh in, “Mipa amah bek a om ding lungkimhuai zo lo hi; amah aa ding a kilawm a huh ding khat Ka bawl ding hi,” a ci hi.

Yahweh in gamlak gamsa khempeuh leh huihlak vasate khempeuh lei panin bawl a, Adam in tuate bangci min vawh ding hiam ci-in a theihna dingin Adam kiangah a paipih hi. Adam in nuntakna nei khempeuh amau nam ciatin min vawh a, ama min vawh bangbang a min ahi pah hi.
Tua ahih manin Adam in innsate khempeuh, huih lak vasate khempeuh leh gamlak gamsate khempeuh min a vawh hi. A hih hangin Adam aa dingin a kilawm, amah a huh ding a mu kei hi.
Yahweh in Adam ihmut suaksak mahmah a, amah ihmu-in, Amah in mipa pang panin a sa leh a guh la a, tua alakna mun ah satak a dim hi.
Tua ciangin Yahweh in mipa tung panin a lakkhiat a satak leh a guh pen, Amah in numei khatin bawl a, Amah in mipa tungah tua numei a paipih hi.
Adam in, “Tu taktak-in hih pen ka guhte pana guh leh ka satak lak pana satak ahi a, amah pen pasal sung panin a kilakhia ahih manin amah pen “Numei” kici ding hi.
Tua thu hangin pasal in a nu leh a pa nusia-in, ama inn ah a zi tawh pumkhat suak ding uh a, amaute tua thu hangin innkuan khat bang ahi ding uh hi.
Mipa leh a zi, amaute a nih tuakun a guaktangin om uh a, maizum lo uh hi.

Tu-in Yahweh’ bawlsa gamlak ganhing khempeuh sangin tua gulpi pen ngiansiam zaw leh zuauthu lamah teizaw hi. Amah in numei kiangah, “Yahweh in, ‘Huan sung singkung khat peuhpeuh panin bangmah ne lo ding,’ hong ci ahi hiam?” a ci hi.
Numei in gulpi kiangah, “Huan sung singkungte’ gahte ka ne thei uh hi.
Ahih hangin huan laizang a om singkung panin a gah pen Yahweh in, “Na ne kei ding uh a, zong na lawng kei ding uh hi. Tua bangin na hih uh leh na si ding uh hi,” hong ci khinzo hi,” a ci hi.
Gulpi in numei kiangah, “Na si kei taktak ding hi.
Ahang in tua na nek ni-in na mitte kihongding a, pasiante (elohim) bangin a sia leh a pha na theih ding lam Yahweh in thei hi,” a ci hi.

Tua ahih manin numei in nek dinga a limtuak na, etet dinga a lungnophuaina, leh a pilsak thei a deihhuai singkung ahihna a muh ciangin, tua singgah la-in a ne hi. Amah tawh a om a pasal zong pia-a, a pasal in zong a ne hi.
Tua ciangin amaute nih’ mitte kihonga, a khialh khit lam uh leh Yahweh’ thukhamte a palsat khitna a phawk uh hi. Amaute in Yahweh’ thukhamte zui lo uh ahih manin a lau mahmah uh hi.
Tua ciangin amaute in Yahweh’ kammal kikona tungtawnin Pa Yahweh, huan sungah hong paina a za uh hi. Tua ahih manin Yahweh omna pan a muh loh dingin amaute huan sung singkungte lakah a kibu uh hi.
Tua ciangin Yahweh in Adam samin, ama kiangah, “Koi-ah om na hi hiam?” a ci hi.
Tua ahih manin Adam in, “Huan sungah Yahweh’ kammal kikona kaza a, mawhna bawl khin ka hih manin ka lau a, ka kibu hi,” a ci hi.
Yahweh in, “Khatpeuh in nang hong khemna hangin mawhna na bawl kha khin hi! Nek loh dinga nang tunga Kong thupiak ahi tua singkung panin nang in na ne khin hi!” a ci hi.
Tua ciangin mipa in, “Kei tawh om dingin Nong piak numei in tua singgah kei hong pia a, ka ne hi,” a ci hi.
Yahweh in numei kiangah, “Bangci-a hici gamtat na hi hiam?” a ci hi. Numei in, “Gulpi in kei hong khem a, ka ne hi,” a ci hi.

Tua ahih manin Yahweh in gulpi kiangah, “Nang, hih bangin gamta khin na hih manin, samsiatna lian na ngah hi. Keimah in nuntakna a nei khempeuhte tungah nangmah Kong kipsak a, Keimah in leitunga ganhing khempeuh tungah nangmah Kong kipsak hi; ahih hangin leivui pan na nuntak theih nading pen hong kilakkhiatsak ding hi. Nangma dantahna ding mun ah na pai ding a, a nungta tawntung Yahweh in tua ni ciangin nang hong susia ding hi.
Keimah in nang leh numei kikal, nangma suanlekhak leh numei suanlekhak kikalah kigal bawlna kong koih ding hi. Amah in na lutang hong sunim ding a, nang in Ama khetul na sunim ding hi,” a ci hi.
Numei kiangah Amah in, “Na naupaii gimna leh na lungkhamna nakpitakin ka khangsak ding hi. Na a sapipi-in nau na nei ding a, na pasal in nang hong uk ding ahih manin, amah in nang hong mapi ding hi.

Tua ciangin Adam kiangah Amah in, “Nang in na zi’ kammal awlmawh-in, ‘Nang in na ne kei ding hi,’ ci-in nang Kong thupiak tua singkung panin ne khin na hih ciangin, nangma hangin leitang in samsiatna ngah hi; na nuntak sung tawntung tua leitang panin gimpi-in sepna tawh na kivak ding hi.
Ling leh kiakte, nang aa dingin hong pokhia ding a, nang in gamlak kungte na ne ding hi.
Lei ah na ciahkik matengin, na mai-ah khua-ul kai-in nasepna tawh an na ne ding hi. Ahang in lei panin nang hong kipiangsak a, leivui na hih manin, lei ah na ciahkik ding hi,” a ci hi.
Adam in a zi’ min pen Eve a phuak hi. Bang hang hiam cihleh amah pen mihing khempeuh’ nu ahi hi.
Adam leh a zi aa ding, Ama thukhamte amaute in a phawk theih nadingin a siangtho saihadial puante Yahweh in sehsak a, Amah in amaute a silhsak hi.

Tua ciangin Yahweh in, “En in, mipa pen a sia leh a pha a thei khat hong suak ta hi. Amah in a khut zankhia-in, Nuntakna Singkung panin a gah lo-in, ne a, a nuntak tawntung ding pen amah kiphal lo hi,” a ci hi.
Tua thu hangin amah a kipiansakna leitang ah nasem dingin Yahweh in Eden huan panin a sawl khia hi.
Tua ahih manin Amah in mipa hawlkhia-in, Eden huan nisuahna lamah Cherub-te koih a, mun khempeuh a nga thei meikuang namsau pen Nuntakna Singkung lampi a cing dingin a koih hi.
Tu-in Adam in ama zi Eve luppih a, amah gai-in Cain suak a, amah in, “Yahweh’ huhna tawh mi khat ka ngah khin hi,” a ci hi.
Tua ciangin a sanggampa Abel hong suakkik hi. Tu-in Abel pen tuu kem pa hi a, Cain pen lokho pa ahi hi.
Tua nung ciangin hi bangin hong piang hi: Yahweh’ Shabbat-te lak pana Shabbat ni khatin, Cain in lei pana piang singgah piakna Yahweh tungah hong paipih a;
Abel in lei pana piang singgah piakna bektham loin, tuuhon tacil a limci pente tawh biakpiakna a pia thuah lai hi. Yahweh in Abel leh ama piakna thupi sa a,
ahih hangin Cain leh ama piakna thupi a sa kei hi. Cain heh mahmah a, a maigum hi.
Tua ahih manin Yahweh in Cain tungah, “Bang hangin heh na hi hiam? Bang hangin lungkia na hi hiam?

Dik takin hih hi lecin, nang hong kisanglo ding ahi hiam? Dik takin na hih keileh, mawhna in na kongbiang ah hong buk hi. Mawh nopna lungsim pen nang tawh om den a, ahih hangin nang in tua pen na zawh ding ahi hi!” a ci hi.
Tu-in Cain in a sanggampa Abel hopih-in, tua ciangin hici bangin hong piang a, mundang pi khat a tun uh ciangin, Cain in a sanggampa Abel langdo-in, a that hi.
Tua ciangin Yahweh in Cain kiangah, “Na sanggampa Abel koi-ah om hiam?” a ci hi. Amah in, “Ka thei kei hi. Ka sanggam a kempa hong sa na hi hiam?” a ci hi.
Amah in, “Bang hangin hi ci gamtat na hi hiam? Na sanggampa’ sisan, leilak panin Kei tungah hong kiko hi.
Tua ahih manin tu-in, nang khut hangin a luang na sanggampa’ sisan a hup dingin a kamka hih leitung ah nang hong kisamsia hi.
Lei nasep na sep ciangin nang aa dingin an hong piang nawn lo ding hi. Nang pen a galtai na hi ding a, leitung ah kilemna a zong na hi tawntung ding hi,” a ci hi.
Cain in Yahweh kiangah, “Kei’ dantahna pen kei thuakzawhna sangin lianzaw hi!

Lei maitang panin tu ni-in Nang in kei nong hawlkhia taktak-a, Na mai panin kei hong kimu lo ding hi. Tatsatlo-a gal kidona, phu kilakna leh kithuhkikna om ding ahih manin leitung ah a galtai leh mi vakthaap ka hi ding hi,” a ci hi.

Tua ciangin Yahweh in ama kiangah, “Hih pen kikipsak hi! Cain a that peuhmah tungah a zah sagih phu kilakik ding hi. Tua ciangin, amah a mu peuhin a thah khak loh nadingin Yahweh in Cain tungah ciaptehna khat koih hi.
Tua ciangin Yahweh kiang panin Cain paikhia-in, Eden nisuahna lam Nod gam sungah a teng hi.
Tua ciangin Cain in a zi luppih a, amah gai-in, Enoch a suak hi. Tua ciangin amah in khuapi khat sat a, tua khuapi min dingin ama tapa’ min tamin Enoch a phuak hi.
Enoch sung panin Irad suak a, Irad pen Mehuyael pa hi a, Mehuyael pen Methushael pa hi a, Methushael pen Lamech pa ahi hi.
Tua ciangin Lamech in zi nih nei-in; a masa’ min pen Adah hi-in, a nihna’ min pen Zillah ahi hi.
Tua ciangin Adah in tapa Yabal nei hi. Amah pen puanbukte sungah tengin ganhing a neite’ pianna pupi ahi hi.
A sanggampa’ min pen Yubal hi a, harp khausai leh tamngai tumte pianna pupi ahi hi.
Zillah ahihleh, amah in Tubal-Cain nei a, sumngo leh sik nasem khutsiam mi khempeuhte’ sia ahi hi. Tubal-Cain’ sanggamnu pen Naamah ahi hi.
Tu-in Lamech in a zite ahi; Adah leh Zillah kiangah, “Ka aw ngai un. Lamech zite aw, ka thugenna ngai un! Kei hong liamsak manin mi khat, kei hong natsak manin khanglai mi khat, ka that khin hi.
Cain hangin a zah sagih vei kithuk ahihleh, Lemech hangin a zah sawm sagih leh sagih vei-in kithuk ding hi,” a ci hi.

Adam in a zi luppih leuleu a, amah in tapa khat nei-in, a min Seth a phuak hi. Bang hang hiam cihleh amah in, “Cain in Abel that ahih manin Abel’ tangin kei aa dingin Yahweh in naupang khat hong sehsak hi,” a ci hi.
Seth ahih leh amah in tapa khat nei a, a min Enosh a phuak hi. Tua hun a kipanin mite in Yahweh bia-in a Min tangko ding kipan hi.
Hih pen Adam’ suanlekhakte thu ahi hi. Yahweh in mihing a piansak ni-in, Yahweh tawh a kisunin amah a bawl hi.
Amah in numei leh pasal piangsak a, amaute thupha pia-in, amaute a kipiansak ni-in Amah in amaute ‘Mihing’ a ci hi.
Adam kum 130 a phak khit ciangin, ama mel leh a pianzia a sun tapa khat nei a, Seth ci-in a min a phuak hi.
Seth a suah khit ciangin, Adam kum 800 lai a, amah in adang tapate leh tanute a nei lai hi.
Tua ahih manin Adam’ nuntak hun sungteng pen kum 930 hi a, tua ciangin amah si hi.
Seth kum 105 a phak ciangin, Enosh kici tapa khat nei hi.
Enosh a suahkhit ciangin, Seth kum 807 nungta a, adang tapate leh tanute a nei lai hi.
Tua ahih manin Seth nuntak hun sungteng pen kum 912 hi a, tua ciangin amah si hi.
Enosh kum 90 a phak ciangin, Qenan kici tapa khat nei hi.
Qenan a suah khit ciangin, Enosh kum 815 nungta a, adang tapate leh tanute a nei lai hi.
Tua ahih manin Enosh nuntak hun sungteng pen kum 905 hi a, tua ciangin amah a si hi.
Qenan kum 70 a phak ciangin, Mahalalyl kici tapa khat nei hi.
Mahalalyl a suahkhit ciangin, Qenan kum 840 nungta a, adang tapate leh tanute a nei lai hi.
Tua ahih manin Qenan nuntak hun sungteng pen kum 910 hi a, tua ciangin amah si hi.
Mahalalyl kum 65 a phak ciangin, Yared kici tapa khat nei hi.
Yared a suahkhit ciangin, Mahalalyl kum 830 nungta a, adang tapate leh tanute a nei lai hi.
Tua ahih manin Mahalalyl nuntak hun sungteng pen kum 895 hi a, tua ciangin amah si hi.
Yared kum 162 a phak ciangin, Enoch kici tapa khat nei hi.
Enoch a suah khit ciangin, Yared kum 800 nungta a, adang tapate leh tanute nei lai hi.
Tua ahih manin Yared nuntak hun sungteng pen kum 962 hi a, tua ciangin amah si hi.
Enoch kum 65 a phak khit ciangin, Methuselah kici tapa khat nei hi.
Methuselah a suah khit ciangin, Enoch pen Yahweh zahtak takin kum 300 sung tawntung kalsuan a, tua ciangin adang tapate leh tanute nei lai hi.
Tua ahih manin Enoch nuntak hun sungteng pen kum 365 ahi hi.
Tua ciangin Enoch pen Yahweh tawh kikhawl hi. Yahweh muhna ah bangmah ahih loh hangin, tua hun lai-in Yahweh in Ama kiangah amah na sang hi.
Methuselah kum 187 a phak ciangin, Lamech kici tapa khat nei hi.
Lamech a suah khit ciangin, Methuselah kum 782 nungta a, adang tapate leh tanute a nei lai hi.
Tua ahih manin Methuselah nuntak hun sungteng pen kum 969 hi a, tua ciangin amah a si hi.
Lamech kum 182 a phak ciangin, tapa khat nei hi.
Tua ciangin amah in a tapa min Noah phuak a, “Yahweh in a samsiatna hangin gimpipi a i sepna leh i nasepnate panin hih tapa in eite hong tawldamsak ding hi,” a ci hi.
Noah a suah khit ciangin, Lamech kum 595 nungta a, adang tapate leh tanute nei lai hi.
Tua ahih manin Lamech nuntak hun sungteng pen kum 777 hi a, tua ciangin amah si hi.
Noah kum 500 phata a, amah in Shem, Ham, leh Yapheth a kici tapate a nei hi.
Tua ciangin hici bangin hong hi a, leitung ah mite tam dingin hong kipanin, amau sung pan tanute zong suak a,
pasiante’ (elohim) tate in hih mite tanute a hoihna uh a mu hi. Tua ciangin amau deih peuhpeuh teelin a zi dingin a la uh hi.

Tua ciangin Yahweh in, “Silesa deihna bekbek lunglut taktak uh ahih manin, hih leitung mite in Ka kammal ngai vet lo uh hi. Tua ahih manin, amaute nuntak hun ding pen kum 120 bek hi ding hi,” a ci hi.

Tua hun lai-in gitloh thahatna tawh mi a ukte om a, tua nungah zong, pasiante (elohim) tate in mite tanute la-in, amaute tawh ta a nei uh hi. Tua mite pen Yahweh’ gal ahi a thahat mite hi a, tanglai hun pek panin minsiatna tawh a minthangte ahi uh hi.
Tua ciangin leitung ah mihing gitlohna a liatna leh, mihing lungtang’ tupna ngaihsutnate khempeuh a tawntungin a sia lam bekbek a hihna Yahweh in mu hi.
Hih bangin mihing’ gamtatna hangin Yahweh’ lungsim sukha-in dah a, mihing in Yahweh’ thukham zuih ding panin lampial ahih manin, mihing in Yahweh’ Kha Siangtho a dahsak hi.
Tua ahih manin Yahweh in, “Ka piansaksa mihing leh ganhing, a bokvak ganhing leh huih lak vasa, leitung panin Ka susia ding hi. Ahang in amaute’ gamtatna hangin Ka dah mahmah hi.
A hih hangin Yahweh muhna ah Noah in deihsakna leh maipha a mu hi.
Hihte pen Noah khanggui sutna ahi hi. Noah pen ama khan hun lai-in paubaanna a nei lo, a midik khat ahi hi. Noah pen Yahweh zahtak mahmah-in a nungta hi.
Noah in Shem, Ham, leh Yapheth kici tapa thum nei hi.
Leitung zong Yahweh mai-ah siagawp a, leitung ah thuzuihna neilo-in, ngongtatna tawh kidim hi.
Tua ahih manin Yahweh in leitung en a, tua pen a kisiagawp taktak hi. Ahang in leitung ah cilesa nei khempeuh a kisiagawp uh hi.

Tua ciangin Yahweh in Noah kiangah, “Ka mai panin cilesa nei khempeuh’ bei hun hong tung ta hi. Bang hang hiam cihleh amaute’ hangin leitung ah ngongtatna tawh kidim ahi manin leitung tawh amaute Ka susia khawm ding hi.
Nang leh nangin gopher-sing(cypress) tawh tembaw khat bawl inla, tembaw sungah a deite bawl-in, a sung leh a pua singnai zut in.
Na bawl dan ding hi bang ahi hi: tembaw a sauna pen cubit zathum; pi 450, a zaina pen cubit sawmnga; pi 75, a sanna pen cubit sawmthum; pi 45, hi ding hi.
Tembaw aa dingin tawlet khat na bawl ding a, a tung panin cubit khat; a tawmpen letmat 18, na ciangah tua pen na zawh bawl ding a, a pangah tembaw kongkhak na thuah ding hi.
En in, Kei, Kei mahmah in, nuntakna hu a nei cilesa khempeuh vanpi nuai panin a susia dingin leitung ah tuiciin Ka tungsak ding a, leitung a om khempeuh a si ding hi.
A hi zongin nang tawh Ka thuciamna Ka kipsak ding a, nang tembaw sungah na pai ding hi. Nang, na tapate, na zi leh na tapate’ zite tawh na pai khawm ding hi.
Nuntakna a nei khempeuh nang tawh a nungta dingin nam khat ah nih ciat tembaw sungah na paipih ding a, tuate pen anu leh apa hi ding hi.
Vasate amau’ nam ciatin, ganhingte amau’ nam ciatin, leilak ah a bokvak ganhingte amau nam ciatin, a suahtak nadingin amau nam ciatin nam khat ah nih ta nang kiangah hong pai ding uh hi.
Nang in a kine an khempeuh nang aa dingin la inla, tuate na kiangah khawmtuah in. Tua pen nang leh amaute aa dingin an ding ahi hi,” a ci hi.
Tua ahih ciangin Yahweh in ama kiangah a thupiakna khempeuh bang lianin Noah in sem a, tua khit ciangin a man hi.
Tua ciangin Yahweh in Noah kiangah, “Nang leh na innkuanpihte tembaw sungah hong pai un. Ahang in hih khang mite sung panin Kei tungah midik na hihna ka mukhin hi.
A siangtho ganhingte panin kop sagih, anu leh apa, a sianglo ganhingte panin kop khat, a nu leh a pa, nangmah in na kiangah na la ding a,
ahih hangin huih lak vasate kop sagih, a nu leh a pa, lei maitang panin amaute’ cii a bei loh nadingin nang in na kiangah na la ding hi.
Bang hang hiam cihleh tuzawh ni sagih khit ciangin, leitung ah sun sawmli leh zan sawmli sung guah Ka zusak ding a, tua ciangin Ka bawlsa nuntakna a nei khempeuh lei maitang panin Ka susia ding hi.
Tua ciangin Yahweh in amah a thupiakna bangin Noah in sem hi.
Leitung ah tuiciin tun hun-in Noah kum 600 a pha hi.
Tuiciin tunna hangin Noah, amah tawh a tapate, a zi leh a tapate’ zite, tembaw sungah a pai uh hi.
A siangtho ganhingte lak pan, a sianglo ganhingte lak pan, vasate lak pan, leh leitunga a bokvak ganhing khempeuh lak pan,
Yahweh in Noah a thupiaksa bangin, a nu leh a pa, nih ta nih ta-in tembaw sung Noah kiangah a pai hi.
Tua bangin ni sagih khit ciangin hi bang thu hong piang a, leitung ah tuiciin hong tungta hi.
Noah nuntak kum, a kum 600 kum, a kha nihna, tua kha a ni sawm leh ni sagih ni-in a thuk mahmah tuinakte khempeuh kitamkham in, vantung tawlette hong kihong a,
Tua ciangin leitung ah sun sawmli leh zan sawmli sung guah a zu hi.
Tua ni teekteek mahin Noah, leh Noah’ tapate ahi: Shem, Ham, leh Yapheth, leh Noah’ zi, leh a tapate’ zi thumte tawh amaute tembaw sungah lut uh a,
ganhing peuhmah amau nam ciat, innsa khempeuh amau nam ciat, leitunga a bokvak ganhing peuhmah amau nam ciat, vasa peuhmah amau nam ciat, vasa’ cii peuhmah;
nuntakna hu a nei cilesa khempeuh nih ta nih ta-in tembaw sung Noah kiangah amaute a pai uh hi.
Yahweh in amah a thupiakna bangin a lut peuhmah nuntakna a nei khempeuh anu leh apa hi a, tua ciangin Yahweh in a sungah amah a kalhkhum hi.
Tu-in leitung ah ni sawmli sung tuiciin tung hi. Tuite hong tam semsem-in, tembaw laamto a, leitung’ tungah khangin sangto lai hi.
Tuite khangto-in, leitung ah nakpitak-in hong tam a, lei tung khawngah tembaw kikhinin, tua ciangin tui maitangte khawngah tembaw kikhin hi.
Tua ciangin tuite pen leitung ah hong khauh mahmah a, vanpi nuai-a mual sang khempeuh a tuumcip hi.
Mualte tung panin cubit sawm le nga val; pi sawmnih val, bang tuite in a tuumcip hi.
Leitunga a gamta a nungta ganhingte khempeuh ahi: vasate, innsate, gamsate, leitunga a bokvak khempeuh, leh mihing khempeuh, a si hi.
Leikeu tung a a teng, a nakvang panin nuntakna huih a diik khempeuh a si hi.

Tua ahih manin lei maitang-a om a nungta ahi: mihing leh ganhing, a bokvak peuhmah leh huih lak vasa tuate khempeuh Amah in susia hi. Amaute leitung panin kisusia hi. Noah leh tembaw sunga amah tawh a om teng bek suakta hi.
Ni za leh ni sawmnga sung leitung tuite in a tuum hi.

Tua ciangin Noah leh nuntakna a nei peuhmah, leh tembaw sunga a mah tawh a pai ganhing khempeuh Yahweh in a phawk hi. Tua ciangin leitung a nawk dingin Yahweh in huih bawl a, tua ciangin tuite a kiam hi.
Kuamthuk tuinakte leh vantung tawlette zong khawl a, vantung pana guah zong a dai hi.
Leitung panin tuite kiam suksuk hi. Ni za leh ni sawmnga a cin ciangin tuite kiamsuk hi.
Kha sagihna kha sung, tua kha a sawm le sagih ni-in Ararat mualte tungah tembaw kinga hi.
A kha sawmna kha dong tuite kiamkiam lai hi. A kha sawmna kha sung, tua kha a ni masa ni in, mual dawnte kimu hi.
Tua ahih manin ni sawm li hong cin ciangin hici bangin hong piang a, Noah in ama bawlsa tembaw tawlet hong hong khia ta hi.
Tua ciangin leitung panin tuite a keu khit dongin a leng kawikawi va-ak khat khahkhia hi.
Lei maitang panin tuite a kiam khin nai hiam cih a theih nadingin amah in vakhu khat zong a khahkhia hi.

A hih hangin lei maitang khempeuh tuite in tuam lai ahih manin amah in a khepek a ngak na’ng tawlngak nading mun mulo a, tembaw sung Noah kiangah hong ciahkik hi. Tua ahih manin amah in a khut zankhia-in a vakhu man a, tembaw sungah a paipih hi. 10 Amah in ni sagih sung ngakkik lai a, tua ciangin tembaw panin vakhu a khah khia leuleu hi.
Nitak lam ciangin vakhu ama kiangah hong leng a, en in, amuk-ah mangbuh vui hing dikdek petin hong tung ahih manin lei panin tuite a kiamkhit lam Noah in a thei hi.
Tua ahih manin amah in ni sagih sung ngak lai a, vakhu khahkhia-in, ama’ kiangah hong ciahkik nawn lo hi.

Noah a khan kum zaguk leh a kum khatna, a kha masa, tua kha a ni masa ni-in hici bang hong piang hi; leitung panin tuite hong keu ta a, Noah in tembaw khuhna lakhia-in en a, lei maitang na keu taktak hi.
A kha nihna, tua kha a ni sawmnih leh sagih ni-in leitung keu hi.
Tua ciangin Yahweh in Noah hopih-in, a gen inah:
“Tembaw panin nang leh na zi, na tapate leh na tapate’ zite tawh paikhia un.
A nungta cilesa peuhmah ahi nang tawh a om vasate, innsate, leitunga a bokvak peuhmah nang tawh paikhiatpih in. Tua hileh amaute leitung ah kizel-in, cipha-in tampi a pha thei ding uh hi,” a ci hi.
Tua ahih manin Noah pen a tapate, a zi leh a tapate’ zite tawh a paikhia hi.
Gamsa peuhmah, a bokvak peuhmah, vasa peuhmah leh leitunga a bokvak limlim tembaw panin a paikhia hi.

Tua ciangin Noah in Yahweh aa dingin biaknatau khat lam a, a siangtho ganhing peuhmah sungpan leh a siangtho vasa peuhmah sung pan khat ciat la-in, ama bawlsa biaknatau tungah meihal biakpiakna a pia hi.

Yahweh in namtui a sa hi. Tua ahih manin Yahweh in a lungsim sungah, “Mihing lungsim ngaihsutna pen a khangno hun panin a sia hi a, ahi zongin mihing’ hangin leitang pen Ka samsiakik ngeinawn kei ding a, tu-a Ka hihsa bangin nuntakna nei khempeuh, zongh Ka susiakik ngei nawn kei ding hi.
Leitung a omlai tengin lo pawi hun leh anlak hun, a vot leh a sa, khuakhal leh phalbi, sun leh zan cihte bei lo ding hi,” a ci hi.
Tua ahih manin Yahweh in Noah leh a tapate thupha pia a, amaute tungah, “Pung unla tampi pha-in, leitung dim un,” a ci hi.
Leitung gamsate khempeuh, huih lak vasate khempeuh, leitunga a gamtang khempeuh leh tuipi ngasa khempeuh in note hong kihta in zahtak ding uh hi. Tuate pen note’ khut sungah hong kipia hi.
A nungta a gamtang a siangtho peuhmah, note aa dingin an hi ding hi. Kungno hing khempeuh Kong piak bangin a siangtho na khempeuh zong note Kong pia khin hi.
A hih hangin nuntakna ahi sisan pen a sa tawh na ne kei ding uh hi.

Note’ nuntakna sisan hangin amaute’ khut mahmah panin nuntakna sisan mah Ka kal teekteek ding a, ganhing khat peuhpeuh ahihleh zong ka kal taktak ding hi. Mi khat peuhpeuh sanggampa’ khut mahmah panin zong mihing nuntakna leiba Ka kal ding hi.
Yahweh in Ama lim sunin hong bawl ahih manin mihing sisan a luangsak peuhmah, mi mah in sisan luangsakkik ding hi.
“Note na hih uhleh, pung unla tampi pha un, leitung ah tam miamua unla, tua sungah tampi pha un,” a ci hi.
Tua ciangin Yahweh in Noah leh amah tawh a om a tapate hopih-in, a gen inah:
“En un, note leh note’ khita na suanlekhakte uh leh,
note tawh a om a nungta ganhing peuhmah ahi: vasate, innsate, leh tembaw pana a paikhia note tawh a om leitung gamsa khempeuh leh leitung gamsa khempeuh tawh Ka thuciamna ka kipsak hi.
Tua bangin note tawh Ka thuciamna ka kipsak hi. Tuiciin tawh cilesa khempeuh cikmahin kibeimangsak nawn lo ding a, leitung a susia dingin tuiciin zong cikmahin tungkik ngei nawn lo ding hi,” a ci hi.
Tua ciangin Yahweh in, “Hih pen Kei leh note leh note tawh a om a nungta ganhing khempeuh kikalah mailam khang tawntung aa dingin thuciamna lim hi ding hi:
Meii sungah ka sakhituihup Ka koih a, tua pen Kei leh leitung kikalah thuciamna lim hi ding a,
Vantung ah meii Kong kaisak ciangin meii sungah sakhituihup a kimuh leh,
Kei leh note leh a nungta cilesa khempeuh kikalah Ka thuciamna Ka phawk ding a, nuntakna a nei khempeuh a susia dingin tuite khangin tuiciin tungkik ngei nawn lo ding hi.
Meii sungah sakhituihup a om ciangin Keimah in Ka en ding a, Kei leh leitunga a om nuntakna a nei khempeuh tawh tawntung thuciamna Ka phawk ding hi,” a ci hi.
Yahweh in Noah kiangah, “Hih pen Kei leh leitung a om a nungta peuhmah kikal-a Ka kipsaksa thuciamna lim hi,” a ci hi.
Tu-in tembaw panin a paikhia Noah’ tapate pen Shem, Ham, leh Yapheth ahi uh hi. Ham pen Canaan’ pa ahi hi.
Hih Noah’ tapa thumte panin leitung buppi mi tawh hong kidim hi.
Lokho mi ahi Noah in leenggah huan khat a bawl hi.
Amah in leenggahzu ne-in kham a, a puanbuk sungah bangmah silh loin a om hi.
Canaan’ pa Ham in a pa guaktangin a omna mu a, a pualama om a sanggam nihte kiangah a gen hi.

A hih hangin Shem leh Yapheth in puan khat la-in amau tegel’ liangko tuakah baang uh a, a nung leh lamun pai-in a pa uh’ guaktang omna a khuh uh hi. Amaute in maingat lo ahih manin a pa uh’ guaktang omna mulo uh hi.
Tua ahih manin Noah a leenggahzu khamna panin a pilvan’ ciangin ama tungah a tapa nauzawte’ gamtatna a thei hi.
Tua ciangin amah in, “Canaan in samsiatna ngah tahen la, a sanggamte tunga nasemte sila hi tahen.
Amah in, “Yahweh leh Shem’ pa in thupha ngah tahen la, Canaan, ama nasem hisak hen.
Yahweh in Yapheth pungsak henla, Shem puanbukte sungah ama tengsakin, Canaan pen ama nasem hisak hen,” a ci hi.
Tuiciin tunzawh Noah pen kum 350 nungta hi.
Tua ahih manin Noah’ nuntak hun sungteng pen kum 950 hi a, tua ciangin amah si hi.
Hih pen Noah’ tapa Shem, Ham, leh Yapheth-te suanlekhakte ahi hi. Tuiciin tun khit ciangin amau sung panin tapate suak hi.
Yapheth’ tapate: Gomer, Magog, Madai, Yavan, Tubal, Meshech, leh Tiras ahi hi.
Gomer’ tapate: Ashkenaz, Riphath, leh Togarmah ahi hi.
Yavan’ tapate: Elishah, Tarshish, Kittim, leh Dodanim ahi hi.
Hihte panin tuipi gei-a teng Gentile mite pen amau leitang ah kithehthang uh a, amau kampau ciat tawh kizui-in, amau minam ciat zui-in a gamgam ah a om uh hi.
Ham’ tapate: Cush, Mitzraim, Put, leh Canaan ahi hi.
Cush’ tapate: Seba, Havilah, Sabtah, Raamah, leh Sabtechah hi a, Raamah’ tapate pen Sheba leh Dedan ahi hi.
Cush in Nimrod kici tapa khat nei a, amah pen leitung ah a thahat khat dingin hong kipan hi.
Amah pen gitloh thahatna tawh mi-uk, mikhem leh Yahweh langpang mipa ahi hi. Tua ahih manin “Nimrod bangin gitloh thahatna tawh mi-uk zuaukhem-in Yahweh langpang mipa” cih paunak na om hi.
Ama kumpi gam kipatna pen Babel, Erech, Accad hi a, tuate khempeuh Babylon zong a kici Shinar gamsung ahi hi.
Tua gam panin Assyria gam ah amah pai-in, Nineveh, Rehoboth Ir, Calah, le
Nineveh leh Calah kikal-a om Resen khuapite a sat hi. (Resen khua pen khuapi lian khat ahi hi)
Mitzraim in Ludim, Anamim, Lehbim, Naphtuhim, le
Pathrusim, leh Casluhim cih tapate a nei hi. (Casluhim pen Philistines leh Caphtorim mite pianna ahi hi.)
Canaan in ama ta masa Sidon, leh Heth cih tapate nei a,
Yebus mite, Amor, leh Girgash mite,
Hiv mite, Arki mite, Sin mite,
Arvad mite, Zemar mite leh Hamath mite’ pianna pupi ahi hi.
Canaan mite gamgi pen Sidon panin kipanin Gerar lam manawhin Gaza ciang dong ban a, tua panin Sodom, Gomorrah, Admah, leh Zeboiyim lam manawhin Lasha ciang dong ahi hi.
Hihte pen amau innkuan ciat, amau kampau ciat zui-in amau leitang, amau gam ciat-a a om Ham’ tapate ahi uh hi.
Eber tate khempeuh (Hebrews) pianna pupi, Yapheth sanggam, ta upa Shem’ sung panin tapate leh tanute a piang hi.
Shem’ tapate: Elam, Asshur, Arphaxad, Lud, leh Aram ahi hi.
Aram’ tapate: Uz, Hul, Gether, leh Meshech ahi hi.
Arphaxad in Salah kici tapa khat nei a, Salah in Eber kici tapa khat nei hi.
Eber kiang panin tapa nih piang a, khat’ min pen Peleg hi a, ahang in ama hun lai-in leitung kikhen hi. Yoktan pen a sanggampa’ min ahi hi.
Yoktan pen Almodad, Shepheph, Hatzarmaveh, Yerah,
Hadoram, Uzal, Diklah,
Obal, Abimael, Sheba,
Orphir, Havilah, leh Yobab-te pianna pa ahi hi. Hihte khempeuh pen Yoktan’ tapate ahi hi.
Amaute’ tenna pen Mesha panin Sephar lam manawhin nisuahna mualtung dong ban hi.
Hihte pen amau innkuan ciat, amau kampau ciat zui-in amau leitang, amau gam ciat-a a om Shem’ tapate ahi uh hi.
Hihte pen amaute suanlekhak zui-in amaute’ gam ciat-a teng Noah tapate’ innkuante ahi hi. Tuiciin tun khit ciangin hihte tung panin leitung ah minamte kikhenthang hi.
Tua laitakin leitung bupin pau nam khat leh pautaang khat zang hi.
Tua ciangin hici bangin hong piang a, amaute nisuahna lam panin a khualzin tawh kizui-in amaute in Shinar; Babylon, gam sungah leitamzang khat mu uh a, tua lai mun ah a teng uh hi.
Tua ciangin amaute khatlekhat kiangah, “Hong pai un, leiseek seekin limtakin hal ni,” a kici uh hi. Amaute in suang dingin leiseek nei uh a, buan dingin kultal tui nei uh hi.

Amaute in, “Hong pai un, khuapi khat leh a dawnin vantungte a ban ding tausang khat ei le ei-in lam ni. Eite i minthan nadingin bawl ni tua hileh leitung buppi ah eite i kithehthang mang kei ding hi,” a ci hi.
Ahih hangin mihingte tapate lamsa tua khuapi leh tausang a en dingin Yahweh hong paisuk hi.

Tua ciangin Yahweh in, “minamte kithukhat taktak a, amaute khempeuh in kampau khat zang uh hi. Hih pen amau’ sep ding a kipatna bek ahi hi. Hih khit ciangin sep dinga amau’ vaihawmte amau aa dingin hi thei nawn lo ding hi.
Hong pai un! Keimah ka paisuk ding a, tua mun ah amaute kampauna ka kitukalhsak ding hi. Tua hileh amaute khatlekhat thu a kigenna uh a kitel thei nawn kei ding uh hi.
Tua ahih manin tua lai mun panin lei maitang khempeuh ah Yahweh in amaute thehthang a, a khuapi bawl uh a tawp hi.
Tua ahih ciangin a min Babel kici hi. Bang hang hiam cihleh tua lai mun ah Yahweh in leitung khempeuh’ kampau kitukalhsak hi.
Hihte pen Shem suanlekhakte hi a, Shem kumza a phak, tuiciin tun zawh kum nih a phak ciangin Arphaxad kici tapa khat nei hi.
Arphaxad a suah khit ciangin Shem kum 500 nungta lai a, adang tapate leh tanute a nei lai hi.
Arphaxad kum 35 a phak ciangin, Salah kici tapa khat nei hi.
Salah a suah khit ciangin, Arphaxad pen kum 403 nungta lai a, adang tapate leh tanute a nei lai hi.
Salah kum 30 a phak ciangin, Eber kici tapa khat nei hi.
Eber a suah khit ciangin, Salah kum 403 nungta lai a, adang tapate leh tanute a nei lai hi.
Eber kum 34 a phak ciangin, Peleg kici tapa khat nei hi.
Peleg a suah khit ciangin, Eber kum 430 nungta lai a, adang tapate leh tanute nei lai hi.
Peleg kum 30 a phak ciangin, Reu kici tapa khat nei hi.
Reu a suah khit ciangin, Peleg kum 209 nungta lai a, adang tapate leh tanute a nei lai hi.
Reu kum 32 a phak ciangin, Serug kici tapa khat a nei hi.
Serug a suah khit ciangin, Reu kum 207 nungta lai a, adang tapate leh tanute a nei lai hi.
Serug kum 30 a phak ciangin, Nahor kici tapa khat nei hi.
Nahor a suah khit ciangin, Serug kum 200 nungta lai a, adang tapate leh tanute nei lai hi.
Nahor kum 29 a phak ciangin, Terah kici tapa khat nei hi.
Terah a suah khit ciangin Nahor kum 119 nungta lai a, adang tapate leh tanute a nei lai hi.
Tu-in Terah kum 70 phata a, Abram, Nahor, leh Haran kici tapate a nei hi.
Hihte pen Terah suanlekhakte hi a, Terah in Abram, Nahor, leh Haran kici tapate nei hi. Haran in Lot kici tapa khat a nei hi.
Ahih hangin ama’ pa Terah a sih ma-in ama suahna leitang ahi Chaldees gam Ur khua ah Haran si hi.
Abram leh Nahor in zi nei uh a, Abram zi’ min pen Sarai hi a, Nahor’ zi min pen Milcah ahi hi. Amah pen Milcah leh Iscah-te’ pa Haran’ tanu ahi hi.
Ahih hangin Sarai ciing a, ta nei lo hi.

Terah in ama tapa Abram leh Haran tapa ahi ama tupa Lot, leh ama tapa Abram’zi ahi a mo nu Sarai samin, Canaan leitang ah a pai dingin Chaldees gam Ur khua panin amaute a paikhia khawm uh hi. Amaute Haran tung uh a, tua mun ah a teng uh hi.
Tua ahih manin Terah nuntak hun sungteng pen kum 205 hi a, Haran ah Terah si hi.
Tu-in Yahweh in Abram kiangah, “Na gam, na beh, leh na pa’ inn panin nang Kong lah ding gam ah pai in.
Minam lianin nang Kong bawl ding hi. Nang thupha Kong pia ding a, na min Ka liansak ding a, nang pen thupha khat na hi ding hi.
Nang thupha hong pia peuhmah thupha Ka pia dinga, hong samsia peuhmah Ka samsia ding hi. Nangma sungah minam khempeuh thupha kipia ding hi,” a ci khin hi.
Tua ahih manin Yahweh in ama tungah a gensa bangin Abram pai a, Lot in zong a zui hi. Haran nusia in a pai hunin Abram kum 75 a pha hi.

Abram in ama’ zi Sarai, leh ama sanggampa’ tapa Lot, amau’ kaihkhopsa amau neihsa khempeuh, leh Haran-a a mau’ neih sila khempeuh samin, Canaan leitang ah a pai dingin amau ding khia uh a, tua gam-a tung uh hi.
Abram in tua gam sung nawkin Shechem dong zin a, a vanglian sia khat kiangah tung hi. Tua lai-in Canaan mite tua gam ah a teng hi.
Tua ciangin Abram tungah Yahweh kilangin a gen inah: “Na suanlekhakte tungah hih gam Ka pia ding hi,” a ci hi. Tua ciangin ama tunga kilang Yahweh aa dingin tua mun ah biaknatau khat a bawl hi.

Tua panin Beth El nisuahna lam-a mual ah amah pai a, tua mun ah a puanbuk a lam hi. Ama kiang panin nitumna lamah Beth El om a, nisuahna lamah Ai a om hi. Tua mun ah Yahweh aa dingin biaknatau khat lamin, tua mun ah Yahweh Min tawh thu a ngen hi.
Tua khit ciangin Negev lam zuanin Abram in a khualzin a zom hi.
Tu-in tua gam ah kialpi tung hi. Tua gam kialpi nasia ahih manin Egypt ah a teng dingin Abram a paisuk hi.
Egypt gam ah a lut madeuh-in, amah in ama zi Sarai kiangah, “Na ngai in, nang pen numei melhoih khat na hihna ka thei a,
tua pen Egypt mite in hong muh ciangin, nang pen ka zi na hih lam thei ding uh a, tua ciangin amaute in kei hong that ding uh a, ahih hangin amaute in nang hong nungtasak ding hi.
Nang pen ka sanggamnu hi ci-in hi bangdanin genna tawh nangmah in kei nong itna a kicianin nong lak ding a, tua hileh nangma hangin ka nuntakna a suakta kha thei ding hi,” a ci hi.
Egypt gam sungah Abram a tun ciangin tuanu pen numei melhoih mahmah khat ahihna a mu uh hi.
Pharaoh’(Faro) uliante in tua nu a muh uh ciangin Pharaoh kiangah tua nu phat uh a, numeite omna Pharaoh’ kumpi inn ah a kipaipih hi.
Sarai hangin Pharaoh in Abram limbawl-in, tuuhon, bawnghon, laate, pasal nasemte, numei nasemte, laa anute, leh kalaohte a pia hi.
Ahih hangin Yahweh in Abram zi Sarai hangin Pharaoh tung leh ama innkuanpihte tungah natna lianpi a tungsak hi.
Tua ciangin Pharaoh in Abram samsak a, a gen inah: “Bang hangin kei tungah hi bangin hong gamta na hi hiam? Amah pen na zi ahih lam bang hangin hong gen lo na hi hiam?

Bang hangin amah pen ka sanggamnu hi ci na hi hiam? Amah pen ka zi dingin ka lak leh amah na zi a na hihi! Amah la in la pai in!” a ci hi. 20 Tua ahih manin Pharaoh in ama mite tungah Abram tawh kisai-in thupia a, amaute in Abram leh ama zi leh ama neih khempeuhte a gamla-ah a puak hi.
Tua ahih ciangin Egypt panin Abram, ama zi leh ama neih khempeuh Negev gam lamah paito a, Lot zong amah tawh a pai hi.
Abram in ganhing, ngun, leh kham hong hau mahmah ta hi.
Amah pen Negev pan leh Beth El panin a kipat cil-a a puanbuk omnasa mun Beth El leh Ai kikal dong,
a masa-a biaknatau a bawlna mun dongah khualzinin a paisuak hi. Tua mun ah Abram in Yahweh Min a lo hi.
Abram tawh a pai Lot in zong tuuhonte, bawnghonte leh puanbukte nei hi.
Ahih hangin amaute a teng khawm dingin amaute neihsate tam mahmah ahih manin amaute a ten khop uh ciangin leitang in daih zolo hi.
Abram’ gancingte lakah, leh Lot’ gancingte lakah kitotna hong khang hi. Tua lai-in Canaan mite leh Periz mite tua gam ah a teng lai uh hi.
Tua ahih manin Abram in Lot kiangah, “Ei mihingte pan sanggam i hih manin, kei le nang kikal, leh kei gancingte leh nang gancingte kikalah kitotna omsak kei ni.
Na mai-ah gambuppi om hi lo ahi hiam? I kipawl khopna pan kikhen ni. Nang veilam ah na pai leh kei taklam ah ka pai ding hi. Nang taklam ah na pai leh kei veilam ah ka pai ding hi,” a ci hi.

Tua ciangin Lot zong khuadak a, Yardan leitamzang buppi mu a, tua mun khempeuh ah tui hoihtakin ngah-in, Yahweh in Sodom leh Gomorrah khua a suksiatma hi a, Yahweh’ huan tawh hitaleh, Zoar gam lam paina Egypt gam tawh hitaleh kibang hi, ci-in a mu hi.
Tua ahih ciangin Lot in ama aa dingin Yardan leitamzang khempeuh teel a, Lot pen nisuahna lamah a pai hi. Tua ciangin amaute a kikhen tuak uh hi.
Abram pen Canaan leitang ah teeng a, Lot ahihleh tua leitamzang khuapite sungah teengin, Sodom khua dongah a puanbukte a lam hi.
Tu-in Sodom mite gilo uh a, Yahweh langpanin mawhna lianpite bawlbawl uh hi.
Ama kiang pan Lot a paikhiat khit ciangin, Yahweh in Abram kiangah, “Tu-a na omna mun panin khuadak kawikawi inla, leilu lam leh leitaw lam, nisuahna lam leh nitumna lam en in.
Na muh leitang khempeuh, nang’ tung leh na tuletate tungah Kong pia paisuak hi.
Na tuletate, leitung leivui zahin ka bawl ding a, mi khatpeuh in leitung leivui a sim zawh leh, na suanlekhakte zong a kisim zo ding hi.
Hih pen nang tungah hong pia taktak ding ka hih manin, ding in la, gamdung gamvai tawnin pai in,” a ci hi.
Tua ahih ciangin Abram in a puanbukte khin a, Hebron nai-a Mamre singkungte nai-ah a teng dingin a pai hi. Tua mun ah Yahweh aa dingin amah in biaknatau khat a lam hi.
Shinar kumpipa Amraphel, Ellasar kumpipa Arioch, Elam kumpipa Chedorlaomer, leh Goyim (Minamte) kumpipa Tidal-te hun lai-in hici bang hong hi a,
amaute in Sodom kumpipa Bera, Gomorrah kumpipa Birsha, Admah kumpipa Shinab, Zeboiyim kumpipa Shemeber, leh Zoar ahi Bela kumpipa, hih kumpite tungah gal va sim uh hi.
Hih kumpite in Siddim Kuam (Ci Tuipi) ah a galkapte uh a gawm uh hi.
Chedorlaomer ukna nuai-ah amaute kum sawm leh kum nih sung om uh a, ahih hangin a kum sawm leh kum thumna ciangin amaute in lehdo uh hi.

A kum sawm leh kum li ciangin Chedorlaomer leh amah tawh a kipawl kumpite hong kuankhia uh a, sehnel gam nai-a El Paran gam dong Ashteroth Karnaim gam sunga Rephai-te, Ham gam sunga Zuzim, Shaweh Kiryatyam gam sunga Emim,
le amau’ gam Seir mual tunga Hori mite hong zo uh hi.
Tua khit ciangin amaute kilehkik uh a, Kadesh ahi Mishpat lamah pai-in, Amalek mite gam khempeuh leh, Hatzetzon Tamar gam a teng Amor mite do-in a zo uh hi.
Sodom kumpipa, Gomorrah kumpipa, Admah kumpipa, Zeboiyim kumpipa, Zoar ahi Bela kumpipa-te kuankhia uh a, Siddim Kuam-a galkidona ah hong kihel uh a,
Elam kumpipa Chedorlaomer, Goyim (Minamte) kumpipa Tidal, Shinar kumpipa Amraphel, leh Ellasar kumpipa Arioch-te langdo uh a, kumpi li kigawm leh kumpi nga kigawm kido uh hi.
Tu-in Siddim Kuam pen singnaivom khukte tawh kidim a, Sodom kumpipa leh Gomorrah kumpipa a tai uh ciangin pawlkhat tua khukte sungah kia uh a, a omlai teng mualtungte ah tai uh hi.
Tua ciangin Sodom leh Gomorrah-te neihsa khempeuh leh a an khempeuh, kumpi lite in la uh a, tua ciangin amaute a pai mang uh hi.
Sodom a teeng Abram sanggampa’ tapa Lot leh ama’ neihsa khempeuh la-in, a pai khia uh hi.

Tua khit ciangin a suakta mi khat hong pai-in, Hebrew mi Abram’ kiangah hong gen hi. Eshcol leh Aner-te sanggampa ahi Amor mi khat neihsa Mamre singkungte kiangah Abram teeng a, amaute pen Abram tawh a kipawlkhawm ahi uh hi.
Ama sanggampa’ tapa salin a kimatna Abram in a zak ciangin, ama innkuanpih sung pana suak a kihilhsa pasal 318-te galvan tawh kithawisakin, Dan dongah nungdelhin a pai uh hi.
Zan hun sungin, amaute a do dingin Abram in ama mite khen a, amaute zo-in, Damascus leilu lam Hobah dong a delh uh hi.
Tua ahih ciangin amah in neihsa khempeuh lakik zo hi. Lot leh ama neihsa khempeuh, numeite leh midangte tawh amah in a ciahpihkik hi.
Chedorlaom kumpipa leh amah tawh a om kumpite a dona panin Abram a ciahkik ciangin, Shaweh Kuam (Kumpipa’ Kuam) ah Sodom kumpipa in amah dawn dingin a pai hi.
Tua ciangin Salem kumpipa Melchizedek in an leh leengggahzu hong pusuah hi. Amah pen Sang Pen Yahweh’ siampi zong ahi hi.
Amah in Abram thupha pia a, a gen inah: “Vantung leh leitung a piangsak, Sang Pen Yahweh in Abram thupha pia henla;
na galte na khut sungah hong pia Sang Pen Yahweh in thupha ngah tahen,” a ci hi. Abram in na khempeuh sawma khat ama tungah a pia hi.
Tu-in Sodom kumpipa in Abram kiangah, “Mite kei hong pia inla, neihsa khempeuh nang aa dingin la in,” a ci hi.
Ahih hangin Abram in Sodom kumpipa kiangah, “Vantung leh leitung a piangsak Sang Pen Yahweh tungah keimah in ka khut ka lam khin zo a,
pat khauzang khat a kipan khedap khau khat dong bangmah mahmah a la lo dingin ka kiciam hi. Tua hileh “keimah in Abram ka hausak hi” cikmah in na ci thei kei ding hi.
Ka mite neksa leh kei tawh hong kuan khawm mite’ tanh ding lobuang bangmah kong sang kei ding hi. Kei tawh hong pai khawm ahi: Aner, Eshcol, leh Mamre mite amau tanh ding amaute pia in,” a ci hi.
Hihte khempeuh khit ciangin, mangmuhna tawh Yahweh kammal Abram tungah hong tunga, “Lau kei in, Abram aw, Kei pen nangma kidalna lum ka hi hi. Na thaman lian mahmah ding hi,” a ci hi.
Ahih hangin Abram in, “Pa Yahweh aw, bang hong pia ding na hi hiam? Ta nei loin si ding ka hihna, leh ka neihsa a luah ding pen Dammesek mi Eliezer hi lo ahi hiam?
Abram in, “Ta kei Nong pia kei a, tua ahih manin ka innkuanpih sung panin sila khatpeuh in keima gamh a luah ding hi ta hi,” a ci hi.
En in, Yahweh’ kammal ama tunga, a gen inah: “Hih mipa pen na gamh luah ding hi lo ding a, ahi zongin nang pumpi teekteek panin a piang tapa khat pen na gamh luah hi ding hi,” a ci hi.
Amah in a pualamah paipih a, “Vantungte en inla, na sim zawh taktak leh aksite sim in,” a ci hi. Tua ciang in Amah in, “Hihte pen na suanlekhak’ neihsa suak ding hi,” a ci hi.
Abram in Yahweh um a, tua upna pen Yahweh in diktatna-in a sang hi.
Tua ciangin Amah in ama kiangah, “Hih leitang na neih nadingin nangma tungah hong pia dingin Chaldees gam Ur khua panin nang hong paikhiatpih pen Keimah Yahweh ka hi hi.
Amah in, “Pa Yahweh aw, keimah in tua leitang ka neih ding bangci theih ding ka hi hiam?” a ci hi.
Tua ahih ciangin Yahweh in ama kiangah, “Bawngla no khat, keel khat, leh tuutal khat, kum thum ciat a pha hi ding a, vakhu khat leh gam vakhu khang lai khat Kei kiangah hong paipih in,” a ci hi.

Tua ahih manin Abram in Ama kiangah hihte khempeuh a paipih hi. Abram in tuate phelnih ciat suahin, phel khat pen a phel dang khat tungah a koih ciat hi. A hih hangin vasate ahihleh amah in phelnih suah lo hi.
Tua khit ciangin sasialne vasate tua sate tungah hong tu suk a, ahih hangin Abram in tuate a hawlkhia hi.
Ni hong tum suk tawh kizui-in Abram a ihmut nak suah mahmah a, a lauhuai khuamial sahpi ama’ tungah hong tung hi.

Tua khit ciangin Amah in Abram kiangah, “Na suanlekhakte amau’ leitang lo mun ah tawlkhat sung khualmi hi ding uh a, tua lai-ah amaute sila hi ding uh a, amaute kum zali sung haksatna thuak ding ahihna thu teltakin thei in.
Ahi zongin a sila sepna minamte tungah thu Ka khen ding a, tua nung ciangin neihsa tampi tawh amaute paikhia ding uh hi.
Tu-in nang na hihleh, nuamtakin na pu na pate’ kiangah na zuan ding a, khan kicingsa-in nang pen hong kivui ding hi.
Ahih hangin khang lina ciangin hih lai mun ah amaute hong paikik ding uh hi. Bang hang hiam cihleh Amor mite mawhna pen a kiciangtanna zah tung nai lo hi.
Ni tumin khua a mial ciangin, meikhu bel tawh a kuang meivak khat kilang a, athemnengte kikalah a pai hi.
Tua ni-in Yahweh in Abram tawh thuciamna khat bawl a, a gen inah: “Na suanlekhakte tungah hih leitang ahi: Egypt gun panin alian Euphrates gun ciang dong,
Ken mite, Kenez mite, leh Kadmon mite,
Hit mite, Periz mite, leh Rephai mite,
Amor mite, Canaan mite, Girgash mite, leh Yebus mite leitang dong ka pia khin ta hi,” a ci hi.
Tu-in Abram zi Sarai in ta nei lo hi. Ahih hangin amah in Hagar kici Egypt mi nasem numei khat nei hi.

Tua ahih manin Sarai in Abram kiangah, “En in, Yahweh in ka ta neih ding hong khaktan hi. Hehpihna tawh ka nasemnu kiangah pai in, tua hileh tua nu’ hangin ta ka ngah kha thei ding hi,” a ci hi. Tua ciangin Abram in Sarai’ genna a mang hi.
Tua ciangin, Canaan leitang ah a teen zawh kum sawm a phak khit ciangin Abram’ zi Sarai in Egypt mi a nasem nu Hagar sam a, a pasal Abram tungah a zi dingin a pia hi.
Tua ahih manin amah Hagar kiangah pai a, amah gai hi. Hagar in amah a gai khit lam a theih ciangin amah a nei Sarai simmawh bawl hi.

Tua ciangin Sarai in Abram kiangah, “Kei tungah hong kikhial khin hi! Keitunga hong khialhsa hih numei na puahphat ding pen nang tavuan hi. Ka nasem nu na khut sungah kong pia a, amah a gai khit lam a kitheih ciangin kei hong simmawh bawl hi. Nang leh kei kikalah Yahweh in thu hong khen tahen,” a ci hi.

Tua ahih ciangin Abram in Sarai kiangah, “Na nasem nu nang khut sungah om hi, thukham tawh kizui-in na theih bangin ama tungah hih in. Tua ciangin Sarai in Hagar khialhna a langdo dingin teci sam hi. Tua ahih manin Sarai omna panin amah a taikhia hi.
Tua ciangin Yahweh’ vantungmi in sehnel gam a tuinak gei khat ah Hagar mu a, tua pen Shur paina lampi gei-a tuinak ahi hi.
Amah in, “Sarai sila Hagar aw, koi panin hong pai na hi a, koi mun ah pai ding na hi hiam?” a ci hi. Hagar in, “Ka pi Sarai omna panin a taimang ka hi hi,” a ci hi.
Tua ahih ciangin Yahweh’ vantungmi in ama kiangah, “Na pi kiangah ciahkik inla, ama’ khut sungah nanglenang kipia in,” a ci hi.
Tua khit ciangin Yahweh’ vantungmi in ama kiangah, “Keimah in na suanlekhakte tampitakin ka khangsak ding a, tua hileh amaute a phakzah kisim zolo ding hi,” a ci hi.

Yahweh’ vantungmi in ama kiangah, “En in, nang pen naupaii na hi a, tapa khat na nei ding hi. Ama min pen Ishmayl na ci ding hi. Bang hang hiam cihleh Yahweh in nangma thuakna hong za khin zo hi,” a ci hi.
Amah pen a zuallo gamsa bang hi ding a, ama khut in mi khempeuh langpanin, mi khempeuh khut in amah langpan ding hi. Amah pen ama sanggamte omna mun ah teeng ding hi.
Tua ciangin Hagar in amah a hopih Yahweh Min lo a, “Nang pen amu thei Yahweh na hi hi,” a ci hi. Bang hang hiam cihleh amah in, “Kei hong mu Pa keimah in mukhin hilo ka hi hiam?” a ci hi.
Tua ahih ciangin tua tuikhuk pen Beer Lahai Roi kici hi. Tua pen Kadesh leh Bered kikalah tudong om lai hi.
Tua ahih ciangin Hagar in Abram tawh tapa khat nei a, Abram in Hagar sung pana suak ama tapa pen Ishmayl ci-in min a phuak hi.
Hagar in Abram tawh a neih Ishmayl a suah-in Abram kum 86 a phata hi.
Abram kum 99 a phak ciangin, Yahweh Abram tungah kilang a, ama kiangah, “Kei pen Vanglian Yahweh ka hi a, Keima ngeinate zui inla, paubaang kei in.
Kei leh nang kikalah Keima thuciamna ka bawl ding a, nang tampitak Kong phasak ding hi,” a ci hi.
Tua ciangin Abram mai kunsuk a, amah tawh Yahweh kiho-in, a gen inah:
“Kei ka hihleh, En in, Ka thuciamna pen nang tawh om a, nang pen minam tampite’ pa na hi ding hi.
Na min pen Abram hong kici nawn lo ding a, nang min pen Abraham hi ding hi. Bang hang hiam cihleh minam tampite’ pa khat dingin Keimah in nang kong bawl khin hi.
Keimah in nang pen a cipha mahmah-in kong bawl ding a, nang sung panin minamte ka piangsak ding a, nang sung panin kumpite hong piangkhia ding hi.

Nang leh nang’ khit cianga na suanlekhakte tungah Pa hihna dingin, hong piang ding suanlekhakte khempeuh aa dingin khang tawntung thuciamna bangin Kei leh nang, leh nang’ khit cianga na suanlekhakte kikalah Ka thuciamna Ka kipsak ding hi.
Nangma tung leh nang’ khit cianga na suanlekhakte tungah khualmi bangin na omna leitang ahi Canaan leitang khempeuh na neih tawntung dingun Kong pia a, Kei pen amaute Pa ahi ding hi,” a ci hi.
Yahweh in Abraham kiangah, “Nang na hihleh, nang leh nang’ khit-a na suanlekhakte in khangkhat khit khangkhat Ka thuciamna na zui pelmawh ding uh hi.
Hih pen Kei leh nang leh nang’ khit-a na suanlekhakte kikalah na zuih dinguh Ka thuciamna ahi hi: note laka pasal peuhmah a vun ki-at ding hi.
Note’ vun dawn na at dinguh a, tua pen Kei leh note kikal-a thuciamna lim hi ding hi.

Note sung pan hong piang ding na tuletate lak panin ni giat a pha peuhmah vun ki-at ding a, na innkuan sunguh panin a suakte, gamdang panin sum tawh na lei khatpeuh, leh note’ laizom ahi lote na ngawn zong kihel ding hi.
Note’ innkuan sung panin suak ahi a, na sum uh tawh na lei uh ahi zongin, amaute vun ki-at pelmawh ding hi. Note’ satak tung a Keima thuciamna pen tawntung thuciamna ahi ding hi.
Satak tunga vun-atna a nei lo vun ki-at lo pasal peuhmah, ama mipihte kiang panin beimangsak ding hi. Bang hang hiam cihleh amah in Ka thuciamna palsat khin hi,” a ci hi.
Tua khit ciangin Yahweh in Abraham kiangah, “Na zi Sarai ahi leh, a min Sarai-in na sam kei ding a, Sarah pen ama min hi ding hi.

Amah thupha Ka pia ding a, amah tawh tapa khat nang Kong pia taktak ding hi. Tua ciangin amah thupha Ka pia ding a, amah pen minamte’ nu hi ding a, mihingte’ kumpite ama sung panin hong piangkhia ding hi,” a ci hi.
Tua ciangin Abraham mai kunsuk hi. Amah nui-in, a lungsim sungah, “Kum 100 a pha mi khat in tapa nei ding ahi hiam? Kum 90 a pha Sarah in tapa ngah zo ding ahi hiam?” a ci hi.
Abraham in Yahweh kiangah, “Yahweh aw Ishmayl mu-in hong sansak peuh lecin,” a ci hi.

Tua ciangin Yahweh in, “Hi hi! Ishmayl ka mu hi! Ahih hangin na zi Sarah in nang tawh tapa khat ngah ding a, nang in ama min Isaac na phuak ding hi. Tawntung thuciamna dingin Ka thuciamna amah leh ama khit cianga suanlekhakte tawh Ka kipsak ding hi.

Ishmayl aa dingin nong ngetna Ka za khin hi. En in, amah thupha Ka pia ding a, amah Ka ciphasak ding a, amah nakpitakin Ka khangsak ding hi. Amah pen ukpi sawm le nihte pa hi ding a, amah minam lianin Ka bawl ding hi.
Ahih hangin Ka thuciamna pen maikum tuhun a nang aa dingin Sarah in a neih ding Isaac tawh Ka kipsak hi,” a ci hi.
Amah Abraham tawh a kiho khit ciangin, ama kiang panin Yahweh paikhia to hi.

Tua ahih ciangin Abraham in ama tapa Ishmayl, ama inn sunga suak khempeuh, leh ama sum tawh a lei khempeuh, Abraham’ inn a mihing pasal khempeuh samin, Yahweh in amah thu a piaksa bang teekteekin, tua ni mahmahin amaute’ vun dawn satak a atsak hi.
Ama vun dawn a ki-atin Abraham kum 99 kua a pha hi.
Ama tapa Ishmayl vun dawn a ki-atin Ishmayl kum 13 a pha hi.
Tua ni mahmahin Abraham leh ama tapa Ishmayl vun ki-at hi.
Ama inn a pasal khempeuh, a inn sung suak khempeuh leh midang’ khat peuh kiang panin sum tawh a lei peuhmah, amah tawh a vun uh ki-at khawm hi.

headings.text: Sodom Khua aa ding Abraham Thuumna

verses.text: Sun khualum ni khat, a puanbuk lutna ah a tut laitakin, Mamre singkungte gei panin ama tungah Yahweh kilang hi.
Tua ahih ciangin Abraham khuadakto a, a nai-ah mithum a ding a mu hi. Amah in amaute a muh ciangin, amaute a mu dingin puanbuk kongkhak panin amah tai a, leilak lamah a kunsuk hi.
Amah in, “ka ukpite aw, note mit ah maipha ka muh leh na nasempa hong paisan kei un.
Tui tawmkhat lasakin, na khete uh sil-in, singkung nuai-ah hehpihna tawh tawlnga hoh un.

Tu-in na nasempa kiangah hong tungkhin na hih buangun, thathak na ngahkik nadingun an pawlkhat ka va la ding a, tua khit ciangin na pai nading vuah na paisuak pan un,” a ci hi. Tua ciangin amaute in, “Na cih bangin hih in,” a ci hi.
Tua ahih manin puanbuk sunga Sarah kiangah Abraham nawh pai mengmeng a, “Annel hoihte lawh thum mekin anlum hong em mengmeng pak in,” a ci hi.
Bawnghon lakah Abraham tai a, bawngno a dawng a hoih khat la a, manlang taka a na bawlpah khanglai pasal khat kiangah a pia hi.
Tua khit ciangin amah in bawngnawi-thaukhal, bawngnawi, leh a minsa bawngsa la-in amaute mai-ah a lui hi. Amaute in a nek laitakun, singkung nuai amaute gei-ah amah a ding hi.
Tua ciangin amaute in, “Na zi Sarah koi-ah om hiam,” a ci hi. Amah in, “Hih teng mun, puanbuk sungah om hi,” a ci hi.

Tua ciangin Amah in, “Nausuah hun tawh kizui-in nang kiangah kong paikik taktak ding a, ngai in, na zi Sarah in tapa khat nei ding hi,” a ci hi. Ama nunga om puanbuk kongkhak sung panin Sarah in na za hi.
Tu-in Abraham leh Sarah pen teek ta uh a, a kum uh ham ta a, Sarah zong a numei ngeina teng tawpta hi.
Tua ahih manin Sarah amahmah nui-in, “Kei ka teek khit nungah tua bang hi thei nawn ding ahi hiam, ka pasal zong teek ta hi,” a ci hi.
Yahweh in Abraham kiangah, “Sarah bang hangin nui-in, ‘ka teek khit nungah tapa khat nei takpi ding ka hi hiam?’ ci ahi hiam?
Na khat peuhpeuh Yahweh aa dingin haksa lua ahi hiam? Maikum khuakhal hun ciangin nangma kiangah kong paikik ding a, Sarah in tapa khat a nei ding hi.
Tua pen Sarah in nial a, amah lau ahih manin a gen inah: “Ka nui kei hi,” a ci hi. Tua ciangin Amah in, “Hilo hi, na nui hi,” a ci hi.
Tua khit ciangin tuamun panin mite dingkhia a, Sodom lam a en uh hi. Amau pai nading lampi ah a kha dingin Abraham in amaute a zui hi.
Yahweh in, “tu mahmah a Ka hih ding thu Abraham tungah im ding Ka hi hiam?;
a hangin Abraham pen a lian leh a thahat minam piang taktak ding a, leitung minamte khempeuh in ama sungah thupha kipia ding hi,” a ci hi.

Bang hang hiam cihleh amah Ka teel khin a, tua ahih manin ama mite leh ama nung a a innkuanpihte in thuman leh thutanga a gamtatna tawh Yahweh ngeina a zuih nadingun amah in sawl ding hi. Tua hileh Yahweh in Abraham aa dingin Amah in a ciamsa thu a tangtungsak ding hi.
Yahweh in, “Sodom leh Gomorrah-te langa kikona lian ahih manin, leh amaute mawhna pen thuakhak lua mahmah ahih manin,
Tu-in Keimah ka paisuk ding a, Kei’ tungah hong tung, amaute langa kikona bangin amaute gamta khin uh hiam? Tua bang ahih kei leh Ka thei ding hi.
Tua ciangin tua panin mite kihei-in, Sodom lamah pai uh a, ahih hangin Abraham pen Yahweh mai-ah a ding lai hi.
Abraham neh phei-in, a gen inah: “Thuman mite, migilote tawh zong susia khawm ding na hi hiam?
Tua khuapi sungah thuman mi 50 bang om leh, tua sunga om thuman mi 50-te hangin hunpia lai loin, tua mun susia veve ding na hi hiam?

Migilote tawh thuman mite a that ding, hih bangin a gamta Nang na hi hetkei hi. Tua bang hileh thuman mite pen migilote mah bang ding a, nang pen tuabang na hi hetkei hi! Leitung khempeuh Thukhenpa in a manin sem lo ding ahi hiam?” a ci hi.
Yahweh in, “Sodom khuapi sungah thuman mi 50 ka muh leh, amaute hangin tua mun buppi bangmah ka cih kei ding hi,” a ci hi.
Tua ciangin Abraham in thu gen leuleu a, “Leivui leh vut bang ahi lel keimah in Yahweh tungah thu kong gen ngamna hong maisak in.
Thuman mi 50 sung panin nga om kei leh, tua nga om lohna manin khuapi buppi na susia veve ding hiam?” a ci hi. Amah in, “Tua sungah 45 ka muh nakleh ka susia kei ding hi,” a ci hi.
Tua khit ciangin Abraham in Ama kiangah thu gen leuleu a, “Tua sungah 40 bek kimu leh e?” a ci hi. Amah in, “40-te hangin tua Ka hih kei ding hi,” a ci hi.
Abraham in, “Yahweh aw hong heh kei in, kong gen lailai ding hi. Tua lai-ah 30 bang a kimu leh e?” a ci hi. Amah in, “Tua lai-ah 30 a kimuh leh Ka hih kei ding hi,” a ci hi.
Abraham in, “Tu-in Yahweh kong gen ngam lailai a, “Tua mun ah 20 bek kimu leh e?” a ci hi. Amah in, “20-te hangin tua Ka susia kei ding hi,” a ci hi.
Amah in, “Yahweh aw hong heh kei in, khat vei bekbek kong gen lai ding hi. Sawm bekbek kimu leh e?” a ci hi. Amah in, “Sawmte hangin tua Ka susia kei ding hi.
Tua ahih ciangin Abraham tawh a kiho khit phetin Ama pai nading ah Yahweh pai a, Abraham zong ama omna mun ah a ciahkik hi.
Nitakin Sodom ah vantungmi nih hong tung a, Sodom khua kulhkongpi ah Lot na tu hi. Lot in amaute a muh ciangin, amaute dawn dingin a ding hi. Leilak lamah maingatin amah a kun hi.

Amah in, “Tu-in hih teng ah, ka ukpite aw, na nasempa’ inn lamah hong kihei unla, zan hong tamin, na khete uh sil phot un. Tua ciangin zingsangin tho baihin na pai nading lam uh ah pai pah un,” a ci hi. Amaute in, “Hilo hi, kote khua sung munawngna ah ka giak ding uh hi,” a ci hi.
Ahih hangin amah in nakpitakin kun ahih manin ama lamah kihei uh a, ama inn ah a lut uh hi. Tua ciangin amah in amaute aa dingin pawl khat bawl a, silngo sawh loh anlum emsak a, amaute in a ne uh hi.
Amaute a lup ma-in Sodom khua mite, a moi a ham, a vengveng panin mi khempeuh in a inn umcih uh a,
amaute in Lot sam uh a, ama kiangah, “Tu nitakin nang kiangah hong pai mite koi-ah om ahi hiam? Kote’ pumpi lunggulhna bangin ka luppih theih nadingin kote kiangah hong paipih in,” a ci hi.
Tua ahih ciangin kongkhak panin amaute kiangah Lot hong paikhia a, ama nung a kong lehkhak a,
a gen inah: “Ka sanggamte aw, gitloh gamtat kei un!

En un, pasal tawh a lumkhawm nai lo tanu nih ka nei a, note kiangah amaute kong paikhiatpih ding a, note lunggulhna bangin amaute tungah gamta un. Ka inn beelin hih mite hong pai khin ahih nungsang amaute’ tungah bangmah gamta kei bek un,” a ci hi.

Amaute in, “Ka mai panun paikhia in!” a ci uh hi. Tua ciangin amaute in, “Hih pa hih teng ah hong pai-in, eite thukhen bangin hong laam dihdih hi. Tu-in amaute sangin nang kong siatbawl zaw ding uh hi,” a ci uh hi. Tua ahih ciangin amaute in Lot lamah nakpitakin neh uh a, kongkhak a kisia zah dong dingin hong neh uh hi.
Ahih hangin mi nihte in amau’ khut hong zanin innsung amau’ kiangah Lot kai-in, kong a khak uh hi.
Inn kongkhak ah a om mi a neu a lian, amaute in a mit uh tawsak uh hi. Tua ahih ciangin amaute in kongkhak a mu thei nawn kei uh hi.
Tua ciangin mi nihte in Lot kiangah, “Hih lai-ah tanau dang na nei lai hiam? Makte, na tapate, na tanute, khua sunga nang’ mi peuhmah hih mun panin amaute paikhiatpih in!
Bang hang hiam cihleh Yahweh mai-ah hih mite a kimawhsakna thu lian mahmah khin a, hih mun susia dingin Yahweh in kote hong sawl khin ahih manin kote in hih mun ka susia ding hi,” a ci hi.

Tua ahih manin Lot taikhia a, ama tanute tawh kitenna letmat a thuh khin ama mak dingte tungah gen a, “Tho un, hih mun panin paikhia un. Bang hang hiam cihleh Yahweh in hih khuapi susia ding hi,” a ci hi. Ahih hangin a mak dingte tungah amah pen ciamnuih bawl a bang lel hi.

Zingsang khua a vak ciangin, vantungmite in Lot a kinawh mahmah nadingin sawl tentan a, “Tho un, na zi leh hih tak a na tanute nih sam in, tua hi kei leh khuapi suksiatna sungah na kangtum kha ding hi.
Amah zekai-in a om laitakin, Yahweh in amah hehpih ahih manin, mite in ama khut, a zi khut, leh a tanu nihte khut lenin paipih a, amaute in amah paikhiatpih a, khua pualamah amah a koih hi.

Tua ahih manin hi bang thu hong piang a, amaute a paikhiatpih khit hun hong tun ciangin, Na nuntak nadingun tai un! Nunghei kei unla, leitamzang mun khat peuhpeuh ah zong khawl kei un. Mual tungah tai to un, tua hi keileh note hong kisusia kha ding hi!” a ci hi.
Tua ciangin Lot in amaute kiangah, “Hilo hi, ka lawmte aw!

Tu taktakin, note’ muhna ah na nasempa in maipha ngah khin a, ka nuntakna nong hutna uh ah hehpihna lianpi kei tungah nong lak khin uh hi. Ahih hangin mualtung lamah tai zawhlohna khat ahih keileh siatna khatpeuh in kei hong pha leh ka si ding hi.
Tu-in en in hih khuapi pen tai nadingin nai-in, khuapi neu khat ahi hi. Tua mun ah hong taisak un – khuapi neu khat hilo ahi hiam? Tua hileh ka kha nungta thei kha ding hi,” a ci hi.
Amah in ama kiangah, “En in, na gensa khuapi ka lumlet loh nading, hih tawh kisai zong na thu kong mang hi.
Tua mun na tun matengun ken bangmah sem thei lo ka hih manin, manlang unla, tua lai-ah tai un,” a ci hi. Tua ahih ciangin tua khuapi min pen Zoar kici hi.
Zoar ah Lot a tun ciangin leitung ah ni suak khin deuh hi.
Yahweh in Sodom leh Gomorrah khuate tungah kaat leh meikuang zusuksak hi. Vantung panin Yahweh in hihte zangin,
Tua khuapite, leitamzang khempeuh, tua khuapi sunga a nungta khempeuh leh lei panin a piang khempeuh kinuaizan hi.
Ahih hangin amaute nung a a nusiat pasiante (elohim) Lot’ zi in lakkik ding hanciam a, amah pen mawhna sila a suak hi.
Yahweh mai-a a dinnasa mun ah zingsang tungin Abraham va pai hi.
Tua khit ciangin Sodom leh Gomorrah, leh leitamzang mun khempeuh lam nga-in khuadak a, leitang khu pen meiphualpi khu bangin a kahto a mu hi.

Tua ciangin hici bangin hong piang a, Yahweh in leitamzang khuapi a suksiat hun ciangin Yahweh in Abraham phawk a, Lot’ tenna khuapite Amah in a nuaizan ciangin, suksiatna laizang panin Amah in Lot sawlkhia hi.
Tua ciangin Zoar ah a teng ding Lot lau ahih manin Zoar panin amah paikhia to-in a tanu nihte tawh mual tungah a teng hi. Amah leh ama tanu nihte kuahawm sung khat ah a teng uh hi.
A u nu pen in a nauzaw kiangah, “I pa teek ta a, leitung bup ngeina bangin leitung ah eite hong luppih ding pasal omlo hi.
Hong pai in, i pa leenggahzu khamsak ni, i pa’ suanlekhak i keptoh theih nadingin amah tawh eite lum khawm ni,” a ci hi.
Tua ahih manin tua nitakin amaute in a pa uh leenggahzu khamsak hi. A u nu pai-in, a pa tawh a lum khawm hi. Amah a lup lam hitaleh, a thawhkhiat lam hitaleh a pa in thei lo hi.

A zingciangin a u nu in a nauzaw kiangah, “En in, zan nitakin ka pa tawh ka lum khawm hi. Tu nitakin zong amah leenggahzu khamsak ni. Nang pai inla amah tawh lum in, tua hileh i pa suanlekhak i kemto thei ding hi,” a ci hi.
Tua ahih ciangin amaute in tua nitakin zong a pa uh leenggahzu khamsak uh hi. A nauzaw nu zong tho-in, a pa tawh lum a, ama lup lam hitaleh a thawhkhiat lam hitaleh a pa in thei lo hi.
Tua ahih ciangin Lot tanu tegel in a pa tawh naupaii uh hi.
A u in tapa khat nei-in a min Moab phuak a, amah pen tu ni donga om Moab mite’ pianna pupi ahi hi.
A nauzaw, amah in zong tapa khat nei-in a min Ben-Ammi a phuak a, amah pen tu ni donga om Ammon mite pianna pupi ahi hi.
Mamre panin Negev gam ah Abraham pai-a, Kadesh leh Shur kikalah a teng hi. Tu-in Gerar-ah tawmvei sung teng a,
tua panin Abraham in a zi Sarah pen, “Amah pen ka sanggamnu hi. Gerar kumpipa Abimelech in mi sawlin Sarah samsak hi.
Ahih hangin nitakin Abimelech’ mang sungah Yahweh pai a, a gen inah: “En in, tua na lak numei hangin nang pen a si ding na hi ta hi. Bang hang hiam cihleh amah pen mi khat’ zi ahi hi,” a ci hi.
Ahih hangin Abimelech in amah zuan nai lo a, Abimelech in Ama kiangah, “Nangmah in a thuman minam zong that ding na hi hiam?

Abraham in kei kiangah, ‘Amah pen ka sanggamnu hi,’ ci hi lo ahi hiam? Tuanu mahmah in zong, ‘Abraham pen ka sanggampa hi,’ ci hi lo ahi hiam? Tua ahih manin lungsim kisuang hetloin leh khutkhial kisa hetloin, hih bangin a gamta ka hi hi,” a ci hi.

Yahweh in a mang sung ama kiangah, “Himah hi, lungsim kisuang hetloin hi bangin na gamtatna thu thei Ka hih manin Kei kiang panin na mawh khak loh nadingin nang Kong kem hi. Tua ahih ciangin tuanu nang Kong sukhasak kei hi.

Tua ahih ciangin tu-in, mipa’ zi piakik in. Bang hang hiam cihleh amah pen kamsang khat hi a, amah in nang aa dingin thu hong ngetsak ding a, nang na hing ding hi. Ahi zongin nangmah in tuanu na piakkik keileh, nang leh na neih khempeuh a sih taktak ding lam thei in,” a ci hi.
Tua ahih ciangin zingsangin Abimelech thobaih a, ama uliante khempeuh samin, amaute zakin hih thu khempeuh a gen a, amaute nak lau mahmah uh hi.

Tua ciangin Abimelech in Abraham sam a, ama kiangah, “Kote tungah hong bang ci gamtat na hi hiam? Kei leh ka kumpi gam sungah khialhna lianpi khat nong tut nadingin, kote in nang hong langdo ka hi uh hiam? Hih ding kilawm lo nate na gamta khin hi,” a ci hi. 10 Tua khit ciangin Abimelech in Abraham kiangah, “Hih bangin na gamtatna pen bang na deihna ahi hiam?” a ci hi.
Abraham in, “Hih mun ah Yahweh zahtakna om lo taktak a, ka zi’ hangin amaute in kei hong that ding hi ci-in ka ngaihsut khak man ahi hi.
Ahih hangin en in, amah pen ka sanggamnu taktak ahi hi. Amah pen ka pa’ tanu hi a, ahih hangin ka nu’ tanu hi lo hi. Tua khitah amah pen ka zi hong hi hi.

Ka pa’ innkuanpih sung panin Yahweh in kei hong paikhiatsak ciangin, keimah in ama kiangah, “Hih pen nong itna nong lahna-in, i paina mun khempeuh ah kei pen, ‘Amah pen ka sanggampa hi,’ hong ci in,” ka ci hi,” a ci hi.
Tua ciangin Abimelech in tuuhon, bawngtalte, nasem numei leh pasal-te la-in, tuate Abraham tungah pia a, ama tungah a zi Sarah zong a piakik hi.
Abimelech in, “En in, na mai-ah ka leitang om hi. Na utna mun peuhpeuh ah teng in.

Tua khit ciangin Sarah kiangah amah in, “En in, na sanggampa nguntang tul khat ka piakhin a, nang tawh a om khempeuh leh a dang khempeuh’ mai panin nang hong kilangdo na pen hih ngunte in hong cin zo taktak hi. Tua ahih manin tu-in na kisuan nading bangmah omlo taktak hi,” a ci hi.
Tua ahih ciangin Abraham in Yahweh kiangah thungen a, Abimelech, ama zi, leh ama nasem numeite a damsak hi. Tua ciangin amaute in ta nei thei uh hi.
Bang hang hiam cihleh Abraham’ zi Sarah hangin Abimelech inn-a naubu khempeuh Yahweh in khakcipsak khin hi.
Yahweh in a gensa bangin, Amah in Sarah tungah a itna lianpi a lak hi. Yahweh in a ciamsa bangin Sarah aa dingin Amah in sem hi.
Sarah gai a, Yahweh in a ciamsa hun teekteek mahin a teek zawhin Abraham in amah tawh tapa khat a nei hi.
Abraham in Sarah tawh a neih ama’ tapa min pen Isaac a phuak hi.
Yahweh in a thupiaksa bangin, Isaac ni giat a phak ciangin, Abraham in ama tapa Isaac vun a at hi.
Ama tapa Isaac a suah ciangin, Abraham kum 100 phata hi.
Sarah in, “Yahweh kei hong nui sak ta a, tua a za mi khempeuh in kei hong nuihpih ding uh hi,” a ci hi.
Amah in gen beh lai a, “Sarah in naucing ding ci-in kua in Abraham’ tungah gen ngei ding ahi hiam? Ahi zongin ama teek zawh in amah tawh tapa khat ka nei hi,” a ci hi.
Tua ciangin naupang hong khang a, nawi tawh hong kikhen ta hi. Isaac nawi tawh a kikhen ni-in Abraham in pawi lianpi khat bawl hi.
Abraham in Hagar tawh a neih Egypt mi Hagar tapa Ishmayl in zahpih-in a ciamnuih bawlna Sarah in a mu hi.
Tua ahih ciangin amah in Abraham kiangah gen a, “Hih sal-numei leh a tapa lawnkhia in. Bang hang hiam cihleh hih sal-numei’ tapa in ka tapa Isaac tawh gamh luahkhawm thei lo ding uh hi,” a ci hi.
Ama tapa’ hangin Abraham muhna panin hih thu pen lunggim huai mahmah hi.

Ahih hangin Yahweh in Abraham kiangah, “Naupangpa hang ahi a, na sal-numei hang ahi zongin na muhna panin lunggim huaisa kei in. Sarah in nang kiangah hong gen bangbangin ama cihna mang in. Bang hang hiam cihleh Isaac sung panin na tuleta kici ding hi,” a ci hi.
Ahi zongin sal-numei’ tapa zong nangma tuleta mah ahih manin amah zong minam khat mahin Ka bawl ding hi.

Tua ahih manin zingsangin Abraham tho baih a, anluum leh savun tuithawl khat la-in, Hagar liangko tungah tuate suanin, amah in Hagar kiangah tuate leh naupangpa pia a, Abraham in a sawl khia hi. Tua ciangin Hagar gamlapi ah pai a, Beersheba gamlak sehnel gam ah a pai kawikawi hi.
Savun sunga tui kidawn khin a, sawlbawk khat nuai-ah amah in naupangpa a koih hi.

Tua ciangin naupangpa mun panin thallot khat tan khawng kigamlatna mun ah amah pai-in a tusuk hi. Bang hang hiam cihleh amah leh amah in gen a, “Naupangpa sihna hong musak kei in,” a ci hi. Tua ahih ciangin Hagar a nai-ah tuphei-in, amah nakpitakin a kap hi.

Yahweh in naupangpa’ aw za hi. Tua khit ciangin vantung panin Yahweh’ vantungmi in Hagar sam a, ama kiangah a gen inah: “Bang thu om ahi hiam? Lau kei in, bang hang hiam cihleh naupang a omna mun ah a awging Yahweh in za khin hi.
Ding inla, naupangpa domto inla na khut tawh lenkip in. Bang hang hiam cihleh minam lianin amah Ka bawl ding hi,” a ci hi.
Yahweh in Hagar’ mit hong a, amah in tuikhuk khat a mu hi. Tua ciangin amah pai a, savun tuithawl sungah tui dimin, naupangpa tui a dawnsak hi.
Tua ahih manin Yahweh in naupangpa ompih a, amah hong khangin, gamlak sehnel gam ah tengin, thalkap siam khat hong suak hi.
Paran gamlakah amah teng hi. A nu in Egypt gam panin ama aa ding zi khat laksak hi.
Tua hun lai-in hi bang thu hong om a, Abimelech leh ama galkap mangpa Phichol in Abraham kiangah, “Na sepna khempeuh ah Vanglian Khat in nang hong ompih hi.

Tua ahih ciangin tu-in kei tawh hitaleh, ka tuletate tawh hitaleh, ka suanlekhakte tawh hitaleh tungah a man lopi-in hong bawl loin, nang tungah thuman tak tawh kong gamtat bangin keima tung leh na tennasa leitang tungah nong gamtat nadingin Amah tawh kei tungah hong kiciam in,” a ci hi.
Abraham in, “Ka kiciam hi,” a ci hi.
Tua ciangin Abimelech’ nasemte in a mat tuikhuk khat hangin Abraham in Abimelech a mawhsak hi.
Abimelech in, “Kua in hih hiam cih ka thei kei hi. Nang nong gen kei a, tu ni dongin tua thu zong ka za kei hi,” a ci hi.
Tua ahih manin tuuhon leh bawnglate Abraham in la a, Abimelech tungah tuate pia a, amaute nih in kithukimna khat a bawl uh hi.
Abraham in ganhon sung panin tuuno anu sagih tuam koih hi.
Tua ciangin Abimelech in Abraham kiangah, “Hih na koihtuam tuuno anu sagihte bang a cihnopna ahi hiam?” a ci hi.
Tua ciangin amah in, “Keimah in hih tuikhuk ka tawhna thu ah nang in keima aa dingin teci na hih theih nadingin nangmah in ka khut panin hih tuuno anu sagihte nong sang ding hi,” a ci hi.
Tua ahih ciangin tua mun pen amah in Beersheba (Kiciamna Tuikhuk ahikeileh Sagihte’ Tuikhuk) a ci hi. Bang hang hiam cihleh amau tenih in tua mun ah thu a kiciam uh hi.
Tua ahih ciangin Beersheba-ah amaute in kithukimna khat a bawl uh hi. Tua ahih manin Abimelech leh a galkap mangpa Phichol, amaute Philistines gam ah a ciahkik uh hi.
Hotkhiatna ngah theih nading lampi ahi Yahweh thukhamte a zui mihon khat Abraham in Beersheba ah a kipsak hi. Tua mun min pen a nungta tawntung Pa, Yahweh min a tapsak hi.
Philistines gam sungah Abraham sauveipi a taam hi.
Hih thute khit ciangin hici bangin hong hi a, Yahweh in Abraham ze-et ding hong kipan a, ama kiangah, “Abraham!” a ci hi. Amah in, “Hiah ka om hi,” a ci hi.

Tua ciangin Amah in, “Na it, na tapa neihsun ahi Isaac la-in, Moriyah gam ah pai inla, Kong gen ding mual-te’ tung khat ah meihal biakpiakna bangin tua lai mun ah amah biakpiakna-in zang in,” a ci hi.

Tua ahih ciangin zingsangin Abraham thobaih a, a la tutphah vawh-in, ama tapa Isaac leh amah tawh ama nasem tangval nihte sam a, amah in meihal biakpiak nadingin sing ek a, amah tho-in, ama tungah Yahweh’ gensa mun ah a pai hi.
A ni thum ni ciangin, Abraham khuadak to-in a gamla-ah tua mun a mu hi.
Abraham in ama nasem tangvalte kiangah, “La tawh hi teng ah na om un,” a ci hi. Kei leh tangvalpa hua lamah pai-in biakpiakna ka va nei ding uh a, note kiangah kong kilehkik ding uh hi,” a ci hi.
Tua ahih manin Abraham in meihal biak nading sing la-in, ama tapa Isaac tungah a suan hi. Amah in a khut sungah mei leh temta a tawi a, amau tegel paikhawm uh hi.

Tua ciangin Isaac in ama’ pa Abraham kiangah, “Ka pa aw,” a ci hi. Amah in, “Hiah ka om hi, ka ta,” a ci hi. Tua ciangin amah in, “Keimah in mei leh sing ka mu a, ahih hangin meihal biakpiak nading tuuno koi-ah om ahi hiam?” a ci hi.
Abraham in, “Ka ta aw, Yahweh in meihal biakpiak nadingin ama aa ding tuuno hong pia ding hi,” a ci hi. Tua bangin amaute a nihun ton khawm uh hi.

Tua ciangin Yahweh in a gensana mun ah amaute tung uh hi. Tua mun ah Abraham in biaknatau khat lam a, a ngeina ding bangin sing koih hi. Amah in a tapa Isaac hencip-in biaknatau tunga sing tungah a koih hi.
Abraham in a tapa a that nading temta la dingin a khut zankhia hi.
Ahih hangin vantung panin Yahweh’ vantungmi in amah sam a, “Abraham, Abraham!” a ci hi. Amah in, “Hiah ka om hi,” a ci hi.
Amah in, “Tangvalpa tungah khutkhial kei inla, zong sukha vet kei in. Bang hang hiam cihleh Yahweh na zahtakna ka mu a, na tapa khat neihsun keima aa dingin na humcip lohna ka mu hi,” a ci hi.

Tua ciangin Abraham khuadak kawikawi a, sawlbawk ziingmema lakah a ki-a a awk tuutal khat a nunga om, a mu hi. Tua ahih manin Abraham pai-in tua tuutal la-a, a tapa’ tangin meihal biakna biakpiakna-in a nei hi.
Abraham in tua mun pen, “Yahweh Yireh (Yahweh in hong sik hi),” ci-in min phuak a, tu ni dongin, “Yahweh’ mual tungah hong kisik hi,” a kici lai hi.
Tua ciangin vantung panin Yahweh’ vantungmi in Abraham a nih veina sam a,
a gen inah: “Kei mahmah ka kiciam hi, Yahweh in ci hi. Bang hang hiam cihleh nang in hih thu na bawl khin a, na tapa neihsun na humcip kei hi.
Nang thupha kong pia taktak ding a, van-a aksite leh tuipi gei-a sehnel bangin na suanlekhakte Ka khangsak ding a, tampi a pha ding hi. Na suanlekhakte in amau’ galte’ kulhkongpite uk ding uh hi.
Nang in Ka thu hong mang khin na hih manin nang’ suanlekhak tungtawnin leitung minam khempeuh thupha kipia ding hi,” a ci hi.
Tua ahih ciangin Abraham pen ama nasem tangvalte kiangah kilehkik a, amaute dingkhia-in Beersheba lamah a paikhawm uh hi. Beersheba ah Abraham a teng hi.
Tu-in hih bang teng khit ciangin hici bangin hong hi a, Abraham kiangah a kigen inah, “En in, Milcah in zong na sanggampa Nahor tawh tate nei hi:
Uz a u pen hi a, ama sanggamte pen Buz, Aram’ pa Kemuel,
Chesed, Hatzo, Pildash, Yidlaph, leh Bethuel ahi hi,” a ci hi.
Bethuel in Rebekah kici ta khat nei hi. Hih giatte pen Abraham sanggampa Nahor tawh Milcah in a neih ahi hi.
A zineu Reumah in zong tapate nei a: Tebah, Gaham, Thahash, leh Maachah ahi hi.
Sarah nuntak hun khempeuh: kum 127 nungta hi.
Tua ahih ciangin Canaan gam Kiryath Arba (Hebron)-ah Sarah si hi. Sarah hangin Abraham dahin a kap hi.
Tua ciangin siluang mai panin Abraham dingto a, Heth’ suanlekhakte kiangah a gen inah:
“Kei pen note lakah khualmi hi-in peemta ka hi hi. Ka mai panin ka siluang ka vui theih nadingin note’ lakah vui nading mun leitang a nei peuh in hong leisak un,” a ci hi.
Heth’ suanlekhakte in Abraham dawng a, ama kiangah,

“Ngai in, ka lawm aw, nang pen kote lakah a vanglian ulian khat na hi a, kote’ han munte pan na deihna penpen ah na misi vui in. Kote kuamah in nang aa dingin a han it lo ding a, na misi vui ding hong khaktan lo ding hi,” a ci hi.
Tua ciangin Abraham dingin, Heth’ suanlekhakte ahi tua gam mite lamah a kun hi.
Amaute tawh amah kiho-in a gen inah: “Ka mai panin ka zi ka vui ding nong deih uh leh, ka thu hong ngai un. Zohar’tapa Ephron in kei aa dingin,

ama lo nawl-a om ama neih ahi Machpelah kuahawm amah in kei’ tungah hong zuak nadingin palai hong sepsak un. Vui nading mun ka neihna dingin a manh ding cing takin tua pen kei kiangah amah in hong zuaksak un,” a ci hi.
Tu-in Ephron zong Heth’ suanlekhakte lakah tu a, Heth’ suanlekhakte omna panin khuapi kulhkongpi ah a hong pai Hit mite khempeuh’ zakna-ah Hit mi Ephron in Abraham dawng a,
“Hilo hi, ka lawm aw, hong ngai in. Nang’ tungah lo leh tua mun a om kuahawm kong pia hi. Ka mipihte’ muhna ah nang kong pia hi. Nang tungah kong pia hi. Na misi vui in,” a ci hi.
Tua ciangin tua gam mite mai-ah Abraham amahmah kunsuk a,
tua gam mite zakin Ephron kiangah amah in, “Lungsim takpi tawh na cih ahihleh hong ngai in. Lo manh ding kong pia ding a, hong sang in. Tua ciangin ka misi ka vui ding hi,” a ci hi.
Ephron in Abraham dawng a, ama kiangah,
“Ka ukpa aw, ka gen hong ngai in. Tua leitang in ngun shekel zali man hi. Nang leh kei kikalah thudang bang omnawn ahi hiam? Na misi vui in,” a ci hi.
Abraham in Ephron’ cih mang a, Abraham in Ephron aa dingin, Heth’ suanlekhakte’ zakna ah a min lawh zah, tua hun laitak a sumbukte’lakah a kizang a gikzah tawh kizui-in ngun shekel 400 a tehkhia hi.
Tua ahih ciangin Mamre tawh a kinai Machpelah-a Ephron’ lo, a sunga om leihawm leh a lo, leh kigi kiimkot lo sunga om singkungte khempeuh pen
ama khuapi kulhkongpi ah a kikhawm mite khempeuh’ mai, Heth’ suanlekhakte’ muhna ah Abraham’ neih dingin a kithukim ahi hi.
Hih bang khit ciangin Canaan gam sunga om Mamre (Hebron) nai-a, Machpelah lo kuahawm sungah Abraham in ama’ zi Sarah a vui hi.
Tua ahih manin lo leh a sunga om kuahawm, si vui nading mun-a neih dingin Heth’ suanlekhakte hangin Abraham’ tungah a kithukim ahi hi.

headings.text: Nasempa in A Paina Thu Pulak

verses.text: Tu-in Abraham teekin a kum tam mahmah ta hi. A nam tuamtuamin Yahweh in Abraham thupa pia hi.
