Tua ahih manin Abraham in a neihsa khempeuh a uk ama inn nasem ukpipa kiangah, “Ka phei nuai-ah na khut hong koih in.
Vantung leh leitung a piangsak Yahweh tawh nang nong kiciam ding ka deih in-ah: amaute laka ka tenna Canaan mite’ tanute panin ka tapa’ zi ding na lak loh nading leh,
ahi zongin nang pen ka gam leh ka behte kiangah pai-in, ka tapa Isaac’ zi ding na lak ding ahi hi.
Tua ciangin nasempa in ama kiangah, “A numei in hih gam ah kei hong zui nuam kei khaleh, nangma nong paikhiatna gam ah na tapa paipihkik ding ka hi hiam?” a ci hi.
Ahih hangin Abraham in ama kiangah, “Tua lai-ah ka tapa na paipihkik loh nangin siangsak in.

Kei tungah hong kiciam leh kei hong hopih, ka behte leitang panin leh ka pa’ inn panin kei hong samkhia, vantung a Piangsak Yahweh in, “Na suanlekhakte tungah hih leitang ka pia hi,” hong ci hi. Nang mai-ah Amah in Ama’ vantungmi sawl ding a, tua mun panin ka tapa aa dingin nangmah in zi khat na la ding hi.
Ahih hangin numei in nang hong zuih nop kei leh, hih thuciamna panin nang na suakta ding a, ka tapa pen tua mun ah na paipih kei bek ding hi,” a ci hi.
Tua ahih manin nasempa in a nasepna pu Abraham’ phei nuai-ah a khut koih a, hih thu tawh kisai-in ama tungah a kiciam hi.

Tua khit ciangin nasempa in Abraham’ kalaohte sawm la-in paikhia a, Abraham’ kiang panin a hoih nate a namkimin la hi. Mesopotamia nitumna-leilulam ahi Arm Naharaim zuan a, Nahor khuapi lamah a pai hi.
Numeite’ tuitawi hun a tun hun nitak hunin, khuapi pualam tuikhuk khat gei-ah amah in a kalaohte boksak hi.
Tua khit ciangin amah in thungen a, “Ka pu Abraham’ Pa Yahweh aw, tu ni-in ka ma hong vangsak in, ka pu Abraham tungah Na hehpihna hong lak in.
En in, tuikhuk gei-ah kei ka ding a, khuapi mite’ tanute tuitawi dingin hong pai uh hi.

Keimah in, ‘Tui ka dawn theih nadingin na beel hong nga suk in,’ ka cih ciangin, ‘Dawn in, na kalaohte zong tui ka pia ding hi,’ hong ci nu pen Na nasempa Isaac aa dingin Na teelsa numei hisak in. Hih bangdan tawh, ka pu’ tungah na migitna Nong lakkhin hi ci-in ka thei ding hi,” a ci hi.
Tua bangin thunget a khit ma-in, Abraham’ sanggampa Nahor in a zi Milcah tawh a neih a tapa Bethuel’ tanu Rebekah a liangko tungah a tuibeel pua-in hong paikhia hi.
Tua nu pen kuamah tawh a lumkhawm nai lo, nungak, a melhoih mahmah khat ahi hi. Amah tuikhuk ah paisukin a bel dim a, hong paito hi.
Tua ciangin nasempa in tua nu dawntuah dingin manlangin pai a, a gen inah: “Na tuibeel panin tui tawmkhat hong pia in,” a ci hi.
Tua ahih ciangin amah in, “Dawn in, ukpa aw,” a ci hi. Tua ciangin amah in a khut tungah a beel niamsuksakin amah a dawnsak hi.
Amah in tua mipa tui a dawnsak khit ciangin, “Na kalaohte in a kham matengun a dawn ding zong tui kong tawisak ding hi,” a ci hi.
Tua ahih ciangin amah in a tuikuang sungah a tui bungsuk pak a, tuitawi dingin tuikhuk ah tai-in a kalaohte khempeuh aa dingin tui a tawi hi.
Yahweh in ama khualzinna mavangsak ding hiam, vangsak lo ding hiam, cih a theih nadingin mipa in tua nu en gige-in, daitakin a om hi.
Kalaohte in tui dawn khin ta uh a, mipa in beka khat; 1/5 ongsa, a gik kham nakbah khat leh shekel sawm; ongsa 4 kiim, a gik kham tau nih tua nu aa dingin la-in pia a,
“Kua tanu na hi hiam? Na pa’ inn ah kote zan kong giahna ding khandei a om hiam? Hong gen in,” a ci hi.
Tua ahih manin amah in mipa kiangah, “Nahor leh a zi Milcah’ tapa Bethuel’ tanu ka hi hi,” a ci hi.
Amah in, “Buhkung leh gan-an a kicing ka nei uh a, giah nading mun zong ka nei uh hi,” ci thuah lai hi.
Mipa a lu kunsukin, Yahweh bia a,

amah in, “Ka pu tungah Ama migitna leh muanhuaina a kipelhsak lo, ka pu Abraham’ Pa Yahweh in Phatna ngah tahen. Ka khualzinna ah, ka pu’ behte inn teekteek mahah Yahweh in kei hong paipih hi!” a ci hi.
Tua ciangin nungaknu a inn ah tai-in hih thute khempeuh a nu’ innkuanpihte tungah a gen hi.
Rebekah in Laban kici sanggam pasal khat nei a, Laban zong tuikhuka mipa kiangah a tai hi.

Amah in nakbah leh a sanggamnu’ khut tunga taute a muh phetin, “Mipa in hih bangin kei tungah hong gen,” ci-in a sanggamnu Rebekah’ gen a zak ciangin, mipa kiangah a pai ahi hi. Tuikhuka kalaohte kiangah amah na ding hi.
Tua ciangin amah in, “Hong pai in, Yahweh thupha piakpa aw! Bang hangin a pua-ah ding na hi hiam? Ahang in inn leh kalaohte’ omna ding mun ka bawl khin hi,” a ci hi.
Tua khit ciangin inn sungah mipa hong pai a, Laban in kalaohte vante suah a, buhkung leh gan-an-te kalaohte pia a, amah leh a mah tawh a om mite’ khe sil nadingin tui zong a pia hi.
Nek dingin amai-ah an kilui a, ahih hangin amah in, “Ka thu kong gen khit matengin ka ne kei ding hi,” a ci hi. Tua ciangin amah in, “Gen in,” a ci hi.
Tua ahih manin Amah in gen a, “Kei pen Abraham’ nasem ka hi hi.
Yahweh in ka pu nakpitakin thupha pia a, amah pen a hau mahmah ta hi. Tuuhonte leh bawnghonte, ngun leh kham, nasem pasalte leh nasem numeite, kalaohte leh laate Amah in ama tungah a pia khin hi.
Ka pu’ zi Sarah in a teek khitin ka pu tawh tapa khat nei hi. Amah in a tapa’ tungah a neihsa khempeuh pia hi.
Tu-in ka pu in kei hong kiciamsak a, ‘Ka tenna Canaan mite’ tanute lak panin ka tapa’ zi ding na la kei ding a,
ka pa’ inn leh ka behte kiangah pai-in ka tapa aa ding zi khat na la ding hi,’ hong ci hi.
Tua ciangin keimah in ka pu kiangah, ‘A numei in kei hong zui nuam kei kha leh,’ ka ci hi.

Ahih hangin amah in kei kiangah, “A thu ka man’ Yahweh in nang tawh a om dingin Ama vantungmi hong sawlin na khualzinna hong tangtungsak ding hi. Ka pa’ inn pan leh ka behte kiang panin ka tapa aa dingin zi khat na la ding hi.
Ka behte lakah na tun ciangin, amaute in nang tungah a numei hong piak kei uh leh, ka thuciamna panin nang a suakta na hi ding a, hih thuciamna panin nang a peng na hi ding hi,’ hong ci hi.
“Tu ni-in tuikhuk ah pai-in, thu ka nget inah, “Ka pu Abraham’ Pa Yahweh aw tu-a ka paina ah nong tangtut ding leh,
en in, tuikhuk gei-ah kei ka ding a, tu-in tuitawi dingin nungak khat hong pai khia-in, keimah in ama kiangah, ‘Ka dawn dingin na tuibel panin tuithem hong pia in,’ ka cih ciangin,
amah in kei kiangah, ‘Dawn in, na kalaohte aa ding zong kong tawisak ding hi,’ hong ci nu pen, ka pu’ tapa aa dingin Yahweh in a teelsa numei hi ding hi,’ ka ci hi.

Ahih hangin ka lungsim sung panin ka thungetna a man khit ma-in, a liangko tungah tuibel pua-in a paikhia Rebekah ka mu a, tuikhuk ah amah paisukin tui a tawi hi. Tua ciangin keimah in ama kiangah, ‘Tui hong dawnsak in,’ ka ci hi.
Amah in a liangko panin a beel hong khiasuk pahin, ‘Dawn in, na kalaohte zong tui ka pia ding hi,’ hong ci hi. Tua ahih ciangin keimah in ka dawn a, amah in kalaohte zong tui a pia hi.

Tua ciangin keimah in ama kiangah, ‘Kua tanu na hi hiam?’ ci-in ka dong hi. Amah in, ‘Nahor leh a zi Milkah’ tapa Bethuel’ tanu ka hi hi,’ hong ci hi. Tua ahih manin a nakah nakbah ka batsak a, a khutah taaute ka bulhsak hi.
Tua ciangin ka lu kunin Yahweh ka bia a, a tapa aa dingin ka pu’ sanggampa’ tunu la dingin lampi man ah hong kha, ka pu Abraham’ Pa Yahweh ka phat hi.
Tu-in, ka pu’ tungah migitna leh thumanna na lak ding ahihleh kei hong gen inla, tua bang ahih kei leh zong kei hong gen in. Tua hileh ka kihei nading veilam maw taklam cih ka thei ding hi,’ a ci hi.
Tua ciangin Laban leh Bethuel in dawng a, “Yahweh kiang panin hong pai thu pen, nang tungah kote in a sia ahi zongin a pha ahi zongin kong gen thei kei uh hi.
Na mai hih mun ah Rebekah om hi, amah sam inla, pai un. Yahweh in hong laksa bangin, na pu’ tapa zi hisak un,” a ci hi.
Hih bang hun hong tung a, Abraham’ nasempa in amau’ kammalte a zak ciangin, Yahweh mai leilak ah a kunsuk hi.
Tua khit ciangin nasempa in ngun kizepna, kham kizepna, leh puansilhte hong suahkhia-in Rebekah a pia hi. A sanggampa leh a nu zong nasempa in a manpha nate a pia hi.
Amah leh amah tawh a pai mite in an ne tui dawnin, tua lai-ah tua zan a giak uh hi. Amaute zingsang a thawh ciangin, amah in, “Ka pu kiangah hong ciahsakkik un,” a ci hi.
Ahi zongin a sanggampa leh a nu in, “Ni sawm kiim, nungakno nu ko tawh tawmvei hong omsak lai in; tua khit ciangin amah pai thei ding hi,” a ci hi.
Ahih hangin amah in amaute kiangah, “Yahweh in ka khualzinna hong tangtungsak khin ahih manin kei hong kho nawn kei un. Kei hong paisak un, tua hileh ka pu kiangah kei ka pai thei ding hi,” a ci hi.
Tua ahih manin amaute in, “Nungakno nu i sam ding a, amah i dong ding hi,” a ci hi.
Tua ciangin amaute in Rebekah samin, ama kiangah, “Hih mipa na zui ding hiam,” a ci hi. Amah in, “Ka zui ding hi,” ci pah hi.
Tua ahih manin amaute in amau’ sanggamnu Rebekah leh a donnu, leh Abraham’ nasempa leh ama mite a khakhia uh hi.
Amaute in Rebekah thupha pia-in ama kiangah, “Kote sanggamnu aw, tulsawm tampite’ tul tampite’ nu hi dingin khang inla, na suanlekhakte in amau a mudahte’ kulh kongpite uk tahen,” a ci uh hi.
Tua ciangin Rebekah leh ama nasem numeite dingin kalaohte tungah tuangin mipa a zui uh hi. Tua ahih manin nasempa in Rebekah la-in, a pai hi.
Tu-in Isaac pen Negev ah teng ahih manin, amah Beer Lahai Roi lam panin hong pai hi.
Nitak ciangin Isaac in thu a lungngaingai dingin lolakah paikhia a, amah a khuadak leh kalaohte hong pai a mu hi.
Tua ciangin Rebekah khuadak a, amah in Isaac a muh ciangin, kalaoh tung panin a kum hi.
Amah in nasempa kiangah, “Eite hong dawn dingin lolak a hong pai mipa kua ahi hiam?” a ci hi. Nasempa in, “Ka pu hi,” a ci hi. Tua ahih ciangin amah in a kikhuhna dial khat la-in, a kikhuh hi.
Nasempa in Isaac kiangah a gamtatnasa khempeuh a gen hi.
Tua ciangin Isaac in ama’ nu Sarah puanbuk sungah kha-in, amah in Rebekah tenpihin, Rebekah pen ama zi a suak hi. Amah in tua nu a it hi. Tua ahih manin a nu sih khit ciangin Isaac kihehnem hi.
Abraham in Keturah min nei zi dang khat la hi.
Amah in tua nu tawh ta Zimran, Yokshan, Medan, Midian, Ishbak, leh Shuah nei hi.
Yokshan pen Sheba leh Dedan’ pa ahi hi. Dedan’ tapate pen Assurim, Letushim, leh Leummim ahi hi.
Midian tapate pen Ephah, Epher, Hanoch, Abidah, leh Eldaah ahi hi. Hihte khempeuh pen Keturah tate ahi hi.
Tu-in Abraham in a neihsa khempeuh Isaac a pia hi.
Ahih hangin Abraham in a zi dang tawh a neih a tapate tungah zong citpiakna pia a, ama nuntak lai mahin ama tapa Isaac kiang pan nisuahna lam, nisuahna gam ah amaute a sawlkhia hi.
Hih pen Abraham nuntak kum vekpi ahi hi. Abraham kum 175 a phak ciangin,
tua ciangin Abraham in a hutawpna sang a, a teek, kum tampi a pha, a khanghamin si a, a mipihte tawh kivui khawm hi.
Ama tapate ahi Isaac leh Ishmayl in Hit mi Zohar tapa Ephron lo sung Mamre tawh a kinai Machpelah kuahawm sungah amah a vui uh hi.
Tua logam pen Abraham in Heth’ suanlekhakte kiang panin a lei ahi hi. Tua lai mun, a zi Sarah gei-ah Abraham a kivui hi.
Abraham a sih khit ciangin hih bang thu hong piang a, tua inah Yahweh in Abraham’ tapa Isaac thupha pia hi. Isaac pen Beer Lahai Roi-ah a teng hi.
Hihte pen, Abraham in Sara’ nasem numei ahi Egypt mi Hagar tawh a neih, Abraham tapa Ishmayl’ suanlekhakte ahi hi.
Hihte pen amau suah bang banga kigual Ishmayl’ tapate min ahi hi: a suak masa pen Nebayoth, tua khit ciang Kedar, Adbeel, Mibsam,
Mishma, Dumah, Massa,
Hadad, Tema, Yetur, Naphish, leh Kedemah ahi hi.
Hihte pen Ishmayl’ tapate hi a, amau khua, amau giahphualte ah amau minamte tawh kizui-in upa sawm le nihte min ahi hi.
Hihte pen Ishmayl’ nuntak kum ahi hi: kum 137 nungta in, amah in a hu tawpna sangin si a, a mipihte tawh kivui khawm hi.
(Amaute pen Havilah panin Assyria lam manawhin, Egypt nisuahna lam ahi Shur dong ah a teng uh hi.) Ama sanggamte’ omna ah amah a si hi.
Hihte pen Abraham’ tapa Isaac suanlekhakte ahi hi. Abraham in tapa Isaac a nei hi.
Aram mi Laban sanggamnu Padan Aram pana Aram mi Bethuel tanu ahi Rebekah zi-in Isaac alak hun lai-in, Isaac kum 40 a pha hi.
Tu-in Rebekah ciing ahih manin, Isaac in a zi aa dingin Yahweh kiangah thungen hi. Yahweh in a thungetna dawng a, a zi Rebekah gai hi.
Ahih hangin ama sunga naute kilaigawp uh a, amah in, “Hih bang ahihleh bang hangin kei tungah hi bang hong tung ahi hiam?” a ci hi. Tua ahih manin Yahweh kiangah a dong dingin amah a pai hi.
Yahweh in ama kiangah, “Na naubu sungah minam nih a om hi. Na pumpi panin mi nihte kikhen ding uh a, khat pen a dang khat sangin hat zaw ding a, a uzaw pen in a nauzaw’ na sem ding hi,” a ci hi.
A suah ding hun hong tun ciangin, en in, naubu sungah tapeeng om hi.
A masa pen a ci sanin hong suak khia a, a pumpi khempeuh mul a nei puan tawh kibang ahih manin amaute in a min Esau phuak hi. Tua inah Mulhau a cihna ahi hi.
Tua khit ciangin a sanggampa suak khia a, ama khut in Esau’ khetul len hi. Tua ahih manin ama min Yaaqob a phuak hi. Tua inah Amah in Khetul Man, Amah in Khem, A Suankhiapa a cihna ahi hi.
Tua ciangin naupangte hong khang a, Esau pen sabet siam gamlak mi ahi hi. Ahih hangin Yaaqob pen a omhithiat mi hi a, puanbukte lakah a om hi.
Esau matsa gamsate a nene Isaac in Esau it a, Rebekah in Yaaqob a it hi.
Esau gilkiallua-in, gamlak panin amah hong ciah ciangin, Yaaqob in meh na huan khin hi.
Esau in Yaaqob kiangah, “Gilkial lua mahmah ka hih manin, tua na meh san tawh kei hong vak in,” a ci hi. Tua ahih manin a min Edom kici hi. Tua pen San a cihna ahi hi.
Ahih hangin Yaaqob in, “Tu ni-in na innluahza hong zuak in,” a ci hi.
Esau in, “En in, kei a si dek ta hi. Tua ahih manin hih innluahza kei aa dingin bang hi nawn ahi hiam?” a ci hi.
Tua ciangin Yaaqob in, “Tu ni mahmahin kei tungah hong kiciam in,” a ci hi. Tua ahih manin amah kiciam a, Yaaqob tungah a innluahza a zuak hi.

Tua ciangin Yaaqob in anluum leh gam-be meh tuamtuam a pia hi. Tua khit ciangin amah in ne-in dawn a, tua khit ciangin amah dingin, ama paina ding ah a pai hi. Tua ci bangin Esau in a innluahza a thupi ngaihsut kei hi.
Abraham hun lai a kialpi masa banah, tu-in gam sungah kialpi a tung hi. Gerar gam sunga Philistines kumpipa Abimelech kiangah Isaac a pai hi.
Tua ciangin ama tungah Yahweh kilang a, a gen inah: “Egypt gam ah paisuk kei in.
Hih gam ah omlai in. Nang Kong ompih ding a, thupha Kong pia ding hi. Ahang in nang tung leh na suanlekhak’ tungah hih leitangte Kong pia ding a, na pa Abraham tunga thuciamna Ka kipsak ding hi.
Na suanlekhakte vantung aksite bangin Ka tamsak ding a, na suanlekhak’ tungah hih leitangte khempeuh Ka pia ding hi. Na suanlekhak’ sungah leitung minamte khempeuh thupha kipia ding hi.
Bang hang hiam cihleh Abraham in Ka thu mangin, Ka sawlna, Ka thupiaknate, Ka biakna ngeinakipte, leh Ka Thukhamte zui hi,” a ci hi.
Tua ahih manin Gerar ah Isaac teng hi.

Tu-in tua muna mite in ama kiangah a zi’ thu a dong uh hi. Rebekah a mel hoih mahmah ahih manin Rebekah hangin tua muna mite in hong that ding hi ci-in ngaihsun a, “Amah ka zi hi,” a cih ding lau ahih manin amah in, “Amah ka sanggamnu hi,” a ci hi.
Tua lai-ah Isaac sawtveipi a om khit ciangin, Philistine kumpipa Abimelech a tawlet panin khuadak a, Isaac in a zi Rebekah it takin a angkawina a mu hi.

Tua ciangin Abimelech in Isaac sam a, “Amah pen na zi hi! A bang ci lianga amah ka sanggamnu hi ci na hi hiam?” a ci hi. Isaac in ama kiangah, “Ama hangin ka si kha ding hi ci-in ka ngaihsun kha hi,” a ci hi.
Abimelech in, “Ko tungah bang hangin hih bangin hong gamta na hi hiam? Na zi tawh mi khat peuh na lum khawm kha thei ding a, tua ciangin nangmah in kote tungah mawhna hong puak na hi ding hi!
Tua ahih manin Abimelech in a mite khempeuh thu zasak a, “Hih mipa ahi a ama zi ahi zongin a sukha peuhmah sihna ah kitun taktak ding hi,” a ci hi.
Tua ciangin Isaac in tua leitang ah khaici tuh a, tua kum mahin a zah zakhat la hi. Yahweh in amah thupha pia hi.
Mipa hong hau a, a hauh mahmah dongin ama hauhna khang semsem hi.
Amah in tuuhonte leh bawnghonte leh nasem tampi nei hi. Tua ahih manin Philistia mite in amah a haza uh hi.
Tu-in a pa Abraham hun lai a ama pa’ nasemte in a tawhsa tuikhuk khempeuh Philistia mite in hukcipsak a, amaute in lei tawh a vuk uh hi.
Abimelech in Isaac kiangah, “Kote aa dingin nang pen thahatlua ta na hih manin kote kiang panin kihem khia in,” a ci hi.
Tua ciangin tua mun panin Isaac kihemkhia a, Gerar kuam sungah a puanbuk lamin a teng hi.

Isaac pa Abraham hun lai-in amaute tawhsa tuikhukte Isaac in a tokik hi. Ahang in Abraham sih khit ciangin Philistia mite in tuate hukcipsak uh hi. A pa in tuate a min vawhnasa bangin amah in zong a lo hi.
Tua kuam sungah Isaac’ nasemte in tuikhuk to uh a, tuikhuk siang khat tua mun ah a mu uh hi.

Ahih hangin Gerar gancingte Isaac’ gancingte tawh kitawng kisel uh a, “Tui pen ko tui hi,” a ci uh hi. Tua ahih manin amah in tuikhuk min pen Esek a ci hi. Tua pen kinial a cihna ahi hi. Bang hang hiam cihleh amaute amah tawh a kinial uh hi.
Tua ciangin amaute in tuikhuk dang khat to leuleu a, tua tawh zong amaute kitawng kisel leuleu uh hi. Tua ahih manin amah in Sitnah ci-in min a phuah hi. Tua pen kilangdona acih na ahi hi.

Tua ciangin tua panin amah kikhin a, tuikhuk dang khat a to hi. Tua tawh amaute kitawng kisel nawn lo hi. Tua ahih manin amah in a min Rehoboth a ci hi. Tua pen Mun a cihna ahi hi. Bang hang hiam cihleh amah in, “Tu petpetin Yahweh in ei aa dingin mun hong bawlsak khin a, eite hih gam ah i pung ding hi,” a ci hi.
Tua ciangin tua lai panin Beersheba ah amah a paito hi.

Tua nitak mahin ama tungah Yahweh kilang a, “Kei pen na pa Abraham’ Pa ka hi a, nang hong ompih Ka hih manin lau kei in. Ka nasem Abraham hangin nang thupha Kong pia ding a, na suanlekhakte Ka pungsak ding hi,” a ci hi.
Tua ahih manin tua mun ah Isaac in biaknatau khat lam a, Yahweh min loin thu a ngen hi. Tua mun ah amah in a puanbuk a lam hi. Tua lai-ah Isaac’ nasemte in tuikhuk khat a to uh hi.
Tua ciangin Gerar panin Abimelech, a lawm khat ahi Ahuzzath, leh a galkap mangpa Phichol Isaac kiangah hong pai uh hi.
Isaac in amaute kiangah, “Note in kei hong galbawl-in note kiang panin hong hawlkhia khin napi-in bang hangin kei kiangah hong pai na hi uh hiam?” a ci hi.

Ahih hangin amaute in, “Yahweh nang hong ompih lam kote in ka mukhin taktak uh hi. Tua ahih manin kote in, ‘Tu-in nang leh kote kikalah kiciamna khat nei-in, nang tawh thukimna khat bawl ni,’ a ci ka hi uh a,

kote in nang hong sukha lo leh kote in nang bangmah hong cih loin a manin gamta-in kilemna tawh nang hong sawlkhia ka hih manun, nang in kote tungah bangmah siatna nong bawl kei ding hi. Tu-in Yahweh in nang thupha hong pia hi,” a ci uh hi.
Tua ahih manin Isaac in amaute aa dingin pawi khat bawl a, amaute in ne-in a dawn uh hi.
Tua ciangin amaute zingsangin thobaih uh a, amaute khatlekhat kiciamna bawl uh a, Isaac in amaute khakhia-in, ama kiang panin kilemna tawh amaute a kikhen uh hi.
2 Tua ni mahin Isaac’ nasemte hong pai-in amaute tawhsa tuikhuk thu amah gen uh a, ama kiangah, “Kote in tui ka mu uh hi,” a ci hi.
Tua ahih manin amah in tua pen Shibah ci-in min a phuah hi. Tua ahih ciangin tua khuapi min pen tu ni dongin Beersheba kici hi. Tua pen Kiciamna Tuikhuk ahih keileh Sagihte Tuikhuk a cihna ahi hi.
Esau kum sawmli a phak ciangin, Hit mi Elon tanu Adah leh Hiv mi Zibeon tanu ahi Anah tanu Aholibamah tenih zi dingin a la hi.
Amaute in Isaac leh Rebekah-te lungsim gimsak mahmah uh hi.

headings.text: Haran ah Rebekah in Yaaqob Sawlkhia

verses.text: Tu-in Isaac teek ta in, amah in khua muthei nawn lo zahin a mitte a mial ciangin, a tapa uzaw amah in sam a, ama kiangah, “Ka tapa aw,” a ci hi. Tua ciangin amah in dawng a, “Hiah ka om hi,” a ci hi.
Amah in, “En in tu-in kei ka teek ta a, ka sih ding hun ka thei kei hi.
Tua ahih ciangin tu-in, na hiamte ahi na thallawng leh na thal la inla, gamlak ah pai-in kei aa dingin sa va beng in.
Ka sih ma-in kei mahmah in nang thupha kong piak theih nadingin kei’ duh bangin a limin hong bawl inla, tua pen ka nek dingin kei kiangah hong paipih in,” a ci hi.
Tu-in Isaac in a tapa Esau kiangah thu a genna Rebekah in na za hi. Sabeng ding leh tua pen a ciahpihkik dingin Esau gamlak ah pai hi.
Tua ahih manin Rebekah in a tapa Yaaqob kiangah gen a, “En in, na sanggampa Esau tungah na pa thugenna ka za a, a gen inah:
‘Ka sihma-in Yahweh mai-ah nang thupha kong piak theih nadingin leh ka nek dingin gamsa va man inla, kei aa dingin a lim hong bawl in,’ ci hi.
Tu-in tua ahih ciangin ka tapa aw, kei kong thupiakna tawh kizui-in ka thu hong mang in.
Ganhon lakah pai inla, keelte’ lak panin keelno a hoih nih kei kiangah hong paipih in. Na pa’ duh bangin ama aa dingin tuate panin a limin ka bawlsak ding hi.
Tua khit ciangin amah in a nek theih nadingin nangmah in tua pen na pa’ kiangah na paipih ding a, ama sihma-in amah in nang thupha hong pia ding hi,” a ci hi.
Tua ciangin Yaaqob in a nu Rebekah kiangah, “Ahih hangin ka sanggampa Esau pen multam mi hi a, kei pen cineel mi ka hi hi.
Ka pa in kei hong zawtin hileh, ama tungah zuaukhem khat tawh ka kibang ding a, thupha hi loin samsiatna keilekei a kitun ka suak kha ding hi,” a ci hi.
Ahih hangin a nu in ama kiangah, “Nang tunga samsiatna kei’ tungah hong tung tahen, ka ta aw; ka thu hong mang peuh inla, kei’ kiangah keelnote hong paipih in!” a ci hi.
Tua ciangin amah pai-in, keelnote man a, a nu’ kiangah tuate a paipih hi. A pa duh danin a nu meh lim a bawl hi.
Tua ciangin Rebekah in inn sunga ama kiangah a om a tapa uzaw Esau’ puan hoihpente la a, a tapa nauzaw Yaaqob a silhsak hi.
Amah in keelnote’ vun Yaaqob khut tung leh a neelna mun a ngawng sanah a silhsak hi.
Tua khit ciangin amah in ama bawlsa meh lim leh an pen a tapa Yaaqob khut sungah a pia hi.
Tua ciangin a pa kiangah amah pai a, “Ka pa aw,” a ci hi. Amah in, “Hiah ka om hi! Ka tapa lak pan kua zaw na hi hiam?” a ci hi.

Tua ciangin Yaaqob in a pa’ kiangah, “Na tapa uzaw Esau ka hi a, nangmah in nong gensa bangin ka bawl khin hi. Thoto inla tu-in ka samatsa ne in. Tua hileh nang mahmah in kei thupha nong pia thei ding hi,” a ci hi.
Ahih hangin Isaac in a tapa kiangah, “Bang ci bangin gamsa manlang takin man thei na hi hiam, ka ta aw?” a ci hi. Tua ciangin amah in, “Nangma Pa, Yahweh in kei lawhcinna hong pia hi,” a ci hi.
Tua khit ciangin Isaac in Yaaqob kiangah, “Nang pen ka tapa Esau taktak hi maw hilo cih kong theihna dingin hong kinphei in,” a ci hi.
Tua ahih manin Yaaqob zong a pa Isaac kiang kinphei a, amah in lawng a, “A aw pen Yaaqob aw hi a, ahih hangin a khutte Esau khut hi,” a ci hi.
Isaac in amah khentel thei lo hi. Bang hang hiam cihleh ama khutte pen a sanggampa Esau’ khutte bangin mul a tam hi. Tua ahih manin Isaac in amah thupha pia hi.
Tua khit ciangin amah in, “Ka tapa Esau taktak na hi hiam?” a ci hi. Amah in, “Ka hi hi,” a ci hi.

Amah in, “Tua pen kei kiangah hong tawi phei inla, keimah in ka tapa matsa ka ne ding a, tua hileh kei mahmah in nang thupha hong pia ding hi,” a ci hi. Tua ahih manin amah in, “Tua pen a pa’ kiangah paipihin a pa in a ne hi. Amah in leenggahzu zong pia a, a pa in a dawn hi.
Tua khit ciangin a pa Isaac in ama kiangah, “Hong kinphei inla hong nam in, ka ta aw,” a ci hi.
Amah kinphei in a pa a nam a, Isaac in a puan gimnam nam a, amah thupha pia a, “Yahweh in thupha a piaksa gamlak gimnam tawh a kibang ka tapa gimnam taktak ahi hi.
Tua ahih ciangin van daitui, leitung’ thauna, buh leh leenggahzu a tampi-te Yahweh in nang tungah hong pia tahen.

Mi tampite in nangma na sem henla, minamte na mai-ah kun uh hen. Na sanggamte’ tungah ukpa hi inla, nang tungah na nu’ tapate kun uh hen. Nang hong samsia mi in samsiatna ngah uh henla, nang thupha hong pia mi in thupha ngah tahen!” a ci hi.
Tua ciangin Isaac in Yaaqob thupha a piakna a man khit, a pa Isaac omna panin a paikhiat khit phetin, a sa betna panin a sanggam pa Esau hong tung hi.

Amah in zong meh lim bawl a, tua pen a pa’ kiangah a paipih a, a pa kiangah, “Ka pa aw kong thotosak ding a, na tapa matsa hong neksak in. Tua hileh nang mahmah in kei thupha nong pia thei ding hi,” a ci hi.
Tua ciangin a pa Isaac in ama kiangah, “Kua na hi hiam?” a ci hi. Amah in, “Keimah na tapa uzaw Esau ka hi hi,” a ci hi.

Tua ciangin Isaac nakpitakin lingin, “Kua hiam? Gamsa manin kei’ kiangah hong paipih khat koi-ah om hiam? Nang nong pai ma-in tuate khempeuh ka ne a, amah thupha ka piakhin hi. Amah in thupha ngah taktak ding hi,” a ci hi.
A pa’ kammalte Esau in a zak ciangin, amah ngaihtak leh nakpitakin a kap a, a pa kiangah, “Thupha hong pia in, kei zong maw, aw ka pa aw!” a ci hi.
Ahih hangin a pa in, “Khemna tawh na sanggampa hong pai-in, na thupha la khin ta hi,’ a ci hi.
Esau in, “Amin Yaaqob kiphuah man hilo ahi hiam? Amah in kei nih vei hong khem khin hi. Amah in ka innluahza hong laksak khin a, tu-in en in, ka thupha hong laksak khin hi!” a ci hi.

Tua ciangin Isaac in dawngin Esau kiangah, “Na ukpa dingin amah ka bawl khin taktak a, a sanggam khempeuh nasemte bangin ama tungah ka pia khin a, an leh leenggahzu tawh amah ka hingsak hi. Nang aa dingin bang hih thei nawn ka hiam, ka ta aw?” a ci hi.
Esau in a pa’ kiangah, “thupha khat beek nei nawn lo na hi hiam, ka pa aw? Kei thupha hong pia in, kei zong maw, Maw ka pa!” a ci hi. Tua ciangin Esau nakpi takin a kap hi.
Tua ciangin a pa Isaac in dawnga, ama kiangah, “En in, na tenna pen leitung’ thauna, leh a tung panin van daitui ama aa ahi hi.
Na namsau tawh na nungta ding a, na sanggampa’ na nasem ding hi. Ahih hangin na kitomtom ding a, na ngawng panin ama hakkol na lawnkhia ding hi,” a ci hi.

Tua ciangin a pa in amah thupha pia-in tua thupha hangin Esau in Yaaqob langdo-in galkhat ngaihsun a, Esau in a lungsim sungah, “Ka pa aa dingin dahin kahna hong naita a, tua khit ciangin ka sanggampa Yaaqob ka that ding hi,” a ci hi.

A tapa uzaw Esau kammalte Rebekah tungah a kigen hi. Tua ahih manin Rebekah in misawlin, a tapa nauzaw Yaaqob a sam a, ama kiangah, “Na sanggampa Esau in nangmah thah ding gelkholhna tawh amah leh amah kihehnem hi.
Tua ahih manin tu-in, ka thu hong mang in. Ding inla, Haran a om ka sanggampa kiangah va tai inla,
na sanggampa’ hehna a dam mateng tua lai-ah amah tawh tawlkhat sung va om in.

Na sanggampa sinsona a daih mateng, ama tunga na gamtatna a mangngilh mateng va om in. Tua khit ciangin nang aa dingin mi hong sawlin tua lai mun panin nang kong lasak ding hi. Ni khat thu-in note nih bang hangin ken hong taankhawm ding ka hi hiam?” a ci hi.

Rebekah in Isaac kiangah, “Hit mite tanute hangin nuntakna ka lunggimin ka cimtak hi. Yaaqob in hih gam numeite dan ahi Hit mite tanute khat zi-in tenpih leh kei aa dingin nuntakna bang hi nawn ding ahi hiam?” a ci hi.

headings.text: Esau in Zi dang La Thuah

verses.text: Tua ciangin Isaac in Yaaqob sam a, amah thupha pia-in thu hilh a, ama kiangah, “Canaan numeite zi-in na la kei ding hi.
Ding inla, na nu’ pa Bethuel inn, Padan Aram ah pai in. Tua mun panin na nu’ sanggampa Laban tanute lak pan na zi ding khat nang leh nangin la tawm in.
Vanglian Yahweh in nang thupha hong pia hen la, mihon tampi khat nang na hih na dingin, pungin tampi pha-in nang hong bawl hen.
Yahweh in Abraham’ tunga a piaksa, khualmi-in na omna leitang na neih nadingin nang tung leh nang tawh a om na suanlekhakte tungah Abraham’ thupha hong pia tahen,” a ci hi.
Tua ahih manin Isaac in Yaaqob sawlkhia a, Yaaqob leh Esau-te’ nu Rebekah sanggampa, Aram mi Bethuel tapa Laban kiang Padan Aram ah amah a pai hi.
Isaac in Yaaqob thupha a piakkhitna leh Padan Aram panin amah le amahin zi khat la dingin sawlkhia a, amah in thupha a piak kawmin amah thuhilhin, ‘Canaan numeite zi-in na la kei ding hi,’ a cihna;
Yaaqob in a nu leh a pa’ thu mangin, Padan Aram ah a paikhitna Esau in a thei hi.
Canaan numeite in a pa Isaac a lungkimsak loh Esau in zong a thei hi.
Tua ahih manin Abraham’ tapa Ishmayl kiangah Esau pai a, zite a neihkhit banah Nebayoth sanggamnu, Ishmayl’ tanu Bashemath a zi dingin a la thuah hi.
Beersheba panin Yaaqob paikhia in, Haran lamah a pai hi.
Tua ahih manin mun khat ah amah tung a, ni tumkhin ahih manin tua lai mun ah zan a giak hi. Tua mun a suangte lak panin suang khat amah in la a, lukhamin nei a, tua mun ah a ihmu dingin a kualsuk hi.
Tua khit ciangin amah in mangman a, en in, leitung ah kahlei khat kinga-in a dawn in vantung dong a ban hi. Tua kahlei tungah Yahweh’ vantungmite a kumsuk a kahto hi.
En in, tua lai mun ah Yahweh ding a, a gen inah: “Na pa Abraham’ Pa, Isaac Pa ka hi a, na lupna leitang nang’ tung leh na suanlekhakte’ tungah Kong pia ding hi.

Na suanlekhate zong leitung leivui bang hi ding a, ni tumna lam, nisuahna lam, leilu lam leh leitaw lamah na kizel ding uh hi. Nang’ sung leh na suanlekhakte sungah leitung innkuante khempeuh thupha kipia ding hi.

En in, Nang Kong ompih a, na paina peuh ah nang Kong kem ding a, hih leitang ah nang Kong paipihkik ding hi. Ahang in nang’ tungah Kong ciamsa bangin Ka hih khit matengin nang Kong nusia kei ding hi,” a ci hi.
Tua khit ciangin a ihmutna panin Yaaqob khanglo a, a gen inah: “Hih mun ah Yahweh om taktak a, ken ka thei kha het kei hi!” a ci hi.
Amah lau a, a gen inah: “Hih mun bangzah takin lamdang hiam! Hih pen Yahweh Inn lo adang hilo a, hih pen Yahweh’ kumpigam lutna kongpi ahi hi,” a ci hi.
Tua ciangin zingsang ciangin Yaaqob thobaih-in, amah in lukhamin a zat suang la-in khuam khat bangin phut a, tua a dawn tung panin sathau a sung hi.
Tua mun min pen amah in Beth Yahweh a phuak hi. Tua pen Yahweh Inn a cihna ahi hi. Ahih hangin tua khuapi min pen tuama pek panin Luz a kici khinsa ahi hi.
Tua khit ciangin Yaaqob in kiciamna khat bawl a, a gen inah: “Yahweh in kei hong ompih ding a, ka pai nading hih lampi ah kei hong keem-in, nek ding an leh silh ding puan hong sikin,
tua hileh kilemna tawh ka pa’ inn ah ka ciahkik theih ding ahihleh tua ciangin Yahweh pen Vantung a om ka Pa hi ding hi;
khuam khat banga ka phutsa hih suang pen Yahweh’ Inn hi ding a, kei nong piak na khempeuhte Nang tungah sawm-ah-khat kong pia taktak ding hi,” a ci hi.

headings.text: Yaaqob in a Zi Ding Thalawh
Yaaqob in Leah leh Rachel Teenpih

verses.text: Tua ahih manin Yaaqob in ama khualzinna zom a, nisuahna lam mite’ leitang ah a tung hi.

Amah khuadak a, gamlak ah tuikhuk khat a mu hi. En in, tua tuikhuk kiangah tuuhon thum na lum hi. Ahang in tua lai panin tuucingte in tuuhonte tui a pia uh hi. Tuikhuk gong ah suang lianpi khat a om hi.

Tuucingte tuuhon khempeuh tawh tua mun ah a kikaihkhop khit uh ciangin tuikhuk gong a suang pen amaute in khukkhia-in tuute tui pia uh a, tua suang pen tuikhuk gong ama omna ngei ah a koihkik zel uh ahi hi.
Yaaqob in amaute kiangah, “Ka sanggamte aw, koi pan na hi uh hiam?” a ci hi. Amaute in, “Kote Haran pan ka hi uh hi,” a ci hi.
Tua ciangin amah in amaute kiangah, “Nahor tapa Laban na thei kha uh hiam?” a ci hi. Tua ciangin amaute in, “Amah ka thei uh hi,” a ci hi.
Tua ahih manin amah in amaute kiangah, “Amah a dam hiam?” a ci hi. Amaute in, “Amah dam mah hi,” a ci uh hi. En in, a tanu Rachel amau tuute tawh hong pai hi.
Tua ciangin amah in, “En un, ni sang lai a, gan kaihkhop hun nai lo hi. Tuute tui pia unla, tua khit ciangin pai-in an nesak lai un,” a ci hi.

Ahih hangin amaute in, “Tuuhon cingte khempeuh a kikaihkhop matengin kote in tua bangin ka hih zo kei uh hi. Amaute in tuikhuk gong panin suang a khukkhiat khit ciang bekin kote in tuute tui ka pia uh hi,” a ci hi.
Tua bangin amaute tawh amah a kiho laitakin, Rachel pen tuucing khat ahih mah bangin a pa’ tuute tawh a mah hong tung hi.
Yaaqob’ nu sanggampa Laban tanu Rachel leh a nu’ sanggampa Laban tuute Yaaqob in a muh ciangin, Yaaqob a nai-ah pai-a tuikhuk gong a suang khukkhia-in a nu’ sanggampa Laban gante tui a pia hi.
Tua khit ciangin Yaaqob in Rachel nam a, nakpitakin a kap hi.
Tua ciangin Yaaqob in amah pen Rachel’ pa kinaipih ahihna leh amah pen Rebekah’ tapa ahihna Rachel a gen hi.

Tua tak ciangin hi bang thu hong piang a, Laban in a sanggamnu’ tapa Yaaqob thu a kipuakna a zak ciangin, amah amu dingin amah tai a, amah angpom-in nam a, a inn ah a paipih hi. Tua ahih ciangin hih thute khempeuh amah in Laban a gen hi.
Laban in ama kiangah, “Nang pen ka guh ka sa na hi taktak hi,” a ci hi. Yaaqob amah tawh kha khat a omkhawm hi.
Tua ciangin Laban in Yaaqob kiangah, “Nang pen ka kinaipih na hih ciangin thaman omlo pi-in ka na sem ding na hi hiam? Na thaman ding bang hi ding hiam hong gen in,” a ci hi.
Tu-in Laban in tanu nih nei hi: a uzaw min pen Leah hi a, a nauzaw min pen Rachel ahi hi.
Leah pen a mithah nem a, ahih hangin Rachel pen a duang leh a melpuakzia hoih hi.
Tu-in Yaaqob in Rachel ngai a, amah in, “Na tanu Rachel, nang tungah kum sagih kong thalawh ding hi,” a ci hi.
Laban in “Midang tungah amah ka piak ding sangin nang tungah amah kong piak ding hoihzaw hi,” a ci hi.
Tua ahih manin Yaaqob in Rachel kum sagih sung thalawh a, amah a itna hangin tua hunte ni tawmno khat tawh kibang a sa hi.
Tua khit ciangin Yaaqob in Laban kiangah, “I thukimna hun cingta ahih manin, kei tungah ka zi hong pia in. Tua hileh amah tawh ka omkhawm thei ding hi,” a ci hi.
Laban in tua mun a mi khempeuh kaikhawmin pawi khat a bawl hi.
Tu-in nitak hun hong tun ciangin hici bangin hong hi a, amah in a tanu Leah la-in, Yaaqob kiangah amah a paipih hi. Tua ciangin Yaaqob in amah a luppih hi.
Laban in a tanu Leah kiangah ama nasemnu Zilpah a nasem dingin a pia hi.

Tua ahih manin zingsang ciangin Leah na hi mawk hi. Yaaqob in Laban kiangah, “Bangci a kei hong hici bawl na hi hiam? Rachel aa ding a, hong thalawh hilo ka hi hiam? Tua hi napi bang hangin hong khem na hi hiam?” a ci hi.
Laban in, “A u’ ma-in a nauzaw piak ding pen ko’ gam ah ngeina hi lo hi.
Leah’ nipikal mo hun beisak phot inla, adang kum sagih ka na nong sepsak thamanin Rachel zong nang kong pia ding hi,” a ci hi.
Tua ciangin Yaaqob in tua mah bangin gamta a, Leah’ nipikal mo hun beisak hi. Tua ahih manin Laban in a tanu Rachel zong a zi dingin a pia hi.
Laban in ama nasem numei Bilhah a tanu Rachel kiangah a nasem numei dingin pia hi.
Tua khit ciangin Yaaqob in Rachel zong luppih a, amah in Leah a itna sangin Rachel a itzaw hi. Amah in Laban’ na adang kum sagih a sem lai hi.
Yahweh in Leah a ki-itloh zawkna a muh ciangin, Amah in Leah’ naubu honsak a, ahih hangin Rachel ahihleh ciing hi.

Tua ahih manin Leah gai-a, tapa khat nei-in amin Reuben a phuak hi. Tua pen Tapa khat Mu a cihna ahi hi. Bang hang hiam cihleh amah in, “Yahweh in keima lungkhamna mukhin hi. Tua ahih manin tu-in ka pasal in kei hong it ta ding hi,” a ci hi.

Tua khit ciangin amah gai leuleu a, tapa khat nei in, a gen inah: “Yahweh in kei hong ki-itloh zawkna zakhin ahih manin Amah in hih tapa zong hong piakhin hi,” a ci hi. Amah in a min Simeon a phuak hi. Tua pen Zakhin a cihna ahi hi.

Amah gai leuleu a, tapa khat nei-in, a gen inah: “Amah tawh tapa thum neikhin ka hih manin tu taktakin ka pasal in kei lam hong pawlpih omta ding hi,” a ci hi. Tua ahih manin a min Levi a phuak hi. Tua pen Pawlpih a cihna ahi hi.
Amah gai leuleu-in tapa khat nei a, a gen inah: “Tu-in Yahweh ka phat ding hi,” a ci hi. Tua ahih ciangin amah in a min Yahdah a phuak hi. Tua khit ciangin amah a ta neihna a tawp hi.
Rachel in Yahweh tawh ta a neih lohna a kimuh ciangin, amah in a sanggamnu eng a, Yaaqob kiangah, “Ta hong pia in, tua ahih keileh ka si ding hi!” a ci hi.
Rachel’ tungah Yaaqob a heh suak a, amah in, “Nang ta hong neisak lo Yahweh’ dinmun a om ka hi hiam?” a ci hi.
Tua ahih manin amah in, “Hih mun ah ka nasem numei Bilhah om hi. Amah luppih inla, ka pheitung ah amah in nau khat hong suak ding a, tua hileh ama hangin keimah in ta a nei ka hi ding hi.
Tua ciangin amah in a nasem Bilhah a zi dingin pia a, Yaaqob in tuanu a luppih hi.
Bilhah gai-in Yaaqob tawh tapa khat a nei hi.

Tua ciangin Rachel in, “Yahweh in ka buaina thu hong khensak khin a, Yaaqob in ka thu hong mangin tapa khat hong piakhin,” a ci hi. Tua ahih ciangin amah in a min Dan a phuak hi. Tua pen Thukhen a cihna ahi hi.
Tua ciangin Rachel’ nasem Bilhah gai leuleu a, Yaaqob tawh a nihna tapa khat a nei hi.
Tua ciangin Rachel in, “Nakpi takin ka sanggamnu tawh ka kilaigawp khin a, ka zo hi,” a ci hi. Tua ahih manin amah in a min Naphtali a phuak hi. Tua pen Ka Laigawp a cihna ahi hi.
Leah in ama ta neihna a tawp lam a muh ciangin, amah in a nasem numei Zilpah la-in, Yaaqob tungah zi dingin a pia hi.
Leah nasemnu Zilpah in Yaaqob tawh tapa khat nei hi.
Tua ciangin Leah in, “Galkap hon hong pai hi!” a ci hi. Tua ahih manin amah in a min Gad a phuak hi. Tua pen Galkap Hon a cihna ahi hi.
Leah nasem numei Zilpah in Yaaqob tawh a nihna tapa khat nei hi.
Tua ciangin Leah in, “Kei kipaak ing. Ahang in tanute in thupha ngah hong ci ding uh hi,” a ci hi. Tua ahih manin amah in a min Asher a phuak hi. Tua pen Kipaak a cihna ahi hi.
Mangbuh lak hun laitakin gamlak ah Reuben pai-in zawl-ai kungte mu a, tuate a nu Leah kiangah a puak hi. Tua ciangin Rachel in Leah kiangah, “Na tapa’ zawl-ai kungte hong pia in,” a ci hi.

Ahih hangin amah in Rachel kiangah, “Ka pasal nong suhkhiat thuneu sa na hi hiam? Ka tapa zawl-ai kungte zong hong sutkhia ding na hi hiam?” a ci hi. Rachel in, “Na tapa zawl-ai man dingin tuzan amah nang tawh hong lum ding hi,” a ci hi.

Nitakin lo panin Yaaqob hong ciah ciangin, amah a dawn dingin Leah hong paikhia a, a gen inah: “Kei’ kiangah nong lum hamtang ding hi. Ahang in ka tapa’ zawl-ai kungte tawh nang kong saap khinzo hi. Tua nitak amah tawh Yaaqob a lumkhawm hi.
Yahweh in Leah dawngin a mah gai a, Yaaqob tawh a ngana tapa khat a nei hi.
Leah in, “Ka pasal tungah ka nasem numeite piakhin ka hih manin Yahweh in ka thaman hong pia hi,” a ci hi. Tua ahih manin amah in a min Issachar a phuak hi. Tua pen Thaman a cihna ahi hi.
Tua khit ciangin Leah gai leuleu-in Yaaqob tawh a gukna tapa khat a nei hi.

Leah in, “Yahweh in a manpha citpiakna khat kei hong piakhin hi. Tu-in ka pasal in kei hong pahtawi ding hi. Bang hang hiam cihleh amah tawh tapa guk ka nei hi,” a ci hi. Tua ahih manin amah in a min Zebulun a phuak hi. Tua pen Pahtawina a cihna ahi hi.
Tua nung ciangin amah in tanu khat nei a, a min Dinah a phuak hi. Tua pen Thumanna a cihna ahi hi.
Tua khit ciangin Yahweh in Rachel phawk a, Yahweh a mah dawngin a naubu a honsak hi.
Amah gai-in tapa khat nei a, a gen inah: “Yahweh in kei hong kigensiatna teng hong lakkhiatsak khin hi,” a ci hi.
Tua ahih manin amah in a min Yahseph a phuak a; tua pen Yahweh in Behlap tahen a cihna ahi hi, a gen inah: “Yahweh in kei tungah adang tapa hong behlap tahen,” a ci hi.
Rachel in Yahseph a suah khit ciangin, Yaaqob in Laban kiangah, “Hong paikhiasak in, tua hileh keimah mah inn leh ka gam ah ka ciahkik thei ding hi.
Nang’ tunga kong thalawhsa ka zite leh ka tate kei’ tungah hong pia inla, kei hong paisak in. Ahang in nang aa dingin ka hihsa ka nasepna na thei hi,” a ci hi.
Laban in ama kiangah, “Nangma mit ah maipha ka muh ahihleh, hehpihna tawh khawllai hoh in. Nang hangin Yahweh in kei thupha hong piakkhit lam muhkholhna tawh ka theikhin hi,” a ci hi.
Tua ciangin amah in, “Na thamante hong gen inla keimah in kong pia ding hi,” a ci hi.
Tua ciangin Yaaqob in ama kiangah, “Bangci bangin nangma na’ kasepna leh na ganhingte ka kep sungin bangci bangin tampi pha cih na theih ahi hi.

Kei hong pai ma-in na neihsa a tawmnote nakpitakin khang a, ka hihna khempeuh ah Yahweh in nang thupha hong pia hi. Ahih hangin tu-in keimah mah innkuan aa dingin na khat peuhpeuh cik ciangin ka hih thei ding hiam?” a ci hi.

Tua ahih manin amah in, “Nang bang hong pia ding ka hi hiam?” a ci hi. Tua ciangin Yaaqob in, “Bangmah hong pia kei in. Kei aa dingin hih khat nong hihsak ahih nak leh, na gante vak kikin kong kepsak lai ding hi.

Tuni-in na gante khempeuh lakah a dung gial leh a phei gial tuu khempeuh, a puang tuuno khempeuh, leh keelte lak panin a dung gial khempeuh a tengkhia dingin hong paisak in. Tuate ka thaman hi ding hi,” a ci hi.

Tua ahih manin ka diktatna in kei aa dingin teci hong pang ding hi: ka thaman ngah dingte nang mai-ah hong pai ciangin, keelte lak panin a dung gial leh a phei gial lo ganhing limlim, leh tuunote lak panin a puang lo limlim, kei kiangah a kimuh zenzen leh, guk-in kiseh ding hi,” a ci hi.
Laban in, “Ka thukim hi. Na genna tawh kizui-in tu-in tua bangin hisak in,” a ci hi.

Tua ahih manin a dung gial leh a phei gial tuutal peuhmah, a dung gial leh a phei gial keel a nute khempeuh, amau’ ci tungah a kaang a om khat peuhpeuh, tuunote lak panin a puang khempeuh tua ni-in amah in tuamkoih a, a tapate khut sungah tuate a ap hi.
Tua khit ciangin amah in amah leh Yaaqob kikal ni thum paina-ah gancing a, Yaaqob in Laban’ ganhon a omlai teng a cing hi.

Tua ciangin Yaaqob in poplar kung, almond kung, leh hiangpa kungte’ a hianghingte amah mah aa dingin la a, tua khit ciangin a kang mun a dawk dingin tuate sui a, singhiangte sunga a kaangte a dawksak hi.
Amah in a suihsa singhiangte, ganhonte tuidawnin a hong paina mun gan tuipiakna kuang, ganhonte mai-ah a koih hi. Tua ahih manin amaute tui dawn dingin a pai uh ciangin amaute in a mu uh hi.
Tua ahih manin gante tua singhiangte mai-ah anu leh apa omkhawm uh ahih manin, gante in a dung gial, a phei gial leh a gial bialbual ta nei uh hi.

Yaaqob in amaute lak panin gan a moite tuam koih a, ahih hangin a cianlai pen amah in Laban aa ahi a gial bialbualte leh a vomte lam a ngasak hi. Tua ahih ciangin ama ganhonte a tuamin koihkhia-in, Laban ganhingte tawh a koih khawm kei hi.
Ganhon sung panin a thahat zawte a huk ciangin, tuikuang sung ganhingte mai-ah Yaaqob in tua singhiangte a koih hi. Amaute singhiang nai-ah anu leh apa omkhawm hi.
Ahih hangin a ginalo ganhingte ahihleh, amaute mai-ah tuate Yaaqob in a koih kei hi. Tua ahih manin a ginalote Laban aa hi a, a thahat-te Yaaqob aa ahi hi.
Hih bang dan tawh Yaaqob nakpitakin hong hau a, ganhon lianpite, numei nasemte, pasal nasemte, kalaohte leh laate a nei hi.
Tu-in Yaaqob in Laban’ tapate kammalte za-in, a gen inah: “I pa’ neihsa khempeuh Yaaqob in la gai a, i pa’ neihsa tung pan amah in hih hauhna khempeuh ngah hi,” a ci uh hi.
Laban in ama tunga a lungsim ngaihsutzia nidang a bat nawn lohna Yaaqob in a mu hi.
Tua ciangin Yahweh in Yaaqob kiangah, “Na pate gam leh na behte’ kiangah ciahkik in, nang Kong ompih ding hi,” a ci hi.
Tua ahih manin Yaaqob pai-in ganhonte omna gamlak ah Rachel leh Leah sam a,
amaute kiangah, “Na pa’ lungsim ngaihsutzia ka mu a, tua pen kei tungah nidang bang nawn lo hi. Ahih hangin ka pa’ i Pa, Yahweh in kei hong ompih lai hi.
Ka tha neih khempeuh tawh na pa’ na ka sepna note in na thei uh hi;
Ahi zongin na pa un kei hong khemin, ka thaman sawm vei khelkhin a, ahih hangin kei hong gimsak ding Yahweh in amah phallo hi.

Amah in, ‘A dung gial khempeuh na thaman ding hi,’ a cih leh ganhonte in a dung gial vive ta nei uh hi. Amah in, ‘A gial bialbual khempeuh na thaman ding hi,’ a cih ciangin ganhonte khempeuh in a gial leplap ta nei uh hi.
Tua ahih manin Yahweh in na pa ganhing khempeuh lakkhiatsak khin a, tuate kei tungah hong piakhin hi.
Tu-in tuute ta neih hun ahih mah bangin, ka khuadak to a tuuhonte laka a diang tuutalte khempeuh pen a gial bialbual, a dung gial, leh a puang-gial ahihna ka mang sungah ka mu hi.
Tua khit ciangin Yahweh’ vantungmi in mang sungah kei hong hopih a, ‘Yaaqob,’ a ci hi. Tua ciangin keimah in, ‘Hiah ka om hi,’ ka ci hi.

Tua ciangin Amah in, ‘Tu-in khuadak inla, en in: tuuhonte laka a diang tuutalte khempeuh pen a gial bialbual, a dung gial, leh a puang-gial vive ahi hi. A hangin Laban in nang’ tunga hong bawlna khempeuh Ka muzo hi.

Kei pen nangmah in khuam khat sathau nilhin Kei’ tungah thuciamna khat na bawlna mun Beth Yahweh; Yahweh Inn, pana Yahweh Ka hi hi. Tu-in tho inla hih gam panin paikhia-in na behte gam ah ciahkik in,’ hong ci hi,” a ci hi.
Tua tak ciangin Rachel leh Leah in dawng a, ama kiangah, “Ka pa’ inn ah eite aa dingin tanh khat peuh ahi a luah ding ahi zongin a omlai hiam?”
Yaaqob hangin eite gamdangmi bangin hong ngaihsun hilo ahi hiam? Bang hang hiam cihleh amah in eite hong zuakkhin a, eite aa ding a hong kipia teng zang mang khin hi.
Ka pa uh kiang panin Yahweh in a lakkhiatsa hih hauhnate khempeuh eite aa leh i tate aa ahi hi. Yahweh in nang kiangah hong gen bangbang hih in,” a ci uh hi.
Tua ciangin Yaaqob ding a, a tapate leh a zite kalaohte tungah a tuangsak hi.
Amah in ama ganhing khempeuh leh amah in Padan Aram panin a ngahsa ama neihsa khempeuh Canaan gam sunga a pa Isaac kiangah pai dingin a puakhin hi.
Laban in ama tuumul met dingin paikhia a, Rachel in tua kalin a pa’ innsung pasiante (teraphim) a gu hi.
Tua bek tham loin, Yaaqob in Aram mi Laban khem a, a tai sawmna amah in gen lo hi.
Tua ciangin ama neihsa khempeuh tawh amah tai hi. Amah dingkhia a, gun khat kantanin Gilead gam lam a manawh hi.
Yaaqob a taina thu a ni thum ni-in Laban kiangah kigen hi.
Tua tak ciangin amah in ama behte samin ni sagih sung Yaaqob a delh a, Gilead gam mual tungah a pha uh hi.
Ahih hangin Aram mi Laban kiang zanin a mang sungah Yahweh na paikhin a, ama kiangah, “Yaaqob kiangah thuphate hitaleh samsiatnate hitaleh na genna ah na kampauna kidawm mahmah in,” a ci hi.
Tua ciangin Laban in Yaaqob pha hi. Tu-in mual tungah Yaaqob in a puanbuk lam a, Laban leh ama behte in Gilead gam mual tungah phual a sat uh hi.
Tua tak ciangin Laban in Yaaqob kiangah, “Nangmah in kei hong khemin namsau tawh galmat bangin ka tanute paikhiatpih dingin a bangci gamtat na hi hiam?
Simtham takin bang hangin taisimin kei kiang panin gu-in kei hong khem na hi hiam? Lungdamna leh laate tawh, khuang leh laza tawh nang hong kha thei hilo ka hi hiam?
Ka tapate leh ka tanute nong namsak kei hi. Tu-in na hai gamtat mahmah khin hi.

Na siatna ding ka hih thei a, ahih hang in na pa’ Pa, Yahweh in kei kiangah zan nitakin thu hong gen a, a gen inah: “Yaaqob kiangah thuphate hitaleh samsiatnate na genna ah na kampauna kidawm mahmah in,” hong ci hi.
Tu-in nang in na pa’ inn nakpitakin lunggulh na hih manin na paikhia khinta hi. Ahih hangin bang hangin ka pasiante (elohim) gu na hi hiam?” a ci hi.
Tua tak ciangin Yaaqob in dawng a, Laban kiangah, “Kei kiang panin na tanute zawhthawh thutawh nong sutkhia ding hi ci-in ngaihsun kha ka hih manin ka lau mahmah hi.

Ahih hangin na pasiante (elohim) na muhna mi peuhpeuh kithat tahen! I behte’ muhna ah kei neihsa khat peuh nang neihsa hi na cih a om leh tua pen la in,” a ci hi. Ahang in Rachel in tua pasiante (elohim) a guk lam Yaaqob in thei lo hi.

Tua ciangin Yaaqob’ puanbuk sung, Leah’ puanbuk sung, leh nasem numei tenih puanbukte sungah Laban lut a, ahih hangin amah in a pasiante (elohim) mu lo hi. Tua tak ciangin Leah puanbuk sung panin amah pusuak a, Rachel paunbuk sungah a lut hi.
Tu-in Rachel in tua innsung pasiante (teraphim) na lakhin ta a, kalaoh tutphah sungah tuate koih-in a tungah a tu hi. Laban in puanbuk sung khempeuh zonga ahih hangin amah in tuate a mu kei hi.

Tua ciangin Rachel in a pa’ kiangah, “Na mai-ah kong din zawh lohna hangin heh kei in, ka pa aw; bang hang hiam cihleh numei ngeina ka neih laitak ahi hi,” a ci hi. Amah in a zon hangin a innsung pasiante (teraphim) a mu zo kei hi.
Tua tak ciangin Yaaqob heh a, Laban mawksakin, Yaaqob in Laban kiangah, “Kei hong nung delhin sabet bangin nong bet na dingin ka khialhna bang hi a, ka mawhna bang ahi hiam?
Ka van khempeuh na zonkhiat hangin na innsung nate bang mu na hi hiam? Keima behte leh nang ma behte mai-ah tuate hong koih khia in, eite nih kikalah amaute thukhensak ding hi hang.
Hih kum sawmnih sung nang tawh ka om khawm khin a, na tuupite leh na keelpite tatolh nai lo a na tuuhonte’ sung pan tuutal sa ka ne ngei nai kei hi.
Gamsate’ balzante, nang’ kiangah kong puak kei a, tua supnate kei mahmah in ka thuak hi. Sun-a kigu ahi a, zan-a kigu ahi zongin tuate kei nong lohsak hi.
Kei pen hi bang ka hi hi! Sunin nisa in hong kangin zanin a vot in hong tawp a, ka ihmu thei kei hi.

Hih kum sawmnih sung nangma na semin na innkuan sungah hih bangin ka omkhin hi. Na tanu tenih kum sawm le kum li sung kong thalawh a, na ganhon kum guk sung kong thalawh hi. Nangmah in ka thamante sawm vei na khel hi.

Vantung a om ka pate Pa; ka pa Abraham’ Pa leh ka pa Isaac i a Zahtak, Yahweh—in kei hong ompih hi kei leh, nangmah in khut hawmguakin kei nong sawlkhia ding hi. Ahih hangin Yahweh in ka haksatna leh ka nasepna mukhin a, Amah in zan nitakin nang hong thuhilh hi.

Tua ciangin Laban in dawng a, Yaaqob kiangah, “Hih nupite pen ka tanute hi a, hih a tate pen ka tate ahih banah hih ganhonte pen ka ganhonte ahi hi. Na muh khempeuh pen kei aa hi. Ahih hangin tu ni-in hih ka tanute hitaleh amau’ sung pana piang naupangte’ tungah hitaleh ken bang cih thei ding ka hi hiam?
Tua ahih manin tu-in, hong pai inla, nang leh kei in thuciamna khat bawlin, nang leh kei’ kikalah teci khat hisak ni,” a ci hi.
Tua ahih ciangin Yaaqob in suang khat la a, khuam khat bangin a phut hi.
Tua tak ciangin Yaaqob in ama behte kiangah, “Suangte kaikhawm un,” a ci hi. Amaute in suangte la-in suangcian khat bawl uh a, tua suangcian tungah an a ne uh hi.

Laban in tua pen Yegar Sahadutha ci-in min a vawh hi. Aaramaic pau-in tua pen Teci Suangcian a cihna ahi hi. Ahih hangin Yaaqob in tua pen Galeed ci-in min a vawh hi. Hebrew pau in Teci Suangcian a cihna ahi hi.
Tua ciangin Laban in, “Tu ni a hih suangcian pen nang leh kei kikalah teci khat ahi hi. Tua ahih manin a min Galeed kici a,
Mizpah; tua pen En a cihna ahi hi, zong kici hi. Bang hang hiam cihleh amah a cih inah, “Eite khatlekhat i tuam om ciangin Yahweh in nang leh kei kikalah hong en gige tahen.
Ka tanute na bawlsiat a, ka tanute’ tang dingin zi la-in, eite tawh kuamah om kei ngawn e na cih leh, nang leh kei kikalah teci Yahweh a om lam phawk in!” a ci hi.
Tua tak ciangin Laban in Yaaqob kiangah, “Hih suangcian hiah om a, nang leh kei kikal a ka koihsa hih khuam khat zong hiah om hi!

Siatna bawl dingin keimah in hih suangcian khengin nang kiangah kong pai loh nading, nang zong hih suangcian leh khuam khengin kei kiangah nong pai loh nadingin hih suangcian pen teci khat hi a, hih khuam pen teci khat ahi hi.
Abraham leh Nahor’ Vanglian Yahweh, amau pate Vantung Pa in eite kikalah thu hong khenta hen,” a ci hi. Tua ciangin Yaaqob in ama pa Isaac’ Zahtak Pa tawh a kiciam hi.
Tua tak ciangin mual tungah Yaaqob in meihal biakpiakna khat pia a, ama a behte an ne dingin a sam hi. Amaute in an ne uh a, zan tawntungin mual tungah a om uh hi.
Zingsang tungin Laban tho a, a tapate leh a tanute namin amaute thupha a pia hi. Tua tak ciangin tua mun panin Laban paikhia-in ama inn ah a ciahkik hi.
Tua ahih ciangin Yaaqob ama pai nading ah pai a, Yahweh’ vantungmite in amah a dawn hi.
Yaaqob in amaute a muh ciangin, amah in, “Hih pen Yahweh’ giahphual hi!” a ci hi. Tua ahih ciangin tua mun min pen Mahanaim a ci hi. Tua pen Giahphual Nih a cihna ahi hi.
Tua tak ciangin Edom gam Seir leitang a om a sanggampa Esau kiangah Yaaqob in ama mai-ah kamtaite a sawl hi.
Yaaqob in amaute thupia a, “Ka sanggampa Esau kiangah note in hih bangin na gen ding uh hi: Na nasempa Yaaqob in, “Laban tawh ka om a, tua mun ah tu dongin ka om lai hi.
Keimah in bawngtalte, laate, tuuhonte, nasem pasalte, nasem numeite ka nei a, na maipha ka ngah nadingin ka sanggampa tungah gen dingin kong sawl hi, ci hi’, ci un,” a ci hi.
Tua tak ciangin kamtai khat Yaaqob kiangah hong kilehkik a, “Na sanggampa Esau kiangah kote ka pai uh a, amah zong nang hong dawn dingin amah tawh mi 400 hong pai uh hi,” a ci hi.
Tua tak ciangin Yaaqob nak lau mahmah a, a lungkham mahmah hi. Tua ciangin amah in amah tawh a om mite, tuuhonte, ganhonte, leh kalaohte pawl nihin khen a,
amah in, “Esau pawl khat kiangah hong pai-in a do leh, adang pawlkhat suakta ding hi,” a ci hi.

Tua tak ciangin Yaaqob in thungen a, “Vantung a om ka pa Abraham’ Pa, Vantung a om ka pa Isaac Pa, keima kianga, ‘Na gam leh na behte kiangah ciahkik in; nang’ tungah hoihna kong bawl ding hi,’ hong ci Yahweh aw,

kei pen na itna kip khempeuh lak pan a neupen leh na nasempa tunga nong lahsa na thumannate khempeuh tawh kei ka kilawm kei hi. Bang hang hiam cihleh ka ciangkhut guak tawh hih Yardan ka kantan a, ahi zongin tu-in pawl nih ka suak khinta hi.
Ka sanggampa’ khut Esau khut panin kei hong khahkhia in, kong thuum hi. Ahang in amah hong pai-in kei leh naupangte tawh a nute hong do ding ka lau hi.
Bang hang hiam cihleh Nangmah in, ‘Nang Kong khangsak taktak dinga, na suanlekhakte a phazah a kisim zolo tuipi sehnel bangin Ka bawl ding hi,’ ci-in nong ciam khin hi,” a ci hi.
Tua ahih ciangin tua mun ah amah giak a, a sanggampa Esau aa dingin a neih bangbang citpiakna dingin la a:
keelpi 200 leh keeltal 20, tuupi 200 leh tuutal 20,
a no tawh a om kalaoh a nu 30, bawngpi 40, bawngtal 10, laa anu 20 leh laa apa 10 ahi hi.
Tua tak ciangin amah in hihte a nasemte’ khut sungah amau’ hon ciatin pia a, ama nasemte kiangah, “Ka mai-ah na paisuak unla, hon khat leh hon khat kikal kihalsak un,” a ci hi.

Amah in a masate kiangah thupia a, “Ka sanggampa Esau in nang hong dawn ciangin, thu hong dongin, ‘Note kua aa na hi uh hiam, koi-a pai ding na hi uh hiam, na mai uha om hih ganhingte kua-a’ ahi hiam?’ a cih leh,
tua tak ciangin note in ama kiangah, ‘Hihte pen na nasempa Yaaqob aa hi. Hihte pen ka ukpa Esau kiangah citpiakna-in hong kipuak ahi hi. En in, amah zong eite nung ah om hi,” ci un a ci hi.
Amah in a nihna, a thumna leh ganhonte a zui khempeuh zong hilh a, “Amah tawh na kituah uh ciangin Esau’ kiangah a hih bangmah in na gen ding uh a,

en in, na nasempa Yaaqob eite nungah om hi,” ci un a ci hi. Ahang in Yaaqob in ama ngaihsutna ah, “Ka mai-a pai citpiaknate tawh amah ka lungkimsak kha thei ding a, tua banah amah ka muh ciangin kei hong sang kha thei ding hi,” a ci hi.
Tua ahih manin ama mai-ah citpiaknate pai masa a, ahih hangin amah pen tua zan giahphual ah a om lai hi.
Tua zanin amah tho a, a zi tenih, a numei nasem tenih, leh a tapa sawm le khatte samin, Yabbok’ lui a thuk lohna mun ngap-in a kantan hi.
Amah in amaute paipih-in lui galkhat ah puak a, tua mah bangin a neih khempeuh zong a puak hi.
Tua tak ciangin Yaaqob amah bek om lai a, zingsang khuavak dongin Mi khat in amah a lai hi.
Tua tak ciangin Amah in Yaaqob a zawh loh lam a theih ciangin, Amah in Yaaqob’ khelkom sung suksak a, tua bangin a kilaina hangin Yaaqob’ khelguh a kilawi hi.
Mipa in, “Khua vakta ahih ciangin hong khah in,” a ci hi. Ahih hangin amah in, “Kei thupha nong piak kei leh kong khah kei ding hi,” a ci hi.
Tua ahih manin Mipa in ama kiangah, “Na min bang hiam?” a ci hi. Amah in, “Yaaqob,” a ci hi.
Mipa in, “Na min Yaaqob; tua pen A Suankhiapa a cihna ahi hi, kici nawn lo ding a, Israyl kici ding hi. Bang hang hiam cihleh nang pen Yahweh leh mite tawh na kilai khin a, na zo hi,” a ci hi.

Tua tak ciangin Yaaqob in Amah dong a, “Na min hong gen in, kong dong hi,” a ci hi. Tua ciangin Amah in, “Bang hangin nangmah in Ka min hong dong na hi hiam?” a ci hi. Tua tak ciangin tua mun ah Amah in Israyl thupha a pia hi.
Yaaqob in tua mun min pen Peniyl a phuak hi. Tua pen Yahweh’ Mai a cihna ahi hi. “Ahang in Yahweh tawh kimaingatin ka mukhin a, ka nuntakna hong kisuaktasak hi,” a ci hi.
Amah khelbai-in Peniyl a khenkhit ciangin ama tung lamah ni a suak hi.
Tua ahih ciangin tu ni dongin Israyl mite in khelkom tunga a om khel tha-gui ne lo uh hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh Amah in Yaaqob’ khelkom, a khel tha-gui a suksak hi.
Tu-in Yaaqob khuadak a, Esau hong paina leh amah tawh mi 400 hong paina a mu hi. Tua ahih manin Leah, Rachel, leh nasem numei tenih lakah naupangte amah in a khen hi.
Amah in nasem numeite leh a tate a masa penin, tua ciangin Leah leh a tate a nungah, tua ciangin Rachel leh Yahseph a nunung pen ah a koih hi.
Tua tak ciangin amah in amaute teng khengphei-in a sanggampa’ kiang a tun matengin leilak lamah sagih vei a kun hi.
Tua tak ciangin amah a dawn dingin Esau hong tai-in amah angpom a, amah ngawngkawi-in nam a, amaute a kap uh hi.
Tua ciangin Esau khuadak a, nupite leh naupangte mu a, a gen inah: “Nang tawh a om hihte kua hiam?” a ci hi. Yaaqob in, “Amaute pen Yahweh in hehpihna tawh na nasempa a piak tate ahi hi.
Tua tak ciangin nasem numeite hong naih uh a, amaute leh a tate hong kunsuk uh hi.
Leah leh a tate in zong tua bangmahin hong naihin a kunsuk uh hi. Tua khit ciangin Yahseph leh Rachel in hong naihin a kunsuk uh hi.
Tua tak ciangin Esau in, “Ka kituahpih hih ganhing honte khempeuh bang na cihnopna ahi hiam?” a ci hi. Yaaqob in dawngin, “Ka sanggampa’ maipha muh nadingin tuate citpiakna ahi hi,” a ci hi.
Ahih hangin Esau in, “A kicingin ka nei hi, ka sanggampa aw; nang neihte’ nang aa dingin kem in,” a ci hi.

Ahih hangin Yaaqob in, “Hilo hi, hong thum ing. Keimah in na maipha mu ka hih leh, ka khut panin kong citpiaknate hong sang in. Bang hang hiam cihleh hih banga maipha tawh kei nong sanna, na maitang ka muh ding pen Yahweh’ maitang muh tawh kibang hi.
Hong thum ing. Nang kianga kong paipih citpiaknate hong sang in. Bang hang hiam cihleh Yahweh in kei tungah siit het loin hong piakkhitna leh ka kisap khempeuh ka neihkhitna hang ahi hi,” a ci hi.
Tua tak ciangin Esau in, “I pai nading ah kithawi-in pai ni, kei na mai-ah ka pai ding hi,” a ci hi.

Ahih hangin Yaaqob in ama kiangah, “Naupangte a hat lohna ka sanggampa in na thei a, a nongek nei tuuhonte leh ganhonte kei tawh om a, mite in ni khat thu-in hawl hileh, ganhon khempeuh si mang kha ding hi.

Hehpihna tawh, ka sanggampa a nasempa mai-ah hong pai masa in. Seir ah ka sanggampa kiang kong tun matengin, kei tawh a om ganhingte’ kalsuanna leh naupangte hatna bangin damtakin kong makaih ding hi,” a ci hi.

Tua tak ciangin Esau in, “Kei tawh a om mite pawlkhat, nang tawh hong nusia ning,” a ci hi. Ahih hangin amah in, “A kisapna bang om ahi hiam? Na mai panin maipha hong musak peuh lecin phazo hi, ka sanggam aw,” a ci hi.
Tua ahih manin tua ni-in Esau ama pai nading Seir ah a ciahkik hi.
Ahih hangin Yaaqob pen Succoth ah pai a, ama aa ding inn khat lamin, ama ganhingte aa ding hampheng a bawl hi. Tua ahih ciangin tua mun min pen Succoth a phuak hi. Tua pen Hampheng a cihna ahi hi.
Tua tak ciangin Padan Aram panin amah a pai ciangin Canaan gam sung Shechem khuapi ah lungmuang takin Yaaqob hong tung a, a khuapi galmual ah amah in ama puanbuk a lam hi.
Amah in Shechem’ pa Hamor’ tate’ tung panin a puanbuk lamnasa leitang ngun tang 100 tawh a lei hi.
Tua tak ciangin amah in tua mun ah biaknatau khat lam a, Thahatna pen Israyl’ Pa hi, a ci hi.
Tu-in Leah in Yaaqob tawh a neih ama tanu Dinah tua gam numeite kiangah va hawh hi.
Tua mun a uk ahi Hiv mi Hamor tapa in amah mu a, amah manin luppih a, a susia hi.
Ama lungsim ah Yaaqob tanu Dinah bek om a, amah in nungakno nu ngai-in awnem takin nungakno nu a hopih hi.
Tua ahih manin Shechem in a pa Hamor kiangah, “Hih nungakno nu ka zi dingin hong laksak in,” a ci hi.
Tua ciangin Yaaqob in a tanu Dinah a kinitsak khitna a za hi. Tu-in a tapate a ganhingte tawh gamlakah om a, tua ahih manin amaute hong tun matengin Yaaqob kilem takin a om hi.
Tua tak ciangin Yaaqob kiangah Shechem’ pa Hamor hong pai a, amah tawh a kiho hi.

Yaaqob’ tapate in a zak ciangin, amaute gamlak panin hong ciah uh hi. A gamtat huai hetlo na ahi Yaaqob’ tanu tawh lumin Israyl langpangin a sia na a gamtat khitna hangin, amaute in nasa-in heh mahmah uh hi.
Ahih hangin Hamor in amaute kiangah, “Na tanu uh aa dingin ka tapa’ lungsim pen duai hi. Zi dingin nungakno nu ama tungah hong pia unla,
kote tawh kitenna hong bawl un. Na tanute uh kote tungah hong pia unla, ko tanute note kiangah la un.
Tua ahih manin kote lakah nong teng ding uh a, note aa dingin leitang kiphal ding hi. Tua sungah tengin sum bawl unla, note aa dingin neih-le-lam zong un,” a ci hi.
Tua tak ciangin Shechem in Dinah’ pa leh a sanggamte kiangah, “Note mai-ah maipha hong musak unla, kei’ tungah nong cih peuhpeuh uh kong pia ding hi.
Moman-in na tampi leh citpiakna tampite seh unla, note nong cihna tawh kizui-in kong pia ding hi. Ahih hangin nungakno nu pen zi dingin hong pia un,” a ci hi.
Tua tak ciangin amah in amaute sanggamnu Dinah ninsak khin ahih manin Yaaqob tapate in Shechem leh a pa Hamor dawngin khemna tawh a ho uh hi.
Amaute in amaute kiangah, “Vun ki-at lo khat tungah ka sanggamnu uh ka piak ding cih hih bang pen kote in ka hih thei kei uh hi. Ahang in tua pen kote aa dingin a daihuai khat ahi hi,” a ci uh hi.
Thu om dan khat bek kote in note tungah ka thukim ding uh hi. Note khempeuh kote tawh kibangin, note lak a pasal khempeuh vun a ki-at leh,
tua tak ciangin kote in ka tanute uh note tungah kong pia ding uh a, note tanute kote kiangah ka la ding uh hi. Tua ciangin kote note lakah kong teng ding uh a, eite minam khat i suak ding hi.
Ahih hangin note in ka thu uh hong ngai loin, vun na ki-at kei uh leh, tua tak ciangin kote in ka tanu uh la-in, ka paikhia ding uh hi,” a ci hi.
Amau’ thugente in Hamor leh Hamor tapa Shechem lungdamsak hi.

Tua ahih manin tangvalpa pen Yaaqob’ tanu tawh lungkim mahmah ahih manin amaute genna bangin gamtat ding pen amah in zekaisak lo hi. Tangvalpa pen a pa’ innkuanpih sung khempeuh ah a kipahtawi pen zong ahi hi.
Hamor leh a tapa Shechem amaute khuapi kulh kongpi ah hong pai in, amau khua mite kiangah,

Hih mite pen eite tawh kilem takin om uh hi. Tua ahih ciangin amaute i gam sungah tengsakin, tua sungah summet bawlsak ni. Ahang in amaute aa dingin leitang pen kicing takin zai hi. Eite kiangah amau tanute’ zi dingin la-in, ei tanute amaute tungah pia ni.
Amaute tawh i tenkhop thei nading leh minam khat i suah theih nadingin, hih thu om dan khat bek tawh amaute thukim ding hi. Amaute vun a ki-at bangin eite laka pasal peuhmah vun a ki-at ding ahi hi.
Amaute ganhon, amaute neihlelam, leh amaute ganhing peuhmah eite aa ahi ding hilo ahi hiam? Amaute tawh eite thukim hoh ni, tua hileh amaute eite lakah hong teng ding uh hi,” a ci uh hi.
Ama khuapi khulh kongpi pana a paikhia khempeuh pen Hamor leh a tapa Shechem tawh thukim uh a, ama khuapi kulh kongpi pana a paikhia pasal khempeuh a vun ki-at uh hi.

Tua tak ciangin ni thum ni-in amaute nasakna tawh a om uh ciangun Yaaqob tapa nih, Dinah’ sanggam pasalte ahi Simeon leh Levi in amau namsau ciat la-in, hangsan takin khuapi sungah hong pai uh a, pasal khempeuh a that uh hi.
Hamor leh a tapa Shechem amaute in namsau hiam tawh a that uh a, Shechem’ innte panin Dinah la-in, tua mun panin a paikhia uh hi.
Mi kithahna mun ah tua ciangin Yaaqob tapate hong pai uh a, amaute sanggamnu a kinitsakna khuapi a buluh uh hi.
Amaute tuute, amaute bawngtalte, amaute laate, a khuapi sunga a om peuhmah leh a gam sunga a om peuhmah a la uh hi.
Amaute hauhna khempeuh a laksak uh hi. A naupangte khempeuh leh a zite khempeuh amaute in salin man a, a inn sungte a om na khempeuh buluh-in a laksak uh hi.

Tua tak ciangin Yaaqob in Simeon leh Levi kiangah, “Hih gam-a teng Canaan mite leh Periz mite lakah a kih-huai khat bangin nong gamtatna uh tawh note in kei’ tungah buaina nong tun uh hi. Kei pen tawmno khat bek ka hi a, amaute kei langah kigawmin pangkhawm leh, kei hong thatlum ding uh hi. Kei leh ka innkuanpihte hong susia ding uh hi,” a ci hi.
Ahih hangin amaute in, “Amah in ka sanggamnu uh numei kizuak bangin a bawl ding kilawmsa na hi hiam?” a ci uh hi.

Tua tak ciangin Yahweh in Yaaqob kiangah, “Dingto-in Beth Yahweh ah paito inla tuamun ah om in. Na sanggampa Esau mai panin na tai lai-in nang tungah hong kilang Yahweh tungah biaknatau khat lam in,” a ci hi.
Yaaqob in ama innkuanpih tung leh amah tawh a om khempeuh tungah, “Note laka gamdang pasiante (elohim) khempeuh paimang un! No le no kisiansuah unla, na puansilhte uh laih un.

Tua tak ciangin dingto-in Beth Yahweh ah paito ni. Ka lungkham hun-in hong dawng a, ka paikhiat khit a kipan lam tawntung ah kei hong ompih Yahweh kiang tua mun ah biaknatau khat ka bawl ding hi,” a ci hi.
Tua ahih manin amaute khut sunga om pasiante (elohim) khempeuh leh amaute bil-a om bilbahte khempeuh Yaaqob kiangah amaute in pia a, Shechem khua kiang-a singkung nuai-ah Yaaqob in tuate a sel hi.
Amaute zin uh a, Yahweh’ lipkhap-huai launa amaute kiimkot khuapite tungah tung ahih manin tua mun mite in Yaaqob’ tapate a delh nawn kei uh hi.
Tua ahih manin Yaaqob leh a tonpih mi khempeuh Canaan gam sung Luz ah a tung uh hi.
Amah in tua mun ah biaknatau khat lam a, tua mun pen Beth Yahweh a phuak hi, bang hang hiam cihleh a sanggampa Esau mai panin amah a taikhiat ciangin ama kiang tua mun ah Yahweh a kilang hi.
Tu-in Rebekah a donnu ahi Deborah si a, Beth Yahweh khanglam-a singkungpi nuai ah amah kivui hi. Tua ahih manin tua’ min pen Allon Bachuth a phuak hi. Tua pen Kahna Singkung Lianpi a cihna ahi hi.
Padan Aram panin Yaaqob a kilehkik ciangin, amah kiangah Yahweh kilangkik a, amah thupha a pia hi;

Yahweh in ama kiangah, “Na min pen Yaaqob hi, ahih hangin nang pen Yaaqob ci-in hong kisam nawn lo ding a; tua pen Amah in Khetul Man, Amah in Khem, A Suankhiapa a cihna ahi hi; na min Israyl kici ding hi. Tua pen Yahweh Uk bangin Uk a cihna ahi hi. Tua ahih manin Amah in Israyl a phuak hi.
Yahweh in ama kiangah, “Na pate i Vanglian Pa, Keimah Yahweh Ka hi hi. Pung inla tampi pha in. Nang sung panin minam khat leh minam honkhat piang ding a, nang’ pumpi panin kumpite piang ding hi.
Abraham leh Isaac tungah Ka piak leitang, nang tung leh nang khit a na suanlekhakte tungah zong Ka pia hi.
Tua tak ciangin amah tawh a kihona mun ama kiang panin Yahweh in a paitohsan hi.
Tua ahih manin Amah in a hopihna mun ah Yaaqob in khuam khat phut a, suang khuampi khat ahi hi. Amah in tua tungah dawn-a biakna sung a, amah in sathau zong a buak hi.
Yaaqob in amah tawh Yahweh a kihona mun pen Beth Yahweh ci-in a phuak hi.
Tua tak ciangin Beth Yahweh panin amaute a kipankhia uh hi. Amaute Ephrath panin a gamla sim pian mun a tun uh ciangin, Rachel nausuak ding hong kipanin nakpitakin a gim hi.
Amah nausuak ding haksa a sak mahmah laitakin naudom nu in ama kiangah, “Lau kei in, tapa dang khat na nei ding hi,” a ci hi.
Amah si dektak ta a, si ding ahih manin amah in a tapa’ min Ben-Oni phuak a, tua pen ka Dahna Tapa a cih na ahi hi, ahih hangin a pa in Benyamin a phuak hi. Tua pen Ka Muan Tapa a cih na ahi hi.
Tua bangin Rachel sita a, Ephrath (Tua pen Bethlehem ahi hi) lampi ah a kivui hi.
Ama han tungah Yaaqob in khuam khat phut a, tu ni dongin tua khuam pen Rachel’ han ciaptehna ahi hi.
Tua tak ciangin Israyl kipankhia leuleu a, Migdal (tausang) Eder khen ah a puanbuk a lam hi.
Tua gam sungah Israyl a om laitakin, Reuben pai-in a pa’ zineu Bilhah luppih a, Israyl in tua thu a za hi. Tu-in Yaaqob in tapa sawm le nih nei hi:
Leah’ tapate: Yaaqob’ ta masa pen Reuben, Simeon, Levi, Yahdah, Issachar, leh Zebulun hi a;
Rachel’ tapate pen Yahseph leh Benyamin hi a;
Rachel’ nasem numei Bilhah’ tapate pen Dan leh Naphatali hi a;
Leah’ nasem numei Zilpah tapate pen Gad leh Asher ahi hi. Hihte pen Padan Aram panin Yaaqob in a neih ama tapate ahi hi.
Tua tak ciangin Abraham leh Isaac a om ngeina mun Mamre ahih kei leh Kiryaht-Arba (Tua pen Hebron ahi hi) mun-a ama pa Isaac kiang, a inn ah Yaaqob a ciah hi.
Tu-in Isaac’ dam sung pen kum 180 ahi hi.
Tua ahih manin Isaac in a hutawpna sangin khangham leh kum cingin si a, a mipihte kiangah kigawm-in a tapa Esau leh Yaaqob in a vui hi.
Hihte pen Edom zong ahi Esau suanlekhakte ahi hi.
Esau in Canaan numeite a zite-in la-a, a zite pen: Hiv mi Elon tanu Adah, Hiv mi Zibeon’ tanu ahi Anah’ tanu Aholibamah leh,
Ishmayl’ tanu ahi Nebayoth’ sanggamnu Bashemath ahi hi.
Tu-in Adah in Esau tawh Eliphaz nei a, Bashemath in Reuel a nei hi.
Aholibamah in Yeush, Yaalam leh Korah a nei hi. Hihte pen Canaan gam sung pana Esau in a neih a tapate ahi hi.

Tua tak ciangin Esau in a zite, a tapate, a tanute, leh ama innkuan sung mi khempeuh, ama gankhawite leh ama ganhingte khempeuh, Canaan gam pana a ngah ama neih-le-lam khempeuh la-in, a sanggampa Yaaqob om na panin a gamla, gam khat ah a pai hi.
Amaute a om khawm dingin a neih-le-lamte uh lianlua a, amaute gankhawite hangin amaute a omkhop ciangin leitang in vaak zo lo hi.
Tua ahih manin Seir gam mual tungah Esau a teng hi. Esau pen Edom ahi hi.
Hihte pen Seir Mual panin Edom mite pianna pupi Esau suanlekhakte ahi hi.
Hihte pen Esau tapate min ahi hi: Esau zi Adah tapa Eliphaz leh Esau zi Bashemath tapa Reuel ahi hi.
Eliphaz tapate pen Teman, Omar, Zepho, Gatam leh Kenaz ahi hi.
Tu-in Timna pen Esau’ tapa Eliphaz zineu hi a, amah in Eliphaz tawh Amalek a nei hi. Hihte pen Esau zi Adah tapate ahi hi.
Hihte pen Reuel tapate: Nahath, Zerah, Shammah, leh Mizzah ahi hi. Hihte pen Esau zi Bashemath tapate ahi hi.
Hihte pen Zibeon’ tanu Anah’tanu ahi Esau’ zi Aholibamah tapate ahi hi. Amah in Esau tawh Yeush, Yaalam, leh Korah a nei hi.
Hihte pen Esau’ tapate laka ukpite ahi hi. Esau ta masa Eliphaz’ tapate pen Ukpi Teman, Ukpi Omar, Ukpi Zepho,
Ukpi Korah, Ukpi Catam, leh Ukpi Amalek ahi hi. Amaute pen Edom gam sunga Eliphaz’ ukpite ahi hi. Amaute pen Adah tapate ahi uh hi.
Hihte pen Esau’ tapa Reuel’ tapate: Ukpi Zerah, Ukpi Shammah, leh Ukpi Mizzah ahi hi. Hihte pen Edom gam sunga Reuel’ ukpite ahi uh hi. Hihte pen Esau’ zi Bashemath’ tapate ahi uh hi.
Hihte pen Esau’ zi Aholibamah’ tapate: Ukpi Yeush, Ukpi Yaalam, leh Ukpi Korah ahi uh hi. Hihte pen Anah’ tanu Esau’ zi Aholibamah pana hong piang ukpite ahi uh hi.
Hihte pen Edom kici Esau tapate leh amaute ukpite ahi hi.
Hihte pen tua kiim-a teng Hori mi Seir’ tapate: Lotan, Shobal, Zibeon, Anah,
Dishon, Ezer, leh Dishan ahi hi. Hihte pen Edom gam sunga Seir tapate ahi Hori mite’ ukpite ahi uh hi.
Latan tapate pen Hori leh Hemam ahi hi. Lotan’ sanggamnu pen Timna ahi hi.
Hihte pen Shobal tapate: Alvan, Manahath, Ebal, Shepho, leh Onam ahi hi.
Hihte pen Zibeon tapate, Aiah leh Anah ahi hi. Hih pen a pa Zibeon’ laate a cing lai-in gamlak ah tui a mu Anah ahi hi.
Hihte pen Anah tate: Dishon leh Anah tanu’ Aholibamah ahi hi.
Hihte pen Dishon’ tapate: Hemdan, Eshban, Ithran, leh Keran ahi hi.
Hihte pen Ezer’ tapate: Bilhan, Zaavan leh Akan ahi uh hi.
Hihte pen Ezer tapate: Uz leh Aran ahi hi.
Hihte pen Hori mite’ ukpite: Ukpi Lotan, Ukpi Shobal, Ukpi Zibeon, Ukpi Anah,
Ukpi Dishon, Ukpi Ezer, leh Ukpi Dishan ahi uh hi; hihte pen Seir gam sunga amaute kikhenna tawh kizui-a Hori mite’ ukpite ahi uh hi.
Hihte pen Israyl kumpi khatbeek in a uk ma-in, Edom gam sung a uk kumpite ahi hi:
Beor tapa Bela in Edom gam sung uk a, ama khuapi min pen Dinhabah ahi hi.
Bela a sih ciangin, Bozrah khuami Zerah’ tapa Yobab in kumpi hihna a luahto hi.
Yobab a sih ciangin, Teman mite gam panin Husham in kumpi hihna a luahto hi.
Husham a sih ciangin, Moab gam sung panin Midiante a do zo Bedad tapa Hadad in kumpi hihna a luahto hi.
Hadad a sih ciangin, Masrekah khuami Samlah in kumpi hihna a luahto hi.
Samlah a sih ciangin, gungei a Pehoboth khuami Shaul in kumpi hihna a luahto hi.
Shaul a sih ciangin, Achbor’ tapa Baal-Hanan in kumpi hihna a luahto hi.
Achbor’ tapa Baal-Hanan a sih ciangin, Hadad in kumpi hihna luahto a, ama khuapi min pen Pau hi a, Me-Zehab’ tanu ahi Matred’ tanu Mehetabel pen a zi’ min ahi hi.
Hihte pen amaute beh leh amaute gamkuam tawh kizui-in Esau ukpite’ minte: Ukpi Timnah, Ukpi Alvah, Ukpi Yetheth,
Ukpi Aholibamah, Ukpi Elah, Ukpi Pinon,
Ukpi Kenaz, Ukpi Teman, Ukpi Mibzar,
Ukpi Magdiel, leh Ukpi Iram ahi hi. Hihte pen amaute tenna leitang ah amaute inn le lo mun tawh kizui-in Edom’ ukpite ahi hi. Hih pen Edom mite’ pupi Esau ahi hi.
Tu-in Yaaqob pen Canaan gam a pa’ tennasa leitang ah teng hi.

Hihte pen Yaaqob suanlekhakte ahi hi. Tangvalno Yahseph pen kum 17 phata a, a pa’ zite Bilhah leh Zilpah tapate ahi a sanggamte tawh gancing khawm uh a, amaute tawh kisai thu hoih lo pen amah in a pa kiangah puak hi.
