Pharaoh in tua tak ciangin Yahseph kiangah, “Mang khat ka man a, a khiatna gen thei kuamah omlo hi. Ahih hangin nangmah in mang khat peuh a telthei-in a khiatna gen thei hi ci-in nang hong ki genna thu ka zakhin hi.
Tua ahih ciangin Yahseph in dawng a, “Keimah in tua pen ka khia thei kei a, ahih hangin Yahweh in Pharaoh aa ding ahoihlamin dawnna hong pia ding hi.
Tua tak ciangin Pharaoh in Yahseph kiangah, “Ka mang sungah Nile gun gei-ah ka ding a,
Nile gun sung panin thakhat thu-in a zol a thau bawngpi sagih hong paikhia-in amaute in phaikungte lakah lopa a ne uh hi.
Tuate khit ciangin a gawng gepgap a melsia adang bawngpi sagih hong paikhia hi. Egypt gamsung khempeuh ah tua bang bawngpi melsia ka mu ngei nai kei hi.
A melsia a gawna gawng bawngpite in a masa a thau bawngpi sagihte a netum hi.
Amaute in tuate a nektum khit uh ciangin, amaute in a nekkhit lam kuamah in thei lo hi. Ahang in amaute a kipat cil-a mah bangin a melsia-in a gawng lai veve hi. Tua ciangin ka khanglo hi.
Azom ka mang sungah zong buhkung khat tungah a cidam leh a gahpha mahmah buhvui sagih a vui hi.
Tua tak ciangin adang sagihte hong po-in, nisuahna lam huih hangin vulin a keu hi.
Tua ciangin a hawm buhvui sagihte in a gahpha buhvui sagihte a nawmvalh hi. Keimah in hihte mitphial siamte kiangah ka gen hangin kuamah in kei’ tungah hong gencian thei lo hi,” a ci hi.
Tua tak ciangin Yahseph in Pharaoh kiangah, “Pharaoh’ mangte pen khat hi a, a kibang ahi hi. Yahweh in a hih ding thu, Pharaoh’ tungah hong lakkhin hi.
A thau bawngpi sagihte pen kum sagih hi a, a gahpha mahmah buhvui sagihte pen kum sagih hi-in, hih mangte pen khat hi a, a kibang ahi hi.
Amaute khit cianga hong paikhia a melsia a gawng bawngpi sagihte pen kum sagih hi a, nisuahna lam huihmutsa manphatna a nei lo buhvui sagihte pen kialpi kum sagih ahi hi.
Pharaoh’ tungah kong gensa bangin ahi hi. Yahweh in a hih ding thu, Pharaoh’ tungah hong lakkhin hi.
Egypt gam sung khempeuh ah kum sagih hauhna hong tung ding a,
ahih hangin tua khit ciangin kum sagih kialpi in hong zui ding hi. Egypt gam sunga hauhna khempeuh kingaihsun zo nawn lo-in kialpi in gamsung teng netum ding hi.
Hong nungzuih kialpi pen nasialua mahmah ding ahih manin gam sungah hauhna kithei lo ding hi.
Mang pen Pharaoh’ tungah namnih in hong kilang ahi hi. Bang hang hiam cihleh hih thu pen Yahweh in khauhtakin kipsak a, a sawt lo-in Yahweh in hih ding hi.
Tua ahih ciangin Pharaoh aw tu-in thu ngaihsutsiam leh mipil khat teng khia inla, Egypt gamsung vaipuak len dingin amah koih in.
Hauh kum, kum sagih sungin Egypt gam leitang pana piang sung panin nga-ah-khat lak nadingin Pharaoh aw gambup vaihawm uliante seh in.
Hong tung ding hauh kum, kum sagih sungin an khempeuh amaute in kaikhawmin Pharaoh’ ukna nuai-ah antangte khol ding uh a, amaute in khuapite sungah kem ding uh hi.
Egypt gam-a hong tung ding kialpi kum sagih sunga a kine ding, gambup aa dingin a ki-siit ante hi ding hi. Tua hileh gambup pen kialpi hangin kisia lo ding hi,” a ci hi.
Pharaoh leh ama uliante khempeuh in hih thugelna pen man a sa uh hi.
Tua ahih ciangin Pharaoh in amaute kiangah, “Ama sungah Yahweh’ Kha a omna, hih mipa tawh a kibang khat peuh muzo ding i hi hiam?” a ci hi.
Tua tak ciangin Pharaoh in Yahseph kiangah, “Na biak Yahweh in hih khempeuh a thei-in nang hong bawl khin ahih nungsang nang bangin thungaihsut siam leh a pil kuamah om lo hi.
Nang pen keima kumpi inn sung vaipuak len na hi ding a, nang’ kammal bangbangin ka mipi khempeuh ki-uk ding a, kumpi tokhom tawh kisai-in kei pen nang sangin ka lianzaw bek ding hi,” a ci hi.
Pharaoh in Yahseph kiangah, “En in, Egypt gambup tungah nang kong koihkhin hi,” a ci hi.
Tua tak ciangin Pharaoh ama letmat thuhna khutbuh a khutme panin lakhia-in Yahseph’ khutme ah a bulhsak hi. Amah in saihadial puan hoihte silhsak a, kham khainiang khat a ngawng ah a oksak hi.
Ama thunei pen nihna ahih mah bangin leeng khat ah Yahseph tuangsak a, ama mai-ah amaute in, “Khukdin un!” ci-in a tangko uh hi. Tua ahih manin Egypt gambup a ukin amah a koih hi.
Tua tak ciangin Pharaoh in Yahseph kiangah, “Keimah Pharaoh ka hi hi, ahih hangin Egypt gam sungah nangma thukimna lo tawh kuamah in a khut ahi a, a khe ahi zongin liik lo ding uh hi,” a ci hi.

Tua ciangin Pharaoh in Yahseph’ min dingin Zaphnath-Paanaeah (Tsophnath Paneach) phuak a, On khua siampi Poti-Pherah, a tanu Asenath a pia hi. On pen Awen hi-a Heliopolis kici ni pasian khuapi ahi hi. Tua ahih manin Egypt gambup khempeuh ah Yahseph pai kawikawi hi.
Egypt kumpi Pharaoh nasepna ah a lutin Yahseph kum 30 a pha hi. Pharaoh omna panin Yahseph paikhia in, Egypt leitang khempeuh ah a pai hi.
Hauh kum, kum sagih sungin leitang in tampi piangsak a,
Egypt gam ah hauh kum, kum sagih sungin Yahseph in a kisehsa ante khempeuh khawm a, khuapite sungah an khol hi. A kiima lote panin a piangte khuapi sim ah amah in an khol hi.
Tuipi sehnel bangin Yahseph in antang tampitak khol a, tua pen tam lua mahmah ahih manin amaute in a sim a khawl uh hi. Bang hang hiam cihleh tua pen sim zawh ahi kei hi.
Kialpi kumte hong tun ma-in Yahseph in On khua siampi Poti-Pherah’ tanu Asenath tawh tapa nih a nei hi.

Yahseph in a suak masa min pen Menasheh a phuak hi. Tua pen Mangngilh dinga Bawl a cihna ahi hi. “Bang hang hiam cihleh ka haksatna khempeuh leh ka pa’ innkuan khempeuh a mangngilhin kei hong kibawl hi,” a ci hi.
A nihna pa min pen amah in Ephraim a phuak hi. Tua pen Cipha a cihna ahi hi. “Bang hang hiam cihleh Yahweh in ka thuakna gam sung panin a pung dingin kei hong bawl hi,” a ci hi.
Tua tak ciangin Egypt gam sunga hauhna kum, kum sagih hong beita hi.
Yahseph gensa mah bangin kialpi kum sagih a piang dingin hong kipan ta hi. Gamdang khempeuh ah kialpi tung a, ahih hangin Egypt gam sung khempeuh ah an om hi.

Egypt gam khempeuh a kial thuak ding hong kipat ciangin an ngenin Pharaoh kiangah a kiko uh hi. Tua tak ciangin Pharaoh in Egypt mi khempeuh kiangah, “Yahseph kiangah pai un, ama hong gen bangbangin gamta un,” a ci hi.
Kialpi pen gam khempeuh ah hong kizelh ciangin, Yahseph in ansalte hong a, Egypt mite kiangah antang a zuak hi. Ahang in Egypt gam sungah kialpi nasia mahmah hi.
Tua ahih manin gam khempeuh in Yahseph kiang panin antang lei dingin Egypt gam ah hong pai uh hi. Bang hang hiam cihleh leitung bup ah kialpi nasia mahmah hi.
Yaaqob in Egypt gam sungah antang om cih a theih ciangin, amah in a tapate kiangah, “Bang hangin khatlekhat ki enen mawk na hi uh hiam?
Egypt gam sungah antang a om lam ka zakhin hi. Tua mun ah paisuk unla eite aa ding tua mun ah va lei un. Tua hileh eite i nungta ding a, i si kei ding hi,” a ci hi.
Tua ahih manin Yahseph’ sanggam pasal sawmte Egypt gam sungah antang lei dingin a paisuk uh hi.
Ahih hangin Yaaqob in Yahseph’ sanggampa Benyamin pen a sanggamte tawh a paisak kei hi. Ahang in siatna khat peuh in a sukha ding hi ci-in a ngaihsun hi.
Tua ahih manin antang lei dinga a paite lakah Israyl’ tapate zong a kihel hi. Bang hang hiam cihleh Canaan gam ah zong kialpi a tung hi.

Tu-in Yahseph pen gambup a ukpa leh a mite khempeuh tungah antang a zuak pa ahi hi. Tua ahih manin Yahseph’ sanggamte hong tun ciangin, amaute in a maitang uh leilak lamah ngatin ama mai-ah a kunsuk uh hi.

Yahseph in a sanggamte mu-a, amaute a thei hi. Ahih hangin amah in midang khat bangin amaute bawl a, khauh takin amaute a hopih hi. Tua tak ciangin amah in amaute kiangah, “Koi pan hong pai na hi uh hiam?” a ci hi. Amaute in, “An lei dingin Canaan gam panin hong pai ka hi uh hi,” a ci uh hi.
Yahseph in a sanggamte a theih hangin a sanggamte in amah a thei nawn kei hi.
Tua tak ciangin Yahseph in amaute a matna a mangte phawk a, amaute kiangah, “Note pen thukan na hi uh hi! Kote gam thaneemna mun a encik dingin hong pai na hi uh hi,” a ci hi.
Ahih hangin amaute in, “Hilo hi, ukpa aw! Na nasemte an lei ding bek a hong pai ka hi uh hi.
Kote pen mi khat’ tapate ka hi uh a, kote a thuman mi ka hi uh hi! Na nasemte thukan ka hi kei uh hi,” a ci uh hi.
Ahih hangin amah in amaute kiangah, “Hilo hi, kote gam thanemna mun a encik dingin hong paikhin na hi uh hi,” a ci hi.
Ahih hangin amaute in, “Na nasemte unau pasal sawm le nih ka hi uh a, Canaan gam ah mi khat’ ta ka hi uh hi. A neupen tu-in ka pa uh tawh om a, khat pen a om nawn kei hi,” a ci uh hi.
Ahih hangin Yahseph in amaute kiangah, “Kong gensa bang mah hi a, note pen thukante na hi uh hi.
Hi bangin note hong ki-entel ding hi: Pharaoh nungta ahih mah bangin, na sanggam neupen pa hi lai mun ah hong pai kei leh note hih mun panin na paikhia thei kei ding uh hi.

Note sungah thutak a om leh a omloh a kilat nading note kammal ki-etcik theih nadingin note sung panin khat na kisawl ding uh a, na sanggampa uh hong paipih un. No adang teng thong sungah hong kikem ding hi. Tua bang ahih kei leh Pharaoh nungta ahih mah bangin note thukante na hi taktak uh hi,” a ci hi.
Tua ahih manin amah in ni thum sung thong sungah amaute a koih khawm hi.
Tua tak ciangin Yahseph in amaute kiangah a ni thum ni-in, “Keimah in Yahweh zahtak ka hih manin, hih bangin na gamtat uh leh note na nungta ding uh hi:
note a thuman mi na hih uh leh, na sanggamte lak panun khat na thong kiatna inn ah omsak lai unla, adang teng pai-in na innkuante uh kialpi a thuakte aa dingin antangte la-in pua un;
tua tak ciangin na sanggam neupen pa kei kiangah hong paipih un, tua bang ahih leh note kammalte pen a man-na kitel ding a, note na si kei ding uh hi,” a ci hi. Tua mah bangin amaute a gamta uh hi.

Tua tak ciangin amaute khatlekhat in, “A taktakin i sanggampa i bawlna hangin ei in dantatna a thuak i hi hi. Amah in eite kiangah hong thum lai-in ama dahluatna i muh hangin eite in i awlmawh kei hi. Tua thu hangin hih bang lungkhamna eite tungah hong tung hi,” a kici uh hi.
Reuben in tua ciangin gen a, “Naupang pa tungah mawhna bawl kei un hong ci mah hilo ka hi hiam? Ahi zong na awlmawh kei uh hi. Tu-in ama sisan in eite hong gencian hi,” a ci hi.
Kam phen khat tungtawnin Yahseph in thu gen ahih manin Yahseph in amaute genna a theih lam amaute in thei kha lo uh hi.
Amaute’ kiang panin amah kihei-in a kap hi. Tua khit ciangin amaute lamah amah kiheikik a, amaute kiangah thu a gen hi. Amaute lak panin amah in Simeon a tuamin lakhia-in amaute muhna ah a hen hi.

Tua tak ciangin Yahseph in amaute ipte sungah antang a guan nading leh amau’ ngun ciat koih kikin, lampi-a a nek ding uh an a piak nadingin Yahseph in thu a pia hi. Tua ahih manin amah in amaute aa dingin hih bangin a hih hi.
Amaute in a laate tungah amau’ antangte suanin tua mun panin a paikhia uh hi.
Amaute a zan giak dingin a khawlna mun ah, amaute lak panin khat in a la an pia dingin a van a hon leh, a van gong ah ama ngun a mu hi.

Tua tak ciangin amah in a sanggamte kiangah, “Ka ngun hong kikoihkik hi! Ka ip sung hi teng ah om hi!” a ci hi. Amaute a dipkua gawpin a vekun linggawp uh a, “Yahweh in eite hi bangin hong bawlna a bangci mawk ahi hiam?” a ci uh hi.
Amaute Canaan gam sunga om a pa kiang a tun uh ciangin, amaute’ tunga thupiang khempeuh ama tungah gen uh a,
“Tua gam a uk mipa in kote tungah khauhtakin hong hopihin gam’ thukante ci-in hong mawhsak hi.
Ahih hangin kote ama kiangah, “Kote a thuman mite ka hi uh a, thukante ka hi kei uh hi.
Pa khat suan, kote sanggam pasal sawm le nih ka hi uh a, khat pen om nawn loin, Canaan gam sungah tu ni-in ka pa tawh a neu pen a om khawm hi,” ka ci uh hi.

Tua tak ciangin gam uk mipa in kote kiangah, “Hih etcik na tawh midiktat na hihna uh kong thei ding hi: Na sanggampa khat uh kei tawh hong nusia unla, kialpi tunna na innkuante aa dingin an la-in hih panin ciahkik un.

Ahih hangin note thukan na hih loh lam uh kong up nadingin na sanggam neupen pa hih mun kei kiangah hong paipih un, tua ciangin midiktat taktak kong ci ding hi. Tua tak ciangin keimah in na sanggampa note tungah kong piakik ding a, tua ciangin note in hih gam sungah sum na bawl thei ding uh hi,” ci-in hong gen uh hi.
Amau’ vante a suah ciangun, a milipun a ngunte uh a van sung ciat uh ah na om hi. Amaute leh a pa un amaute’ sum ipneu a muh ciangin, amaute a lau mahmah uh hi.

Tua tak ciangin a pa uh Yaaqob in amaute kiangah, “Ka tate tawh kei nong kikhensak zo uh hi! Yahseph om nawn lo hi! Simeon om nawn lo hi! Benyamin, note in na la ding uh hi! Hih nate khempeuh kei tawh kilehbulh hi!” a ci hi.

Tua tak ciangin Reuben in a pa kiangah, “Nang kiangah amah kong ciahpihkik kei leh ka tapa tenih na utleh that in. Lungmuang takin kei kepna ah hong ap in. Nang kiangah kong ciahpihkik ding hi!” a ci hi.

Ahih hangin a pa in, “Ka tapa nang tawh paisuk lo ding hi, ahang in a sanggampa lah sikhin a, amah bek a cian hi. Lampi ah siatna khatpeuh ama tungah hong tung leh, sam kangpi-in dahluatna tawh han ah nong zuansak ding uh hi,” a ci hi.

headings.text: Yahseph in A Sanggamte Hoihtakin Zindo

verses.text: Tu-in gam sungah kialpi veng nai lo hi.
Egypt gam panin a puak uh antang khempeuh amaute in a gaih khit uh ciangin, a pa in amaute kiangah, “Paikik unla, ei aa dingin an tawmkhat va lei lai un,” a ci hi.
Ahih hangin Yahdah in amah dawng a, “Mipa in nasia takin kote thu hong hilhkhol khinin a gen inah: ‘Na sanggampa uh tawh nong pai kei uh leh note in ka mai na mu kha kei ding uh hi,’ ci hi.
Nangmah ka sanggampa uh kote tawh nong paisak a leh, tua ciangin kote ka paisuk ding uh a, nang aa dingin an ka lei ding uh hi;

Ahih hangin amah na paisak kei leh, mipa in kote kiangah, ‘na sanggampa uh tawh nong pai kei uh leh note in ka mai na mu kha kei ding uh hi,’ hong cikhin ahih manin kote ka paisuk kei ding uh hi,” a ci hi.
Tua tak ciangin Israyl in, “Adang sanggam pasal nei ung ci-in genna tawh bang hangin hi bang buaina kei kiangah hong puak na hi uh hiam?” a ci hi.

Ahih hangin amaute in dawng a, “Mipa in kote’ thu leh ka sanggamte uh thu limtakin hong dong hi. Amah in, ‘Na pa uh a dam lai hiam? Sanggam dang na nei lai uh hiam?’ ci-in hong dong hi. Tua ciangin kote in ama hong dotna bangbekin ka dawng uh hi. ‘Na sanggampa uh hong tonpih suk un,’ amah in hong cih ding lam kote in bangci theihkholh ding ka hi uh hiam?’ a ci uh hi.

Tua tak ciangin Yahdah in a pa Israyl kiangah, “Keimah tawh naupangpa hong zuisak in, kote thakhat thu-in ka dingkhia pah ding uh hi. Tua hileh kote, nang leh i naupangte nungta ding a, a si kei ding hi,” a ci hi.

Kei pen ama aa dingin a kikham ka hi ding a, kei’ khut sung panin ama aa dingin tavuan ka la ding hi. Na kiangah kong ciahpih kei a, na mai-ah kong koihkik kei leh, tua mawhna kei hong thuaksak tawntung in.
Eite in zia nei kei le hang tubangin kote paikhinin nih vei bang kong kilehkik khin taktak ding uh hi,” a ci hi.

A pa uh Israyl amaute kiangah, “Hih bangin hih loh phamawh ahih leh, hi bangin hih un: Gam sunga van hoih pente na ip sungte ah pua unla, mipa tungah citpiakna-in pia un: tuate pen lingsi tawm, khuaizu tawm, singnamtui, myrrh paknamtui, pistachio gah leh almond gahte ahi hi.
Note in sum a zahnih in pua unla, na ipte sunga a kikoih sumte piakik un. Tua pen a koihkhialh hikha thei ding hi.
Na sanggampa uh zong la unla, mipa kiangah pai un;

Vanglian Pen Yahweh in mipa mai-ah note hehpihna hong pia tahen. Tua hileh amah in note adang sanggampa leh Benyamin note tawh hong ciahkiksak kha thei ding hi. Sihna in kei hong khen leh zong, kei hong khen mai hen!
Tua ahih manin amaute in citpiaknate leh sum a zah nih pua-in, Benyamin zong tonpih uh a, Egypt gam ah manlang takin pai-in Yahseph mai-ah a va kilak uh hi.

Yahseph in Benyamin tawh amaute a muh ciangin, a innsung kempa kiangah: hih mite ka inn ah hong paipih inla, gan khat go-in bawl in. Bang hang hiam cihleh hih mite in sun ciangin kei tawh an nekhawm ding uh hi.
Tua tak ciangin mipa in Yahseph gen bangin hih a, tua mite Yahseph’ inn ah a paipih hi.

Tu-in Yahseph’ inn ah amaute a kipaipih ciangin amaute a dipkua uh hi. Bang hang hiam cihleh amaute in, “a masa lai-in eite ip sungte ah ngun hong kikoihsak kikna hangin eite hong paipih hi ding hi; eite sila-in hong manin i laate la-in eite’ hong suk theih nadingin eite’ tungah thu hong zong ahi ding hi,” ci-in a ngaihsun uh hi.
Yahseph’ inn sung lutna nai ah amaute a tun uh ciangin, Yahseph inn kempa kiangah amaute in thugen a,
“Kote a masa lai-in an lei ding taktakin a hong pai ka hi uh a,
ahih hangin zan giak dingin ka khawlna mun uh ah, ka ipte uh ka hong uh a, koma ngunte tawi cing takin ka van sung ciat vuah ka mu uh hi. Tua ahih manin kote in tuate kong tawikik uh hi.
An ka lei beh nadingun adang ngunte zong kote in kong pua uh hi. Kua in ko ipte sungah ka sum uh na koih hiam cih ka thei kei uh hi,” a ci uh hi.

Ahih hangin amah in, “Na vekun Shalom Lau kei un. Na pate i Pa, Yahweh in no ipte sungah van manpha hong koihsak hi ding hi. Keimah in note ngunte ka ngah hi,” a ci hi. Tua tak ciangin amah in amaute kiangah Simeon paikhiatpih hi.
Tua ahih manin amah in amaute Yahseph’ inn sungah paipih a, amah in amaute tuipia-in amaute in a khete uh a sil uh hi. Tua tak ciangin amah in amaute laate an a piaksak hi.
Amaute in tua lai-ah Yahseph tawh an ne ding uh ci-in za uh ahih manin sunin Yahseph hong pai ciangin a piak ding uh citpiakna bawlkhol uh hi.
Yahseph inn hong tun ciangin, amaute ken citpiaknate a inn ah amaute in amah pia uh a, leilak lam ama mai-ah amaute a kunsuk uh hi.
Tua tak ciangin amah in amaute’ cidamna thu khawng dong a, tua ciangin amah in, “Note gen a khangham na pa uh a dam lai hiam? Amah a nungta lai hiam?” a ci hi.
Tua ciangin amaute in dawng a, “Na nasem kote pa nungta lai-in a cidam hi,” a ci uh hi. Amaute in amah zahtakna a piakna-in a kunsuk uh hi.
Tua ciangin amah khuadakin, ama nu’ tapa a sanggampa mu a, “Hih pen note in kei kianga nong gen uh na sanggam neupen pa ahi hiam? Nang tungah Yahweh in hehpihna hong omsak tahen, ka ta,” a ci hi.
Tu-in a sanggampa a muh ciangin amah khasia mahmah hi; tua ahih manin Yahseph in a kah nading mun zongin manlangin a paikhia hi. Ama inndei sungah lutin tua mun ah a kap hi.
Tua khit ciangin a mai phiatin hong paikhia a, Amah leh amah ki-ap tawm in, “An lui ta un,” a ci hi.

Amaute in Yahseph a tuamin, a sanggamte a tuamin, amah tawh a ne Egypt mite a tuamin an a lui hi. Bang hang hiam cihleh Egypt mite in Hebrew mite tawh an nekhawm lo uh hi. Tua banga nekkhop ding pen Egypt mite aa dingin a kihhuai ahi hi.
A upen pan a neupen dongin amau’ kum tawh kizui-in Yahseph deihna lamah amaute a tu uh hi; amaute khatlekhat lamdangsak mahmahna tawh a ki-en uh hi.
Yahseph’ sabuai panin amaute tanh a kihawm ciangin, Benyamin’ tanh pen a sanggam dangte aa sangin a zah nga-in tam zaw hi. Tua ciangin amaute in amah tawh suakta takin ne-in a dawn uh hi.
Tu-in Yahseph in ama innsung sai innkempa kiangah, “Hih mite ipte, amau puakzawh zahzah an tawh dim inla, amau’ ngun ciat a ip gong ah koih in.
A naupen pa’ ip gong sungah a ngakna leh a letna a nei ka hai, ngun hai pen zong guang inla, ama antang’ man ngun tawh koihkhawm in,” a ci hi. Tua ahih manin Yahseph gen bangin amah in a sem hi.
Zingsang khua a vak phetin ciangin, mite pen amau laate tawh a pai nading ah a kisawlkhia hi.
Khuapi panin gamlapi a tun ma-in, Yahseph in a innkempa kiangah, “Mite va nungdelh inla, amaute na phak ciangin, amaute kiangah, ‘Migitna pen bang hangin gitlohna tawh thuk na hi uh hiam?
Ka ukpa hih a ngakna nei leh a letna nei hai sung panin dawnin, a thu muhkholh theih nading-a zong a zatden hi lo ahi hiam? Hih pen na gitloh gamtatna uh ahi hi,’ va ci in,” a ci hi.
Tua ahih manin amah in amaute a phak ciangin, amaute tungah tua thu teng a gen hi.
Amaute in ama kiangah, “Ka ukpa un bang hangin tua bang thute hong gen na hi hiam? Na nasemte tua bangin gamtatna pen ko tawh kigamla hi.

A taktakin, kote ip gong sunglam-a ka muh uh ngunte, Canaan gam panin kote in nang kiangah kong puakkik lai uh hi. Tua hi-a bangci bangin na ukpa’ inn panin ngun ahi a, kham ahi zongin gu ding ka hi uh hiam?
Na nasemte’ khatpeuh kiangah tua hai a kimuh leh, amah that inla, kote ka vek un na ukpa’ sila ka hi ding uh hi!” a ci hi.
Tua ciangin amah in, “Hoih mahmah hi. Na gen bangin hisak in. Tua hai a kimuhna a kuamapeuh ka sila hi ding a, ahih hangin no a dangteng mawh a baanglo na hi ding uh hi,” a ci hi.
Tua tak ciangin amaute in a ip ciat uh leilak ah manlang takin ngakhia pahin a hong uh hi.
Tua khit ciangin innkempa in a hampen pan panin a moipen dongah zong a, a ngakna leh a letna nei hai Benyamin’ ip sungah mu hi.
Tua ciangin amaute in a puansilhte uh balkek uh hi. Tua khit ciangin a milip in khuapi ah a kilehkik uh hi.
Yahseph a inn ah omlai ahih manin Yahdah leh a sanggamte a inn ah a pai uh hi. Ama mai leilak ah amaute kunsuk uh hi.
Yahseph in amaute kiangah, “Hih bangin na gamtatna uh bang hi mawk ahi hiam? Muhkholhna tawh nate a zongkhia thei mi khat ka hihna thei lo na hi uh hiam?” a ci hi.

Tua tak ciangin Yahdah in, “Kote in ka ukpa kiangah bang gen nawn ding ka hi uh hiam? Bang gen thei nawn ding ka hi uh hiam? Ka mawhloh lam uh bangci bangin hong lak thei ding ka uh hiam? Hih thu ah Yahweh in kote tatkhialhna hong pholakkhin hi. Tu-in kote ka ukpa’ sila ka hi ta uh a, kote mahmah leh tua hai a kimuhna pa tawh ka hi uh hi,” a ci hi.
Ahih hangin Yahseph in, “Tua bangin gamtatna pen kei tawh kigamla hi! Ka hai a kimuhna mipa bek ka sila hi ding hi. No a dangteng na pa uh kiangah lungmuang takin ciah un,” a ci hi.
Tua tak ciangin Yahdah ama kiangah hong paito in, “Ka ukpa aw, ka ukpa kiangah kammal tawmno khat hong gensak in. Pharaoh nangawn tawh a kibang himah lecin na nasempa tungah hong heh kei in.
Ka ukpa in a nasemte nong dong a, ‘Pa hitaleh sanggam pasal hitaleh na nei hiam?’ nong ci hi.

Kote in ka ukpa kong dawng uh a, ‘A khangham pa khat leh a teek zawhin a neih tangvalno khat ka nei uh hi. Ama sanggampa si a, a nu’ tapate panin amah bek om lai a, a pa in it mahmah hi,’ ka ci uh hi.
Tua tak ciangin nangmah in na nasemte kiangah, ‘Kei kiangah amah hong tonpihsuk un, tua hileh amah ka mu ding hi,’ nong ci hi.
Kote in ka ukpa kiangah, ‘Naupangin a pa nusia thei lo ding hi; nusia leh a pa si ding hi,’ kong ci uh hi.
Ahih hangin nangmah in na nasemte kiangah, ‘Na nautum neupen pa uh no tawh hong paisuk kei leh, ka mai na mu nawn kei ding uh hi,’ nong ci hi.
Tua ahih manin hi bang hi a, na nasem ka pa uh kiangah kote ka paitoh uh ciangin ka ukpa’ kammalte amah ka gen uh hi.
Tua khit ciangin ka pa un, ‘Paikik un, an themkhat va lei lai un,’ hong ci hi.

Ahih hangin kote in, ‘Kote ka paisuk kei ding uh hi. Ka nautum pen pa uh kote tawh ahih leh bek ka pai ding uh hi. Bang hang hiam cihleh ka sanggam neupen pa ko tawh ahih keileh mipa tawh kimuh ding pen kote hong kiphallo ding hi,’ ka ci uh hi.
Tua tak ciangin na nasem ka pa un kote kiangah, ‘Ka zi in tapa nih a neih na thei uh hi;
Khat kei’ kiang panin paikhia khin a, amah pen a themneng dongin kibalzan aive maw ka ci-a, tua a kipanin amah ka mu nawn kei hi.
Note in hih a khat zong kei kiang panin la-in ama tungah siatna tung leh, sam kangpi-in dahluatna tawh han ah nong zuansak ding uh hi,’ a ci hi.
Tua ahih manin tu-in na nasem ka pa uh kiangah kote pai-in naupang pa ko tawh hi keileh, ka pa uh’ nuntakna pen ka sanggamte’ nuntakna tungah kinga ahih manin,
hih bang piang ding a, kote tawh naupangpa hong muh loh ciangin, amah sikha ding hi. Tua ahih manin na nasemte in na nasem sam kang ka pa uh dahluatna tawh ama han ah ka puaksuk ding uh hi.
‘Na kiangah kong ciahpih kei a, na mai-ah kong koihkik kei leh, tua mawhna kei hong thuaksak tawntung in,’ ci-in genna tawh kei, na nasempa in ka pa’ tungah ama aa dingin a kikham ka hi hi.
Tu-in tua ahih ciangin ka ukpa’ sila dingin naupangpa’ tangin na nasempa hong omsak inla, a sanggamte tawh naupangpa ciahkiksak in.
Ahang in naupangpa kei tawh hong ton kei leh bangci bangin ka pa kiangah ciahkik thei ding ka hi hiam? Hilo hi! Ka pa tungah a tung ding dahna-lungkhamna hong musak mahmah kei in!” a ci hi.

headings.text: Yahseph in A Pa Yaaqob Samsakkik

verses.text: Tua tak ciangin Yahseph zong ama nasemte khempeuh mai panin ki-ip zo nawn lo a, amah in, “Ka kiang panin a kuamah peuh paikhia un!” ci-in a kiko hi. Tua ahih manin a sanggamte tungah amah leh amah a kipulak ciangin Yahseph kiangah kuamah dang om lo hi.
Amah kapkhia beba ahih manin Egypt mite in za a, Pharaoh’ innkuante in tua a za uh hi.

Tua tak ciangin Yahseph in a sanggamte kiangah, “Keimah Yahseph ka hi hi! Ka pa a nungta lai hiam?” a ci hi. Ahih hangin a sanggamte in amah a dawng kei uh hi. Bang hang hiam cihleh ama mai-ah amaute a lau uh hi.
Tua tak ciangin Yahseph in a sanggamte kiangah, “Ka kiangah hong nehphei un,” a ci hi. Amaute a nehphei ciangin amah in, “Egypt gam sunga nong zuak uh na sanggampa Yahseph ka hi hi.
Tu-in Yahweh in nuntakna a hu dingin note mai-ah kei hong sawl ahih manin no-le-no kilunggimsakin kihehsak tawm kei un.
A hangin gam sungah kialpi kum nih sung tungkhin a, lo khawh loh, an lak loh ding kum nga omlai hi.
Tua ahih ciangin note aa dingin leitung ah a omlai mi a hingsak ding leh note aa dingin a suakta mi tampi a kem dingin note mai-ah Yahweh in kei hong paisak ahi hi.

Tua bang ahih manin hih mun ah a hong paisak pen no na hi kei uh a, Yahweh ahi hi. Amah in Pharaoh tungah pa bangin kei hong bawl a, ama innkuan khempeuh a uk ding leh Egypt gam khempeuh a uk dingin hong bawl hi.
Manlangin ka pa’ kiangah paito unla, ama kiangah, “Na tapa Yahseph genna hih bang ahi hi: Yahweh in Egypt gambup a uk dingin kei hong bawlkhin ta hi. Kei kiangah hong paisuk inla zekai kei hen.
Goshen leitang ah na teng ding a, nang, na tate leh na tute, na tuuhonte leh na bawnghonte, leh na neih khempeuh tawh, nang pen kei tawh a kinai-in na om ding hi.
Hong pai ding kum nga kialpi om lai ahih manin keimah in tualai mun ah nang kong vak ding hi. Tua hileh nang leh na innkuan, leh na neih khempeuh na genthei nawn kei ding uh hi.
Note kianga thu hong gen pen keimah ka hih taktakna thu note mahmah in nong thei uh a, ka sanggampa Benyamin’ mit in hong mu hi.
Egypt gam sungah hong kizahtakna leh na muhte khempeuh uh zong ka pa na gen un. Note manlang unla hih lai mun ah ka pa hong paipihsuk un,” a ci hi.
Tua tak ciangin amah in a sanggampa Benyamin angpom-in kap a, Benyamin zong a ngawng ah kawi-in a kap hi.
Amah in a sanggamte khempeuh nam-in amaute a kah hi. Tua khit ah a sanggamte in amah hopih uh hi.
‘Yahseph’ sanggamte hong pai’ cih thu Pharaoh inn sungah a kizaksak ciangin, tua thu in Pharaoh leh ama uliante a lungdamsak hi.
Pharaoh in Yahseph kiangah, “Na sanggamte gen in, ‘Hi bangin gamta un: Na ganhingte uh van suan unla, Canaan gam ah na kilehkik theih nadingun hi panin ding khia un;
Kei kiangah na pa leh na innkuanpihte hong paipihkik un. Keimah in Egypt gam a hoih pen mun kong pia ding a, tua gam’ hauhna na ne ding uh hi,’ ci un.
Note in zong amaute kiangah tangtakin gen un, ‘Hi bangin gamta un: Na ta neute leh na zite aa dingin Egypt gam panin leengte la unla, na pa uh samin hong paipih un.
Egypt gam hoih penna nomau aa hi ding ahih manin na neih-le-lamte awlmawh kei un,’ ci in,” a ci hi.
Tua ahih manin Pharaoh in Yahseph kiangah a gen bangin Israyl’ tapate a gamta uh hi. Yahseph in amaute leengte pia a, amah in amaute’ khualzinna-a nek le dawn dingte zong a pia hi.
Amaute khat ciat amah in puan thak pia hi. Ahih hangin Benyamin pen amah in ngun shekel 300; pound 7 ½ kiim, leh puansilh kop nga a pia hi.
Amah in hihte a pa’ kiangah a puak hi: Egypt gam na hoih pen teng a pua laa sawm; antang, an leh a pa’ khualzin nadinga nek le dawn dingte a pua laa a nu sawm ahi hi.
Tua ahih manin amah in a sanggamte sawlkhia a, amaute a paikhiat ciangin amah in amaute kiangah, “Lampi tawntung ah kitawng-kisel kei un aw,” a ci hi.
Tua ciangin amaute Egypt gam panin paikhiato-in Canaan gam sung a pa uh Yaaqob kiangah a tung uh hi.
Amaute in ama kiangah, “Yahseph nungta lai hi! Amah pen Egypt gambup a ukpa a hi hi,” a ci hi. Yaaqob lungmang a, amah in amaute a um zo kei hi.
Ahih hangin Yahseph in amaute’ tunga a gen thute khempeuh amaute in ama kiangah a gen ciangin leh ama tuan nading leengte Yahseph in a khakkhitna a muh ciangin, amaute pa Yaaqob lungsim a khanglo hi.
Tua ciangin Israyl in, “Taksang ta-ing! Ka tapa Yahseph nungta lai hi! Ka sihma-in amah ka va en ding!” a ci hi.

headings.text: Yaaqob leh Yahseph Goshen ah Kimu

verses.text: Tua ahih manin Israyl ama neihsa khempeuh tawh a khualzinna kipan a, Beersheba ah amah a tun’ ciangin amah in a pa Isaac Pa, Yahweh tungah biakpiakna a pia hi.
Tua tak ciangin zanin mangmuhna tawh Yahweh in Israyl hopih a, “Yaaqob! Yaaqob!” a ci hi. Tua ciangin amah in dawng a, “Hiah ka om hi,” a ci hi.
Amah in, “Na pa Pa, Keimah Yahweh ka hi a, Egypt ah nangmah minam lianin hong bawl ding Ka hih manin tua mun ah na paisuk ding lau kei in.
Egypt ah nang tawh Ka paisuk ding a, nangmah Kong ciahpihkik taktak ding hi. Yahseph’ khut mahmah sungah na si ding hi,” a ci hi.
Tua tak ciangin Yaaqob in Beersheba paisan hi. Israyl’ tapate in a pa uh Yaaqob leh a tate leh a zite uh, amah a tuan nading-a Pharaoh in a khak leengte tungah a tuangsak hi.
Amaute tawh a ganhonte leh Canaan gam sung pana a ngah amaute neih-le-lamte zong amaute in la-in Yaaqob leh ama suanlekhakte Egypt gam ah a pai uh hi.
Amah in amah tawh Egypt gam ah a tapate leh a tute, a tanute leh a tunute la-in ama tuletate khempeuh Egypt gam ah amah tawh a paipih hi.
Tu-in hihte pen Yaaqob kici Israyl tate leh Egypt gam-a a pai a tapate minte ahi hi: Reuben pen Yaaqob ta masa pen ahi hi.
Reuben’ tapate pen Hanoch, Pallu, Zeron, leh Carmi ahi hi.
Simeon’ tapate pen Yemuel, Yamin, Ohad, Yachin, Zohar leh Canaan numei tawh a neih tapa Shaul ahi hi.
Levi’ tapate pen Gershon, Kohath leh Merari ahi hi.
Yahdah’ tapate pen Er, Onan, Shelah, Perez leh Zerah ahi hi. (Ahih hangin Er leh Onan pen Canaan gam sungah a si uh hi.) Perez’ tapate pen Hezron leh Hamul ahi hi.
Issachar’ tapate pen Tola, Puwah, Yashub, leh Shimron ahi hi.
Zebulun’ tapate pen Sered, Elon, leh Yachleel ahi hi.
Hihte pen Padan Aram pana Yaaqob in Leah tawh a neih a tapate hi a, a tanu Dinah tawh ahi hi. A tapate leh a tanute, mi a vekin 33 ahi hi.
Gad’ tapate pen Zephon, Haggi, Shuni, Ezbon, Eri, Arodi, leh Areli ahi hi.
Asher’ tapate pen Yimnah, Ishwah, Ishwi, leh Berach ahi hi. Amaute sanggamnu pen Serah ahi hi. Berach’ tapate pen Heber leh Malchiel ahi hi.
Hihte pen Laban in a tanu Leah’ tunga a piak Zilpah’ tapate hi a, amaute pen Yaaqob tawh a neih hi a, mi 16 ahi hi.
Yaaqob’ zi Rachel’ tapate pen Yahseph leh Benyamin ahi hi.
Yahseph in On khua siampi Poti-Pherah’ tanu Asenath tawh a neih Egypt gam sunga suak Menasheh leh Ephraim ahi hi.
Benyamin’ tapate pen Belah, Beker, Ashbel, Gera, Naaman, Ehi, Rosh, Muppim, Huppim, leh Ard ahi hi.
Hihte pen Yaaqob tawh a neih Rachel’ tapate hi a, a vek in mi 14 ahi hi.
Dan’ tapa pen Hushim ahi hi.
Naphtali’ tapate pen Yachzeel, Guni, Yezer, leh Shillem ahi hi.
Hihte pen Laban in Rachel’ tunga a piak Bilhah’ tapate hi a, amah in Yaaqob tawh a neih hi-in a vekin mi 7 ahi hi.
Egypt ah Yaaqob tawh a pai ama pumpi pana piang, a tapate’ zite a kisim lo, mi 66 ahi hi.
Egypt gam-a a pai Yaaqob’ innkuante leh Egypt gam sunga ama tung pana piang Yahseph’ tapa nihte tawh a vekin 70 ahi hi.
Tu-in Goshen pai na lampi ah lamlak dingin Yaaqob in Yahseph kiangah Yahdah a mataisak hi. Tua ciangin amaute Goshen gam ah a tung uh a,
tua tak ciangin Yahseph in a leeng kithawisakin Goshen gam ama pa Israyl dawn dingin a paito hi.
Tua ciangin Israyl in Yahseph kiangah, “Nangmah nungta lai-in keimah in na maitang mukhin ka hih nungsang tu-in ka si zongin phamawh nawn lo hi,” a ci hi.

Tua tak ciangin Yahseph in a sanggamte kiang leh a pa’ innkuanpihte’ kiangah, “Keimah paito-in Pharaoh ka hopih ding a, ama kiangah, ‘Ka sanggamte leh Canaan gam sunga teng ka pa’ innkuanpihte tu-in ka kiangah hong paikhinta uh hi.
Mite pen tuucingte hi a, amaute in gancing uh a, a tuuhonte uh, a bawnghonte uh, leh a neih khempeuh amau tawh hong paipihkhin hi,’ ka ci ding hi.
Pharaoh in note hong samin, ‘Note nasep bang ahi hiam?’ ci-in hong dot ciangin,
note in hi bang danin dawng un, ‘Ko na nasemte in ka pa uh sep mah bangin ka neu-a kipan tuhun na-ngawn dongin gan ka khawi uh hi,’ci un.
Tua tak ciangin note pen Goshen gam sungah ten ding hong kiphal ding hi. Bang hang hiam cihleh tuucingte khempeuh pen Egypt mite aa dingin a kihhuai ahi hi,” a ci hi.

Tua tak ciangin Yahseph pai a, Pharaoh kiangah, “Ka pa leh ka sanggamte, amaute tuuhonte leh amaute bawnghonte, amaute neihsa khempeuh tawh Canaan gam panin hong paikhin uh hi; amaute tu-in Goshen gam ah om uh hi,” ci-in gen hi.
A sanggam pasalte lak panin mi nga telkhia-in, Pharaoh’ kiangah paipih hi.
Tua tak ciang Pharaoh in a sanggamte kiangah, “Note nasep bang ahi hiam?” a ci hi. Amaute in Pharaoh dawng a, “Na nasemte pen ka pa uh mah bangin tuucingte ka hi uh hi,” a ci uh hi.
Amaute in ama kiangah, “Canaan gam sungah kialpi tung a, na nasemte’ ganhonte aa ding gantatna lopa om nawn lo ahih manin gam sung, hih mun ah a teng dingin kote hong pai ka hi uh hi,” a ci hi.
Pharaoh in Yahseph hopih-in a gen inah: “Na pa leh na sanggamte nang kiangah hong tungkhin hi.

Egypt gam leitang na mai-ah om a, leitang hoih penna mun ah na pa leh na sanggamte tengsak in. Goshen leitang ah amaute tengsak in. Amaute lakah a tuam vilvelin hih theihna nei na theih leh, keima ganhonte kem dingin amaute koih in,” a ci hi.
Tua ciangin Yahseph in a pa Yaaqob lutpihin Pharaoh mai-ah koih a, Yaaqob in Pharaoh hopih hi.
Pharaoh in tua ciangin Yaaqob kiangah, “Kum bangzah na hi hiam?” ci-in a dong hi.

Yaaqob in Pharaoh kiangah, “Ka khualzinna hun sung kumte pen kum 130 ahi hi. Ka nuntak hun tawm in haksa a, ka dam sung kumte pen ka pate khualzinna hun sungin amaute nuntakna kum hunte tawh kikim zo nai lo hi.
Tua tak ciangin Yaaqob in Pharaoh mangphakhak-in Pharaoh’ omna panin a paikhia hi.
Tua ahih manin Pharaoh thupiaksa bangin Yahseph in a pa leh a sanggamte Egypt gam sungah tengsak a, Remeses gam, leitang hoih penna sungah neihlelam a pia hi.
Yahseph in a pa, a sanggamte leh a pa’ innkuanpih khempeuh, amau innkuan sung phazah tawh kizui-in an tawh panpih hi.
Kialpi nasialua mahmah ahih manin gam sung khempeuh ah an om lo hi; kialpi hangin Egypt gam leh Canaan gam vul ningniang hi.
Antang a kileina hanga Egypt gam sung pan a akingah sum khempeuh Yahseph in kaikhawm-in, amah in Pharaoh’ kumpi inn ah a paipih hi.

Egypt gam sung leh Canaan gam sungah sum a bei ciangin Egypt mi khempeuh Yahseph kiangah hong pai uh a, a gen inah: “Ka sum uh beita a, na mai panin si ding ka hi uh hiam? Kote an hong pia in!” a ci uh hi.
Tua ciangin Yahseph in, “Na sum uh bei ahih manin na ganhon uh hong pia un, tua ciangin keimah in na ganhon hangin an ka pia ding hi,” a ci hi.

Tua ahih manin amaute in a gankhawite uh Yahseph kiangah paipih uh a, amaute sakolte, tuuhonte, bawnghonte, leh laate uh khekna-in an a pia hi. Amah in tua kum sung tawntung amaute gankhawi khempeuh khekna-in an pia hi.

Tua kum hong bei-in, a kumkik ciangin amaute ama kiangah hong pai-in, a gen inah: “Ka sum uh a bei taktakna ka ukpa kiang panin kong im vet kei uh hi; ka ganhonte uh zong ka ukpa aa hi-in ka pumpite uh leh ka leitangte simloh ka ukpa muhna panin bangmah om nawn lo hi.

Bang hangin kote leh ka leitang uh na mit mai panin si mang ding ka hi uh hiam? An khekna in kote leh ka leitang uh hong lei in, kote ka leitang uh tawh Pharaoh nasemte ka hi ding uh hi. Leitang pen gamkhing a suah loh nadingin kote khaici hong pia in tua hileh kote ka nungta ding uh a, ka si kei ding uh hi.

Tua ahih manin Yahseph in Pharaoh aa dingin Egypt gam leitang khempeuh lei hi. Egypt mi a kuamahpeuh in a lote uh zuak uh hi. Bang hang hiam cihleh kialpi pen amaute tungah nasialua mahmah hi. Tua ahih manin leitang pen Pharaoh aa a suak hi.
Egypt mong khat pan adang khat donga mite Yahseph in salsuahna khiap nadingin khuapite sungah a khin hi.

Siampite’ leitang bek Yahseph in lei lo hi. Bang hang hiam cihleh Pharaoh kiang panin siampite in a kiciangtan zah an a hunhunin amaute tungah kipia a, Pharaoh in amaute tunga a piak amaute tanh hangin amaute in kicingtakin an nei ahih manin hih hangin amau leitangte zuak kul nawn se lo hi.
Yahseph in mite kiangah, “Pharaoh aa dingin tuni-in note leh na leitang uh kong leikhin hi. Hih lai mun ah note aa dingin khaici om ahih manin note in leitang ah na vawh thei ding uh hi.
Ahih hangin an lak ciangin note in Pharaoh tungah nga-ah-khat na pia ding uh hi. Khaici pen no aa ahih manin nga-ah-li pen note aa hi ding a, na innkuanpihte leh na tate aa dingin an hi ding hi.
Tua ahih manin amaute in, “Nangmah in ka nuntakna uh nong hukhin hi. Ka ukpa uh mit panin maipha hong ngahsak inla, kote pen Pharaoh nasemte ka hi ding uh hi,” a ci hi.
Tua ahih manin Yahseph tua pen Egypt gam sungah thukham khat bangin kipsak a, tu ni dongin a piangkhia panin nga-ah-khat pen Pharaoh aa ahi hi. Pharaoh aa a suak lo pen siampite leitang bek ahi hi.
Tu-in Egypt gam sung Goshen gamke ah Israyl teng a, amaute in tua lai mun ah neihlelamte nei uh a, pungin nakpitakin tampi a pha uh hi.
Egypt gam sungah Yaaqob kum 17 sung teng hi. Tua ahih manin Yaaqob’ nuntak hun sung pen kum 147 ahi hi.

Israyl a sih ding hun hong nai mahmah ciangin, amah in a tapa Yahseph sam a, ama kiangah, “Na muhna ah maipha ka ngah ahih leh ka phei nuai-ah na khut hong koih inla, migitna leh cihtakna man kei nong lak ding hong ciam in. Egypt gam sungah hong vui kei in.
Ka pate tawh hong sial khawm in. Egypt panin hong puakhia inla, amaute kivuina mun ah kei hong vui in,” a ci hi. Tua ciangin Yahseph in, “Na gen bangin ka gamta ding hi,” a ci hi.
Tua tak ciangin Yaaqob in, “Kei tungah hong kiciam in,” a ci hi. Yahseph ama tungah a kiciam hi. Tua ahih manin Israyl kunin a lukhung ah a bia hi.

headings.text: Yaaqob in Yahseph’ Tapate Thupha Pia

verses.text: Hih thute khit ciangin Yahseph thu kizasak a, “Na pa a cina hi” a kici hi; amah in a tapa nihte Menasheh leh Ephraim paipih hi.
Yaaqob kiangah, “En in, na tapa Yahseph na kiangah hong paikhiakhin hi” a kicih ciangin Israyl in a thasanin a lupna tungah a tuto hi.
Tua tak ciangin Yaaqob in Yahseph kiangah, “Canaan gam sung Luz ah Vanglian Pen Yahweh kei tungah hong kilangin, kei thupha hong pia a,
a gen inah: ‘Keimah in a pungin tampi a pha-in nang Kong bawl ding a, mihonpi khatin nang hong bawlin a neih tawntung dingin nang khit a na suanlekhakte tungah hih gam Ka pia ding hi,’ ci hi.
Tua ahih ciangin kei kong pai ma-a Egypt gam sunga suak na tapa tenih pen kei aa hi. Reuben leh Simeon kei aa ahih mah bangin Ephraim leh Menaseheh pen kei aa hi.
Amaute’ khit cianga na neih ding na suanlekhakte pen nang aa hi ding a, ahih hangin amaute gamh luahna gam sungah a sanggamte’ min tawh amaute kilo ding hi.

Padan pan ka ciahkik lai-in Ephrath panin a gamla luatlohna lampi ah ka om lai mah un, Canaan gam sungah ka kiang panin Rachel si hi. Tua ahih manin Ephrath (Tua pen Bethlehem ahi hi.) paina lampi gei-ah amah ka vui hi,” a ci hi.
Tua tak ciangin Israyl in Yahseph’ tapate mu a, “Hihte kua hiam?” ci-in a dong hi.

Yahseph in a pa kiangah, “Amaute pen Yahweh in hih mun-a hong piaksa ka tapate ahi uh hi,” a ci hi. Yaaqob in, “Amaute ka kiangah hong paipih in, tua hileh amaute thupha ka pia thei ding hi!” a ci hi.
Israyl pen teekta ahih manin a mitte mang a, ciantakin a mu thei nawn kei hi. Tua ahih manin Yahseph in amaute Israyl’ kiangah paipih a, amah in amaute namin a angkawi hi.
Tua khit ciangin Israyl in Yahseph kiangah, “Na maitang ka muhkik ding cikmahin ka lamen ngeikei hi. Tu-in Yahweh in tate zong a mu dingin kei hong phal hi!” a ci hi.
Tua ciangin Yahseph in Israyl’ khuk gei panin amaute lakhia-in leilam nga-in a kunsuk hi.
Tua khit ciangin Yahseph in a nih tuakin len a, ama taklama om Ephraim pen Israyl’ veilam khut ah, ama veilama om Menasheh pen Israyl’ taklam khut ah kai-in Israyl kiangah a nehsak hi.

Ahih hangin Israyl in a taklam khut zankhia-in Ephraim pen a nauzaw ahih hangin ama tungah a khut nga a, amah in a khut kipaihpehsakin, Menasheh pen a uzaw himah taleh amah in a veilam khut Menasheh’ lu tungah a nga hi.

Amah in Yahseph thupha pia-in a gen inah: “Ka pate Abraham leh Isaac-te ma-a om Vantung Pa, tu ni dongin ka nuntak sung tawntung, tuu bangin kei hong cingin hong ompih tawntung Yahweh; siatna khempeuh panin hong tankhia Vantungmi in hih naupangte thupha pia tahen.
Amaute tungah keima min leh ka pate Abraham leh Isaac-te min kizomsak henla, leitung ah amaute mi honpi khatin khangsak tahen!’ a ci hi.
A pa in a taklam khut Ephraim’ lu tungah a koihlam Yahseph in a muh ciangin, tua in amah lungkimlosak hi. Ephraim’ lu panin Menasseh’ lu tungah koih dingin amah in a pa’ khut la a,
Yahseph in, “Tua bang hilo hi, ka pa aw, hih khat zaw pen ka ta masa hi. Ama lu tungah na khut nga in,” a ci hi.

Ahih hangin a pa in nial a, a gen inah: “Ka thei hi ka ta aw, ka thei hi. Amah zong mi nam khat hong suak veve ding a, amah zong a lian a suak ding hi; ahi zongin a naupa amah sangin lianzaw ding a, ama suanlekhakte pen minam tampi a suak ding hi.
Yaaqob in amaute tua ni-in thupha pia a, a gen inah: ‘Ephraim leh Menasheh bangin Yahweh in nang hong bawl ta hen’ ci-in genna tawh note tungtawnin Israyl mite thupha kipia ding hi, a ci hi.
Tua ciangin Israyl in Yahseph kiangah, “Kei ka si dek ta hi. Ahih hangin Yahweh nang tawh hong om ding a, na pate gam ah nang hong ciahpihkik ding hi.
Ka namsau leh ka thal tawh Amor mite kiang panin ka lak sehtanh nang tungah na sanggamte sangin sehtanh khat a tamzaw-in kong pia hi.

headings.text: A Tate kianga Yaaqob’ Kammal Nunung

verses.text: Tua ciangin Yaaqob in a tapate sam a, “Hong kikaikhawm un, tua hileh ni tawp nite ciangin hong tung dingte note tungah kong gen ding hi.
Hong kikaikhawm unla ngai un, Yaaqob tapate aw; na pa uh Israyl’ thu ngai un.
Reuben, nang pen ka ta upa, ka vangliatna, ka thahatna lim masa, pahtawina hoih mahmah, leh a dimlet hih theihna a nei ka ta na hi hi.
Tui bangin a kiloklok nang pen sawtvei na hoih deuh nawn kei ding hi. Bang hang hiam cihleh na pa’ lupna tung ka kualna tungah nang na kahto a, ka lupna na ninsak hi.
Simeon leh Levi pen unau hi a, amaute namsau pen gitlohna galhiamte ahi hi.

Amaute vaihawmna ah hong kihelsak kei unla, amaute pawl ah ka minthanna tawh hong kizomsak kei un. Bang hang hiam cihleh amaute in hehna tawh mi khat that uh a, amaute lungkimna pen bawngtal’ zagui sattan peuh ahi hi.
Amaute hehna in samsiatna ngah tahen, a hehna uh lauhuai a, a thangpaihna uh kihtakhuai hi! Keimah in Yaaqob sungah amaute ka thehthang ding a, Israylte lakah ka khen ding hi.
Yahdah, na sanggamte in nang hong phat ta uh hen; na galte ngawng ah na khut kinga ding a, na pa’ tapate na kiangah hong kunsuk ding uh hi.

Nang pen humpinelkai no khat na hi a, Yahdah aw; sa sialnekna panin nang nong ciahkik hi, ka ta aw. Humpinelkai khat bangin amah in buk a, a boksuk hi. Tua humpi a phawng ngam a hangsan humpinelkai ta nei tawh kibang hi.
Yahdah kiang panin kumpi ciangkhut kikhenkhia lo ding a, siahnei pa kiangah Amah hong pai-in minamte zahtakna pen Ama aa ahih matengin ukna ciangkhut; Thukham-pia-pa, in zong taisan lo ding hi.
Leenggah kung ah a laa khih a, ama laa-no leenggui hoih pen ah khih hi; amah in leenggahzu sungah a puan sawp dinga, leenggah tui sungah a puantualpite a sawp ding hi.
Ama mittangte leenggahzu sangin vomzaw ding a, a hate bawngnawi sangin paak zaw ding hi.
Zebulun, tuipi gei-ah teng ding a, tembawte aa dingin khawlna khat suak ding hi; ama gamgi pen Sidon lamah zai ding hi.
Issachar pen vangik nih kikal-a lum a thakhauh laa khat ahi hi.
A khawlna mun bangzahtakin a hoihna leh leitang bangzahtakin a hoihna a muh ciangin, vanpua dingin amah in awnsuk a, a kitangsawl na sem dingin amah kipia ding hi.
Dan in Israyl minamte khat bangin a mite thumanna tawh gelsakin pia ding hi.
Dan pen lampi gei-a gulpi khat hi ding a, sakol’ khetul a tu lam gei-a gulgu nei hi ding hi. Tua ahih manin sakol’ tung tuang pa a nungkiat hi.
Nangma hotkhiatna ka ngakngak hi, Yahweh aw!
Gad pen galkap hon, khat in amah zo ding a, ahih hangin a tawpna ah amah gualzo ding hi.
Asher’ an pung ding a, amah in kumpite aa dingin anlimte bawl ding hi.
Naphtali pen kammal hoihte a gen a kikhahkhia sazukpi khat ahi hi.
Yahseph pen gamsa no, tuiluang khat gei-a gamsa no, mual tamzang tunga om gam laa khat ahi hi.
Muhdah mahmahna tawh thal tawite in amah do a; amaute in galbawlna tawh amah a kap hi.

Ahih hangin amaute’ thal kikek zolo a, Yaaqob’ Vanglian Khat’ khutte hang leh Israyl’ Suangpi Tuucing pa hang leh, nang hong huh na pate’ Pa hang leh, nang thupha hong pia Vanglian Pen Pa hangin amaute khutte a thanem hi:
vantungte tung panin thuphate, nuai-a a thukpi panin thuphate, nawi leh naubu panin thuphate;

buh kung leh a pakpalh panin thuphate, tawntung mual liante panin thuphate; tawntung mual neute’ lungkimnate: hihte khempeuh Yahseph’ lu tungah hong tung henla; a sanggamte kiang panin tavuan kician khat aa dinga a siangtho a kituamkoih; a kituamkoih pa’ lu-a kumpi lukhu tungah tung hen.
Benyamin pen a gilkial mahmah ngia khat ahi hi: zingsangin amah in a galpa sutin ne baba a, nitak ciangin a suhsa teng a hawm hi,” a ci hi.
Hihte khempeuh pen Israyl minam sawm le nihte ahi hi. Hih thute pen amau tawh a kituak ciatin a pa in amaute a kikhen ding uh ciangin mangpha khakna-in a gente ahi hi.
Tua tak ciangin amah in hih thuhilhnate amaute tungah pia a, a gen inah: “Ka mipihte kiangah a kigawm ding ka hita hi. Hit mi Ephron’ lo sung kuahawm sungah ka pate tawh hong vuikhawm un,
tua kuahawm pen Canaan gam sung Mamre nai-a Machpelah lo sunga kuahawm hi-a, tua pen a lo tawh Hit mi Ephron kiang panin Abraham in han mun a neih dingin a lei ahi hi.
Tua mun ah amaute in Abraham leh a zi Sarah vui a, tua mun ah amaute in Isaac leh a zi Rebekah vui a, tua mun ah keimah in Leah ka vui hi.
Lo leh kuahawm sunga khempeuh pen Heth’ suanlekhakte kiang panin a kilei ahi hi,” a ci hi.
Yaaqob in a tapate a thuhilhna a man khit ciangin amah in lupna ah a khete likto a, a hu tawpna sang-in a mipihte kiangah a kigawm hi.
Tua ciangin Yahseph maitang tungah kunsukin, amah kah a, a nam hi.
Tua ciangin a pa a muat loh nadinga a bawl dingin Yahseph in a nasem zatui siamte sawl a, tua ahih manin zatui siamte in Israyl a muat lo dingin bawl uh hi.
Amaute in ni 40 hun la hi. Bang hang hiam cihleh a muat lo-a bawl nadingin hun tua zah a kisam hi.
Ama hangin kahna hun a beikhit ciangin Yahseph in Pharaoh’ thukhen zum ah, “Note muhna ah tu-in keimah in maipha ka muh leh, Pharaoh kiangah thu hong gensak unla, ama tungah,

ka pa in kei hong kiciamna khat hong ciamsak a, ‘En in, tu-in a si ding ka hi ta a, Canaan gam sungah kei aa dingin ka tawhsa hankhuk sungah kei hong vui in,’ hong ci hi. Tua ahih manin, kei hong paitosak unla, ka pa hong vuisak un. Tua khit ciangin kei kong paikik ding hi.
Pharaoh in, “Paito inla, amah in nang hong kiciamsak mah bangin na pa vui in,” a ci hi.
Tua ahih manin Yahseph in a pa vui dingin paito hi. Amah tawh Pharaoh’ uliante khempeuh, ama thukhen zum-a uliante, leh Egypt gam uliante khempeuh in a zui hi;
Yahseph’ innkuante khempeuh, a sanggamte leh a pa’ innkuanpihte tawh a omte in zong a zui uh hi. Amaute tate, amaute tuuhonte leh a bawnghonte bek Goshen ah a nusia uh hi.
Leengte leh sakol hawlte amah tawh paito uh hi. Tua lai-a a paite tam mahmah hi.
Amaute Yardan gun galkhat, Atad’ buhcilna phual a tun uh ciangin amaute nakpitakin dahna tawh a thuum uh hi. Tua mun ah Yahseph a pa hangin ni sagih sung dahna hun a bawl hi.

Tua mun-a teng Canaan mite in Atad buhcilna ah tua banga kahna a muh ciangin amaute in, “Hih pen Egypt mite aa dingin a nasia mahmah thuumna ahi hi,” a ci uh hi. Tua ahih manin tua mun pen Abel Mitzraim kici hi. Tua pen Yardan nai-a Egypt mite dahna a cihna ahi hi.
Tua ahih manin Yaaqob’ tapate in ama thupiaksa mah bangin ama aa dingin hih uh hi:
Canaan gam ah a tapate in amah pua uh a, han mun a neih dingin Hit mi Ephron kiang panin Abraham in a lo tawh a leikhop, Mamre nai-a Machpelah lo kuahawm sungah amah a vui uh hi.
Yahseph in a pa a vui khit ciangin amah leh a sanggamte, leh a pa vui dingin amah tawh a paito khempeuh Egypt gam ah a ciahkik uh hi.
Yahseph’ sanggamte in a pa uh a sihna a muh uh ciangin amaute in, “Yahseph in eite hong lungkimlo-in ama tunga siatna i bawl khempeuh hong thukkik kha leh?” a ci uh hi.
Tua ahih manin amaute in Yahseph kiangah kamtai sawl uh a, “Na pa a sihma in amah in thu hong pia a, a gen inah:

‘Yahseph kiangah hi bangin ci un: Hehpihna tawh na sanggamte mawhna leh nang tunga hong khialhna tu-in na maisak in. Ahang in amaute in nang hong siatsakin nang tungah hong gamta uh hi. Hehpih takin na pa i Vantunga om Pa’ nasemte’ mawhna maisak in’ ci-in,” a ci hi. Amaute genna thu ama kiangah hong tun ciangin, Yahseph a kap hi.
A sanggamte tua khit ciangin hong pai a, ama mai-ah amaute kunsuk uh a, “Ko pen na nasemte ka hi uh hi,” a ci uh hi.
Ahih hangin Yahseph in amaute kiangah, “Lau kei un, kei Yahweh’ dinmun ah om ka hi hiam? A ci hi.
Note in keimah natna dingin na gel uh a, ahih hangin Yahweh in tua pen tu ni-a mi tampite nuntakna kep na’ng hong tangtun’ nadingin thupha-in hong gelsak hi.
Tua ahih manin tu-in lau kei un; keimah in note leh na tate aa dingin kong panpih ding hi. Amah in tua bangin kip gen pha kikin amaute a hehnem hi.
Tua ahih manin Yahseph, amah leh a pa’ innkuanpihte Egypt gam sungah a teng uh hi. Yahseph kum 110 nungta a,
Amah in khang thumna ahi Ephraim’ tate mu hi. Menasseh’ tapa Machir tate pen Yahseph’ khuk tung ah a piang uh hi. Amaute Yaaqob aa ci-in a kiciamteh hi.

Tua ciangin Yahseph in a sanggamte kiangah, “Kei a si ding ka hi ta hi. Ahih hangin Yahweh in note huh dingin hong pai taktak ding a, Abraham, Isaac leh Yaaqob tungah Amah in a ciamsa leitang ah note hih leitang panin hong paikhiatpih ding hi,” a ci hi.

Tua ciangin Yahseph in Israyl’ tapate kiangah kiciamna khat kiciamsak a, “Yahweh in note huh dingin hong pai taktak ding a, tua ciangin note in ka guhte hih mun panin na paipihto hamtang ding uh hi,” a ci hi.
Tua ciangin Yahseph si a, kum 110 a pha hi; amaute in amah a muat lo dingin bawl a, Egypt gam sung hankuang sung khat ah kikoih hi.
